jobs.title: Scientific Production
jobs.salary_text: R791 604 per annum, (OSD), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with OSD)
jobs.summary: Manage scientific production systems and develop methodologies, policies and compliance regulations for the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and an appropriate 4-year BSc (Honours) or equivalent in Agriculture in Soil Science majoring in soil fertility and plant nutrition. Compulsory registration with South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as a Professional Natural Scientist. Minimum of 3 years post qualification regulatory PUBLIC experience. Job Related Knowledge: Expertise and experience in the interpretation of Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agriculture Remedies and stock Remedies Act,1947 (Act No: 36 of 1947) together with its regulations and guidelines. Job Related Skills: Programme & project management. Scientific methodologies and models. Ability to research and develop independently. Legal compliance. Data analysis (high level analytical skills). Ms Office Software (Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Technical report writing (the ability to prepare and present complex reports). Customer service skills. Communication skills. (verbal and written). Ability to work under pressure. Extended working hours/overtime may be required. Travelling. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement methodologies, systems and procedures. identify and consolidate needs for methodologies, policies, systems and procedures by developing administrative and compliance regulations and SOPs. Identify gaps and develop appropriate interventions by developing guidelines and conducting training workshops. Monitor and evaluate programme performance and perform scientific functions that require interpretation in the absence of an established framework by writing technical reports. Provide scientific support and advice through client advisory meetings and via emails. Develop working relations with client base during liaison meetings with clients. Create public awareness of the science system through liaison with stakeholders. Provie scientific data, information and advice as requested by responding to technical enquiries. Perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Conduct analysis of scientific data during the evaluation of applications to register fertilizers. Gather and interpret data, evaluate results and disseminate information by publishing information packages. Formulate proposals and compile reports by writing technical submissions when required. Develop and customise scientific models and techniques by contributing to the technical aspects of regulations. Compile technical reports. Research and Development. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures by attending technical workshops and conferences. Research/literature studies to improve expertise by reading technical publications. Publish and present research findings; and liaise with relevant bodies /councils, industries, government departments and other stakeholders on science and regulatory related matters. Human Capital and Development. Mentor, train and develop candidate scientist and others to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound scientific principles and code of practice. Customer Service Management. Continuous professional development. To keep up with new technologies and procedures by attending technical workshops and conferences. Research /literature studies to improve expertise by residing publications. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils, industries, government departments and other stakeholders on science and regulatory related matters.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie
af.summary: Bestuur wetenskaplike produksiestedels en ontwikkel metodologieë, beleide en nakomingsregulasies vir die Department of Agriculture in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n toepaslike 4-jarige BSc (Honours) of ekwivalent in Landbou met Grondkunde as hoofvak met spesialisering in grondvrugbaarheid en plantvoeding. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as 'n Professional Natural Scientist. Minimum van 3 jaar post-kwalifikasie regulatoriese OPENBARE ervaring. Werksverwante Kennis: Kennis en ervaring in die interpretasie van die Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agriculture Remedies and stock Remedies Act,1947 (Act No: 36 of 1947) tesame met sy regulasies en riglyne. Werksverwante Vaardighede: Program- en projekbestuur. Wetenskaplike metodologieë en modelle. Vermoë om onafhanklik te navorseer en te ontwikkel. Regsonderhorigheid. Data-ontleding (hoë vlak analitiese vaardighede). Ms Office Software (Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Tegniese verslagskryfwerk (die vermoë om komplekse verslae voor te berei en voor te lê). Klantediensvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Verlengde werksure/oortyd mag vereis word. Reis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer metodologieë, stelsels en prosedures. Identifiseer en konsolideer behoeftes vir metodologieë, beleide, stelsels en prosedures deur administratiewe en nakomingsregulasies en SOP's te ontwikkel. Identifiseer leemtes en ontwikkel toepaslike ingrypings deur riglyne te ontwikkel en opleidingswerkswinkels te bied. Monitor en evalueer programprestasie en voer wetenskaplike funksies uit wat interpretasie vereis in die afwesigheid van 'n gevestigde raamwerk deur tegniese verslae te skryf. Verskaf wetenskaplike ondersteuning en advies deur kliëntadviesvergaderings en via e-pos. Bou werksverhoudings met die kliëntbasis gedurende skakelvergaderings met kliënte. Skep openbare bewustheid van die wetenskapstelsel deur skakeling met belanghebbendes. Verskaf wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies soos versoek deur op tegniese navrae te reageer. Voer wetenskaplike ontleding en regulatoriese funksies uit. Doen ontleding van wetenskaplike data gedurende die evaluering van aansoeke om bemestingstowwe te registreer. Versamel en interpreteer data, evalueer resultate en versprei inligting deur inligtingspakkette te publiseer. Formuleer voorstelle en stel verslae op deur tegniese voorleggings te skryf wanneer vereis. Ontwikkel en pas wetenskaplike modelle en tegnieke aan deur by te dra tot die tegniese aspekte van regulasies. Stel tegniese verslae op. Navorsing en Ontwikkeling. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures deur tegniese werkswinkels en konferensies by te woon. Navorsings-/literatuurstudies om kundigheid te verbeter deur tegniese publikasies te lees. Publiseer en lê navorsingsbevindings voor; en skakel met tersaaklike liggame/rade, industrieë, regeringsdepartemente en ander belanghebbendes oor wetenskap- en regulatorieverwante aangeleenthede. Menslike Kapitaal en Ontwikkeling. Mentorskap, opleiding en ontwikkeling van kandidaatwetenskaplikes en andere om vaardigheids/kennisoordrag en nakoming van deeglike wetenskaplike beginsels en gedragskode te bevorder. Klantediensbestuur. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures deur tegniese werkswinkels en konferensies by te woon. Navorsings-/literatuurstudies om kundigheid te verbeter deur publikasies te bestudeer. Skakel met tersaaklike liggame/rade, industrieë, regeringsdepartemente en ander belanghebbendes oor wetenskap- en regulatorieverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Ukukhiqizwa Kwesayensi
zu.summary: Phatha izinhlelo zokukhiqizwa kwesayensi futhiuthuthukise izindlela, izinqubomgomo nemithetho yokuziphathisa kweMinyango yezolimo ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-BSc (Honours) ezinhlobonhlobo zonyaka we-4 noma okulinganayo kwezolimo kwi-Soil Science ezingxenyeni yezinkuni zomhlabathi ukondza kanye nokudla kwezitshalo. Ukubhalisa ngokuphothule ku-South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengososayensi wezemvelo ongumuntu ogunyaziwe. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 yokusebenza komphakathi ngemuva kokuthola iziqu. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ubuchwepheshe nokuhlonipheka ekuchazeni i-Fertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agriculture Remedies and stock Remedies Act,1947 (Act No: 36 of 1947) kanye nemithetho yayo nezinqubomgomo. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namagepha. Izindlela nezinhlelo zesayensi. Ikakhono lokucwaninga nokuthuthukisa nokuzimele. Ukuhambisana nomthetho. Ukuhlaziya idatha (amakhono okuhlaziya ibanga eliphezulu). Isoftware ye-Ms Office (Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe (ikakhono lokulungisa futhi umyale izibalo ezibucayi). Amakhono okusebenzela abathengi. Amakhono okuxhumana. (akho ngomlomo kanye nobhalwe). Ikakhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela. kungase kudingeke ukusebenza izikhathi ezengeziwe/nomasikhathi songezele. Ukuhamba. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izindlela, izinhlelo nezinqubo. Bonakalisa futhi uhlanganise izidingo zezindlela, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo nezinqubo ngokuthuthukisa imithetho yokuphatha nokuziphathisa kanye nama-SOPs. Bonakalisa izikhala futhi uthuthukise izinyathelo ezifanele ngokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo nokubamba amakilasi okolwa. Qaphela futhi uhlolisise ukusebenza kwenhlelo futhi wenze imisebenzi yesayensi edinga ukuchazwa ekungeneni kwesikhathi esakhiwe ngokubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Nikeza inkuxeko yesayensi kanye nencomo ngokusebenzisa izinkumuso zabathengi kanye nge-imeyili. Thuthukise izinhlelo zokusebenza nabathengi ngaminkumuso yokuhlangana nabathengi. Yenza ukwaziswa komphakathi mayelana nenhlelo yesayensi ngokuhlukana namakhela. Nikeza idatha yesayensi, ukwaziswa kanye nencomo njengoba kuceliwe ngokuphendula imibuzo yobuchwepheshe. Yenzo ukuhlaziya isayensi kanye nemisebenzi emithetho. Yenza ukuhlaziya idatha yesayensi ngexesha lokuhlolwa kwezicelo zokubhalisa izibulula zomhlabathi. Qoqa futhi uchaze idatha, uhlolisise imiphumela futhi usakaze ukwaziswa ngokushicilela izinqulunga zenwazi. Lungisa iziphakamiso futhi uqoqe imibhalo ngokubhala iziyalezo zobuchwepheshe lapho kudingeka khona. Thuthukisa futhi ulungise izinhlelo nezindlela zesayensi ngokwabelana ngemicabango yobuchwepheshe yemithetho. Qoqa imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ucwaningo kanye nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo komsebenzi ukuze bagone ematekinolojini amatsha kanye nezinqubo ngokubamba amakilasi okolwa nobuchwepheshe kanye namakilasi. Ucwaningo/izifundo zokulandela ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe ngokufunda okushicilelwe kobuchwepheshe. Shicilela futhi umyale imiphumela yesayensi; futhi uhlukane namabhunga/ amakhansili, amabhizinisi, amaminnyango kahulumeni kanye namakhela omunye ngemikhakha yesayensi kanye nemithetho. Amakhono abantu nokuthuthukiswa. Qeqesha, qeqesa futhi uthuthukise ososayensi abangabafaki isicelo kanye nabanye ukuze khuthaze ukudluliswa kwamakhono/ulwazi kanye nokuhambisana nemigomo yesayensi eqinisekile kanye nendlela yokwenza umsebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo zabathengi. Ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo komsebenzi. Ukuze ugcine ukuziphatha ngamatekinolojini amatsha kanye nezinqubo ngokubamba amakilasi okolwa nobuchwepheshe kanye namakilasi. Ucwaningo/ izifundo zokulandela ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe ngokuhlala okushicilelwe. Hlukana namabhunga/ amakhansili, amabhizinisi, amaminnyango kahulumeni kanye namakhela abantu bomunye mayelana nesayensi kanye nemithetho ehlotshaniswa.

xh.title: Ukuveliswa kweZenzululwazi
xh.summary: Phatha iinkqubo zokuveliswa kwezenzululwazi ziphuhlise iindlela, iinkqubo zemigaqo nemigaqo yokuzezisa kwisebe leZolimo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 kwaye neBSc (Honours) eneminyaka ye-4 okanye esilingana nayo kwiZolimo kwiSoil Science ngegatya lokutyaliswa komhlaba nesityalo. Kuyimfuno ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengengcali yeZenaturali eZenzululwazi. Ubuncinane i-3 iminyaka yamava woLawulo ngoPhakathi komsebenzi kamambelele. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ingcobo namava ekuchazeni iFertilizer, Farm Feeds, Agriculture Remedies and stock Remedies Act,1947 (Act No: 36 of 1947) kunye nemigaqo yayo neenqaqavaba. Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Iindlela neemodeli zezenzululwazi. Ikhono lokuphanda nokuphuhliza ngokuzimeleyo. Ukuzezekwa komthetho. Ukuhlazulwa kwedata (amandla aphezulu ekuhlazulweni). Isoftware yeMs Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Ukbhaliwe kwemibobo yobuchwepheshe (ikhono lokulungisa nokubonisa iimibobo ezinzima). Amandla okukhonza abathengi. Amandla okunxibelelwana. (olubhalwayo noluthethwayo). Ikhono lokusebenza ngotshaba. Iiyure ezeenzieko zomsebenzi/ixesha elengeziwe lingafuneka. Ukuhamba. Ilayisensi yomqhubi esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa uzeke iindlela, iinkqubo neenqobo. Chaza qhubele nidibene iimfuno zeendlela, iinkqubo zemigaqo, iinkqubo neenqobo ngokuphuhlisa iinkqubo zolawulo nemigaqo yokuzezisa neSOPs. Chaza iingxixa uze uphuhlise iingenelelo ezifanelekileyo ngokulungisa iinquaqavaba nokwenza iindaba zokuzilolonga. Qondise qinisekise inkqulo yomphumo wenkqubo uze wenze imisebenzi yezenzululwazi efuneka ichazwa ngokungabikho kwesiseko esisekiweyo ngokubhala iimibobo yobuchwepheshe. Nikela ngenkxaso nengcebiso yezenzululwazi ngokudibana kwangaabathengi kwaye nge-email. Phuhlisa ubudlelwane bokusebenza nabathengi ngexesha lomanyano lwabathengi. Yila ingqiqo yokumanywa ngoluntu ngenkqubo yezenzululwazi ngokunxibelelana nabathintathintya. Nikezela idatha yezenzululwazi, ulwazi nengcebiso njengoko kuceliwe ngokuphendula iimbuzo yobuchwepheshe. Zenza isahlulelo sezenzululwazi nemisebenzi yolawulo. Qhubelesela isahlulelo sedatha yezenzululwazi ngexesha lokuhlola iimfuno zokubhalisa iifertilizers. Qokelela uze uchaze idatha, hlola iziphumo kwaye yasabe ulwazi ngokushicilela iiphakheji zolwazi. Lungezela iincolelo uze uhluze iimibobo ngokubhala izicelo zobuchwepheshe xa kufuneka. Phuhlisa ulungelelise iimodeli neendlela zezenzululwazi ngokunegalelo kumacandwo obuchwepheshe emigaqo. Hluza iimibobo yobuchwepheshe. Uphononongo nokuPhuhliswa. Ukuphuhliswa ngokuchasene kobungcali ngokuya kwzindaba zobuchwepheshe namagumbi ngokuhlala kumtshingo neteknoloji ngeenkqubo ezintsha. Uphononongo/ukufunda izifundo ukuphucula ingcobo ngokufunda iimibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Shicilela ubonise iziphuso ziphandiweyo; unxibelelane namabumba/amagunyazwe, amashishini, amasebe karhulumente nabanye abathintathintya kumacandwa ezinzululwazi nolawulo. Amandla oMutu nokuPhuhliswa. Qeqesha, fundisa uze uphuhlise ogqitha kwengcali yenzululwazi nabanye ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kwamandla/olwazi nokuzinikela kwiimigaqo yezenzululwazi nekhodi yokusebenza. Ulawulo loKukhonza abathengi. Ukuphuhliswa ngokuchasene kobungcali. Ukugcina iliso kwiteknoloji ngeenkqubo ezintsha ngokubakho kwindaba zobuchwepheshe namagumbi. Uphononongo/ukufunda izifundo ukuphucula ingcobo ngokuhlala kumzila. Xhumana namabumba/amagunyazwe, amashishini, amasebe karhulumente nabathintathintya kumacandwa ezinzululwazi nolawulo.

af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer relevante stelsels en prosedures. Verifieer aansoeke en tegniese vraelyste wat deur applikante ingedien word ooreenkomstig die Plant Breeding’s Rights Act en die Plant Improvement Act. Vestiging van proewe in samewerking met die direktoraat se plaasbestuurder, applikant of hul aangestelde agent soos van toepassing. Identifiseer die ligging van alle kandidaat- en vergelykende variëteite / skakel met die plaasbestuurder oor veldidentifikasie. Skakel met kliënte oor aangeleenthede verwant aan hul aansoeke en doen terreinbesoeke. Voer tegniese wetenskaplike analises uit. Versamel data oor kandidaat- en standaardvariëteite volgens voorgeskrewe riglyne. Waarneming en evaluering van kandidate volgens die International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV) of Nasionale Toetsriglyne soos van toepassing. Variëteitkarakterisering en -dokumentasie. Data-analise oor kandidaat- en standaardvariëteite. Stel variëteitbeskrywings en DUS-verslae vir kandidaatvariëteite op. Bevestig dat kandidaatvariëteite aan voorgeskrewe DUS-vereistes voldoen ooreenkomstig die tersaaklike wetgewing. Dataverwerking. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies. Versamel en verskaf tegniese / wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies aan Registrateurs en Plantverbeteringsorganisasies. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies aan applikante met betrekking tot Tegniese Vraelyste wat ingedien word ooreenkomstig die Plant Breeder’s Rights Act en die Plant Improvement Act. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Opstel en / of verskaf insette tot UPOV en / of verskaf aan UPOV en / of nasionale toetsriglyne. Hersien en bestudeer wetenskaplike publikasies, insluitend internetsoektogte, wat relevant is tot ontvangde PBR/VL-aansoeke. Neem deel aan nasionale, streeks- en internasionale forums. Skakel met tersaaklike wetenskaplike liggame oor tegniese / wetenskapverwante aangeleenthede en die uitruil van kennis daarvan. Verseker bestuur van verwysingsversamelings. Verseker behoorlike bestuur van die argiefstelsel en gewas- en saadregisters. Voer navorsing uit of neem deel aan navorsing rakende variëteitkenmerke of ringtoetse soos van toepassing.

zu.title: Ukusayensi Ukukhiqiza 2
zu.summary: Isikhundla sosayensi sokukhiqiza esisesikhungweni sase-Stellenbosch esidinga i-BSc Honours noma i-M Tech, ukubhalisa ku-SACNSP, kanye neminyaka emithathu yesipiliyoni ezindaweni ezifanele ukuze kuphatwe amalungelo okulima izitshalo kanye nezivivinyo zokuthuthukiswa kwazo.
zu.requirements: Umuntu ofaka isicelo kumele abe necashishi le-Grade 12 kanye ne-BSc (Hon) noma i-M Tech anesihloko esikhulu se-Botany, Agronomy, Horticulture, Genetics kanye / noma i-Plant Biotechnology. Ukubhalisa ngokuphoqelelwa ne-South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNSP) njengenkosikazi ye-Professional Natural Scientist. Ukuqashwa komsebenzi ohlobene nalolu hlelo: Ukuthola ubudala obungaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) ngemuva kokuthola izifundo ezikuqeqesha emkhakheni we-botany, i-plant taxonomy, i-plant breeding noma ukuphathwa komthetho ohlobene nezolimo. Umthetho we-Plant Breeders' Rights Act. Umthetho we-Plant Improvement Act. Isivumelwano se-UPOV Convention. I-Plant Morphology and Physiology. Izibalo. Amakhono ohlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono ekhompyutha (i-MS Office). Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuphatha ukungqubuzana, okukhulumayo nakubhalwayo. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlelabuso. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngezinsimbi zedolobha. Ubuningqangi, amakhono ezibalo kanye nezibalo zokusayensi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ezindaweni zomphakathi. Ucwaningo, ukuhlolwa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo, amakhono okuhlaziya. Ikono lokusebenza ngempumelelo nangokusebenza. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa futhi ukusetshenzisa izimiso ezifanele, kanye nalezo zokuqondiswa. Ukuqinisekisa izicelo namapheshana awemibuzo obuchwepheshe ahethwe ngabafaki izicelo ngokomthetho we-Plant Breeding's Rights Act kanye noMthetho we-Plant Improvement Act. Ukumisa ukuhlolwa ngokubambisana neMphathi wesikhashana somnyango, isiceli noma umelane wabo oqokwe njengoko kufanelekile. Ukuhlola indawo yabo bonke abaphakamiswayo kanye nezinhlamvu ezinokubhekiswa / xhumana nemphathi yasepulazi ngokuqapha insimu. Ukuxhumana namakhasimoni ngezindaba ezihlobene nezicelo zabo futhi kwenziwe ukuvakashela izindawo. Ukwenza ukuhlaziywa kobuchwepheshe bokusayensi. Ukuqoqa ulwazi ngabaphakamiswayo kanye nezinhlamvu ezijwayelekile ngokoholayo olumiswe. Ukuqapha nokuhlola abaphakamiswayo ngokwe-International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV) noma uHoliko Lwezivivinyo Zwekati njengoko kufanelekile. Ukuvezwa kokuhluka kwezinhlamvu kanye nokuqoshwa kolwazi. Ukuhlaziya ulwazi ngabaphakamiswayo kanye nezinhlamvu ezijwayelekile. Ukuqamba incazelo yezinhlamvu kanye nemibiko ye-DUS yezinhlamvu zabaphakamiswayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlamvu zabaphakamiswayo zihambisana nezidingo ze-DUS ezimisiwe ngokomthetho ohlobene nokho. Ukugquba ulwazi. Ukunika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kanye neluleko. Ukuqoqa futhi ukunikeze idatha yobuchwepheshe / isayensi, ulwazi kanye neluleko kubo ababhalise kanye nezinhlangano ze-Plant Improvement. Ukunika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kanye neluleko kubafaki izicelo mayelana namapheshana emibuzo yobuchwepheshe ahethwe ngokomthetho we-Plant Breeder's Rights Act kanye noMthetho we-Plant Improvement Act. Ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Ukubhala futhi / noma ukunikeza imviko ku-UPOV futhi / noma ukunikeza ku-UPOV futhi / noma oholiko lokuvivinya lukazwelonke. Ukuhlola futhi ukufunda ukushicilelwa kokusayensi, okuhlanganisa ukusesha inthanethi, okuhlobene nezicelo ze-PBR/VL ezitholiwe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emhlabeni jikelele, kumzinga wezifunda nakwezwe ngamazwi aphelele. Ukuxhumana namabhodi esayensi ahlobene nezindaba zobuchwepheshe / isayensi nokushintshiselana ulwazi ngazo. Ukubheka ukuphathwa kwezinto zokuhlanganiswa. Ukubheka ukuphathwa okulungile kwesistimu yokugcwalisa izikhathi namarejista kwezolimo. Ukwenza noma ukuthatha inxaxheba ocwaningweni ohlobene nezimpawu zezinhlamvu noma ukuhlolwa kwesinqe njengoko kufanelekile.

xh.title: Isayensi Yoshicilelo 2
xh.summary: Indima yokushicilela isayensi eStellenbosch efunwa ibe nephondo leBSc okanye iM Tech, ukubhaliswa kwiSACNSP, namava eminyaka emithathu ahambelanayo ukulawula amalungelo okuza nemitshobo yezityalo nokulinganiswa kwenkcubeko.
xh.requirements: Mngeni kufuneka abe negesi yeGrade 12 kunye neBSc (Hon) okanye iM Tech aneBotany, Agronomy, Horticulture, Genetics kwaye / okanye iPlant Biotechnology njengesigaba esikhulu. Ukubhaliswa ngokuyinyaniso kwiSouth African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNSP) njengProfessional Natural Scientist kuyinyaniso. Uluhlu lomsebenzi ohambelanayo nomsebenzi: Ubuncinane leminyaka emithathu (3) emva kwefaneleko kwinkqubo ye-botany, plant taxonomy, plant breeding okanye ulawulo lomthetho ongqinelana neAgriculture. Plant Breeders' Rights Act. Plant Improvement Act. UPOV Convention. Plant Morphology and Physiology. Statistics. Amakhono ahambelanayo nomsebenzi: Amakhono ekhompyutha (MS Office). Amakhono eengxaki, amakhono ekuqxulumana. Ulawulo lwengxaka namakhono ekuqhathamlanisa ngomlomo nangesibini. Amakhono eplani nokumisela. Ulwazi nokuqhuba i apparatus yelaboratory. Amakhono ezibalo, kwindalo yamabala kunye nezibalo. Amakhono okusombululiingxaki zezeentlukwano. Ipesearch, Uniko lwehlobo lokulinganiswa, amakhono okuqhelanisa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo nangokusebenziseka. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa yaye usebenzise iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo, kunye neenkqubo. Kuqinisekise izicelo kunye namajiji obuchwepheshe athunyelwe ngabafaki zigqibo ngokomthetho wePlant Breeding's Rights Act nowePlant Improvement Act. Misela ukuqhelaniswa ngokusebenzisana noMlawuli webosika wesikhosi, isicelo okanye ommyalezini wabo njengoko kufanelekile. Chonga indawo yabo bonke abagqithiswa kunye neentlobo ezinamathatho/ qxhumana nomlawuli webosika ekuchongeni insimu. Qhagamshelana noxhasi kumacala angqinelana nezicelo zabo yaye uhambe kwiindawo. Yenza isohlwayo sobuchwepheshe sezibalo. Qokelela iinkcukacha zabagqithiswa nakwiintlobo ezingagqibekanga ngokwemigaqo echaziweyo. Kuqwalaselwe kwaye kulinganiswa abagqithiswa ngokweInternational Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV) okanye iNational Test guidelines njengoko kufanelekile. Ukuqamba iintlobo nokuqulatha iinkcukacha. Uhlaziyo lweencukacha zabagqithiswa nakwezintlobo ezingagqibekanga. Qulatha iinkcazelo zeentlobo namagwegu eDUS kunye neentlobo zabagqithiswa. Qinisekisa ukuba iintlobo zabagqithiswa zihambisana nemfuno yeDUS echaziweyo ngokomthetho ofanelekileyo. Ulungiselelwa kweencukacha. Nikela ngesixhaso sobuchwepheshe nesigunyaziswa. Qokelela yaye u nikela ngeencukacha / isayensi ezingengomchwepheshe, iinkcukacha nesigunyaziswa kwiRegistrars nakumabandla wePlant Improvement. Nikela ngesixhaso sobuchwepheshe nesigunyaziswa kwabafaki zigqibo kumajiji obuchwepheshe abhaliweyo ngokomthetho wePlant Breeder's Rights Act nowePlant Improvement Act. UPesearondo yophuhliso. Qamba yaye/ okanye nikela nengeniso kwiUPOV yaye/ nikela kwiUPOV yaye/ okanye kumagqibeki wovavyo weqonga. Phinda upheleze kwaye ufunde iipeshayishehanthi zesayensi, kuquka ukukhangela i-intanethi, ezehlukeneyo kwezicelo zePBR/VL ezifunyenweyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwelizwe, kummandla nakumazwe aphaya. Qhagamshelana namabandla ezobuchwepheshe kumacala obuchwepheshe/ esayensi nokutshintshiselwana kolwazi ngako. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweqoqo lesalathiso. Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lenkqubo yokuzalisa kunye namagqwetha ezityalo nembewu. Yenza okanye thatha inxaxheba kuphando olunxulumene neempawu zentlobo okanye uvavayo lwesangqa njengoko kufanelekile.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Compliance Management
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Compliance Management in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma in Compliance, Law or Risk Management plus three years' supervisory experience in compliance.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Compliance Management / Law / Risk Management (NQF 6). Minimum of 3 years’ supervisory experience in compliance management environment. Job related knowledge: knowledge of corporate governance issues, Compliance management, Public service environment, Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) and National Treasury Regulations. Relevant legislation and regulations, norms and standards. Job related skills: Dynamic leadership skills, Computer literacy in Microsoft Office Suite, Project management skills, Communications skills (verbal and written), Presentation and Facilitation skills. Problem solving and analysis. Extended working hours and ability to work under pressure. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Implement a compliance management strategy. Implement compliance management process which includes compliance identification, compliance risk assessment, compliance risk management and reporting. Develop a training strategy and train employees in the Department on compliance awareness. Update the Departmental Compliance universe on an on-going basis. Provide assistance in compiling the annual compliance management implementation plan. Participate in committees that serve as advisory bodies in the area of compliance risk management. Provide assistance in all compliance report coordination and assist in any compliance related information required by Risk and Compliance Committee. Align compliance checklist with strategic and operational plans on an on-going basis. Identify strategic and operational plans of the Department in order to understand the Departmental business for the purpose of identifying regulatory requirements. PUBLIC Conduct compliance assessments in the department according to procedure. Conduct compliance monitoring in accordance with developed compliance monitoring tools and techniques. Communicate best practice methodologies and standards for compliance functionality. Research on what are the best compliance practice methodologies and contribute in improving the Departmental compliance management methodology.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Nakomingsbestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Nakomingsbestuur in Pretoria, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Nakoming, Regte of Risikobestuur plus drie jaar se toesigervaring in nakoming vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma in Nakomingsbestuur / Regte / Risikobestuur (NQF 6). Minimum van 3 jaar se toesigervaring in 'n nakomingsbestuursomgewing. Werksverwante kennis: kennis van korporatiewe bestuursake, Nakomingsbestuur, Openbare diensomgewing, Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) en National Treasury Regulations. Toepaslike wetgewing en regulasies, norme en standaarde. Werksverwante vaardighede: Dinamiese leierskapsvaardighede, Rekenaargeletterdheid in Microsoft Office Suite, Projekbestuursvaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik), Aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Uitgebreide werksure en vermoë om onder druk te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Implementeer 'n nakomingsbestuursstrategie. Implementeer 'n nakomingsbestuursproses wat nakomingsidentifisering, nakomingsrisiko-assessering, nakomingsrisikobestuur en verslagdoening insluit. Ontwikkel 'n opleidingsstrategie en oplei werknemers in die Departement oor nakomingsbewustheid. Dateer die Departementele Nakomingheelpad voortdurend op. Verskaf bystand by die opstel van die jaarlikse nakomingsbestuursimplementeringsplan. Neem deel aan komitees wat as adviserende liggame dien op die gebied van nakomingsrisikobestuur. Verskaf bystand by alle nakomingsverslagkoördinering en help met enige nakomingsverwante inligting wat deur die Risiko- en Nakomingskomitee vereis word. Belyn nakomingskontrolelys met strategiese en operasionele planne op 'n voortdurende basis. Identifiseer strategiese en operasionele planne van die Departement ten einde die Departementele besigheid te verstaan vir die doel van die identifisering van regulasiesvereistes. PUBLIC Voer nakomingsassesserings in die departement uit volgens prosedure. Voer nakomingsmonitering uit in ooreenstemming met ontwikkelde nakomingsmoniteringsinstrumente en -tegnieke. Kommunikeer best-praktykmetodologieë en standaarde vir nakomingsfunksionaliteit. Doen navorsing oor wat die best-praktyk-nakomingsmetodologieë is en dra by tot die verbetering van die Departementele nakomingsbestuursmetodologie.

zu.title: Umncedi: Ukuphatha Ukuhambelana Nemithetho
zu.summary: Umncedi we Director: Compliance Management e Pretoria, ofuna i National Diploma kwi Compliance, Law noma Risk Management kanye neminyaka emithathu yesipiliyoni sokuhola ekulandeleni imithetho.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe nesitifiketi se Grade 12 kanye ne National Diploma ku Compliance Management / Law / Risk Management (NQF 6). Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-3 yokuhola isipiliyoni endaweni yolawula ukulandela imithetho. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: ulwazi ngezinkinga zokuphathwa komanyano, ukulawula ukulandela imithetho, izindawo zomphakathi, i Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) kanye nemithetho ye National Treasury. Umthetho ohlobene nemithethomulo, amagugu nezindinganiso. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuholka angashintshi, Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ku Microsoft Office Suite, Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, Amakhono okuxhumana (okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwe), Amakhono okubonisa nokuqondisa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Amahora okusebenza amade kakhulu nendlela yokusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esevisi.
zu.duties: Qalisa inqubo yolawula ukulandela imithetho. Yenza inqubo yolawula ukulandela imithetho okuhlanganisa ukubona ukulandela imithetho, ukulinganisa ingozi yokungalandeli imithetho, ukuphatha ingozi yokungalandeli imithetho nokubika. Setha inqubo yokuqeqesha futhi uqeqeshe abasebenzi kwi Department ngokwazisa ngokulandela imithetho. Mukha izwe lokulandela imithetho le Department njalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Nikeza usizo ekwakheni icebo lokusetshenziswa kolawula ukulandela imithetho lonyaka. Zibandakanye emakomidi asebenza njengezikhulu zokweluleka endaweni yokuphatha ingozi yokungalandeli imithetho. Nikeza usizo ekubambisaneni zonke izikhubekiso zokulandela imithetho futhi usize nganoma yisiphi ulwazi oluhlobene nokulandela imithetho oludingwa i Risk and Compliance Committee. Lungiselela uhlu lokuqinisekisa ukulandela imithetho nezinhlelo eziyisigungwini nezisebenzayo njalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Hlonza izinhlelo eziyisigungwini nezisebenzayo zomnyango ukuze uqonde umsebenzi we Department ngenjongo yokuhlonza izidingo zemithetho. PUBLIC Yenza izivivinyo zokulandela imithetho kule department ngokuya ngenqubo. Yenza ulwangu lokulandela imithetho ngokuvumelana nezinsiza nezindlela ezakhiwe zokulwanguqula ukulandela imithetho. Yezisa izindlela nezindinganiso ezinhle kakhulu zokusebenza kolawula ukulandela imithetho. Funda ngaleziyizindlela ezinhle kakhulu zokulandela imithetho futhi nikeze ekwenzeni ngcono indlela ye Department yokulawula ukulandela imithetho.

jobs.title: Scientific Technician Prodcution Grade a
jobs.summary: Scientific Technician Production Grade A at the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma in Science and SACNASP registration.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate and National Diploma in Science or relevant qualification. Compulsory registration with South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as a Certified Natural Scientist. Job Related Work Experience: Minimum of 3 years post qualification in the field of botany, horticulture, agronomy, agriculture or conservation of plant genetic resources. Job Related Knowledge: Programme and project management. Scientific methodologies. Research and development. Computer-aided scientific applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Creating high-performance culture. Professional judgment. Data analysis. Mentoring. Job Related Skills: Creativity. Self- management. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer literacy. Networking. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Change management. Problem solving and analysis. Working extended working hours. Handling of hazardous chemicals. Valid Driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement methodologies, policies, systems and procedures relevant to conservation and sustainable use of Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Perform technical scientific functions and tasks that require interpretation in the presence of an established framework. Apply operational standards and consolidate methodologies, policies, systems and procedures. Identify gaps and develop appropriate interventions. Preparation for and participation in research activities. Data collection through field surveys. Maintenance, calibration and operation of scientific equipment. Provide technical support and advise relevant to conservation and sustainable use of Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Develop working relations with client base. Promote public awareness of scientific activities. Provide technical / scientific data, information and advice. Perform technical scientific analysis and regulatory functions relevant to conservation and sustainable use of Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Preparation of data and routine interpretation. Database and data management, Analysis of technical scientific data. Dissemination of information. Apply the appropriate scientific and technical procedures/skills to generate information and knowledge. Formulate proposals and compile reports. Develop and customize operational procedures. Research and Development relevant to conservation and sustainable use of Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Conceptualise and development of scientific equipment. Equipment review. Research/literature studies to improve expertise. Publish and present technical reports and research findings. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on technology-related matters. Human Capital and Development relevant to conservation and sustainable use of Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Mentor, train and develop candidate research technicians and others to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound scientific principles and code of practice. Supervise technical support and processes. Manage the performance management and development of staff.

Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. af.title: Wetenskaplike Tegnikus Produksie Vlak A
af.summary: Wetenskaplike Tegnikus Produksie Vlak A by die Departement van Landbou in Pretoria, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Wetenskap en SACNASP-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma in Wetenskap of relevante kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as 'n Gekertifiseerde Natuurlike Wetenskaplike. Werksverwante Werkervaring: Minimum van 3 jaar na kwalifikasie in die veld van botanie, tuinbou, agronomie, landbou of bewaring van plantgenetiese hulpbronne. Werksverwante Kennis: Program- en projektebestuur. Wetenskaplike metodes. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Kennis van regsgevolgmoeting. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel. Data-analise. Mentorskap. Werksverwante Vaardighede: Kreatiwiteit. Selfbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Netwerkwerk. Menslikebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise. Werk van uitgebreide werksure. Hantering van gevaarlike chemikalieë. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer metodes, beleid, stelsels en prosedures wat relevant is tot bewaring en volhoubare gebruik van Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Voer tegniese wetenskaplike funksies en take uit wat interpretasie in die teenwoordigheid van 'n gevestige raamwerk vereis. Pas operasionele standaarde toe en konsolideer metodes, beleid, stelsels en prosedures. Identifiseer leemtes en ontwikkel toepaslike ingrypings. Voorbereiding vir en deelname aan navorsingsaktiwiteite. Data-insameling deur veldopnames. Onderhoud, kalibrering en bedryf van wetenskaplike toerusting. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies wat relevant is tot bewaring en volhoubare gebruik van Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Ontwikkel werksverhoudings met kliëntbasis. Bevorder publieke bewustheid van wetenskaplike aktiwiteite. Verskaf tegniese/wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies. Voer tegniese wetenskaplike analise en regulatoriese funksies uit wat relevant is tot bewaring en volhoubare gebruik van Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Voorbereiding van data en roetine-interpretasie. Databasis- en databestuur, analise van tegniese wetenskaplike data. Verspreiding van inligting. Pas die toepaslike wetenskaplike en tegniese prosedures/vaardighede toe om inligting en kennis te genereer. Formuleer voorstelle en stel verslae op. Ontwikkel en pas operasionele prosedures aan. Navorsing en Ontwikkeling wat relevant is tot bewaring en volhoubare gebruik van Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Konseptualiseer en ontwikkeling van wetenskaplike toerusting. Toerustingsherbesinning. Navorsing/literatuurstudies om kundigheid te verbeter. Publiseer en bied tegniese verslae en navorsingsbevindings aan. Skakel met relevante liggame/raad oor tegnologie-verwante aangeleenthede. Menslike Kapitaal en Ontwikkeling wat relevant is tot bewaring en volhoubare gebruik van Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Mentor, lei en ontwikkel kandidaatnavorsingstegnici en ander om vaardigheids/kennisoordrag en nakoming van gesonde wetenskaplike beginsels en gedragskode te bevorder. Oorsien tegniese ondersteuning en prosesse. Bestuur die prestasiebestuur en ontwikkeling van personeel.

zu.title: Itheshini Yesayensi Umkhiqizo Izinga A
zu.summary: Itheshini Yesayensi Umkhiqizo Izinga A eDepartment of Agriculture ePretoria, kudingeka i-Diploma Yezwe ezifundweni ezibalulekile kanye nokubhaliswa kwi-SACNASP.
zu.requirements: Umfuni kumele abe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe ezifundweni ezibalulekile noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphoqelele ku-South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengesayensi yasendaweni evunyiwe. Uluvo lokusebenza oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ubumnyama bonyaka we-3 ngemva kokuthola izifundo enkabeni ye-botany, horticulture, agronomy, agriculture noma ukugcina izinsiza ze-genetic zezitshali. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo ohlelakweni nemigqa. Izindlela zocwaningo lwesayensi. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa khompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Isahlulelo sesikhundla. Ukuhlaziya idatha. Ukukhulekela. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukudala. Ukuzilawula. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuqondisisa kanye nokubuyelela kumthengi. Ukuthuthukisana. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa khompyutha. Ukuxhumanisa. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ukuphathwa kwezingxabano. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukusebenza amahora alandiwe. Ukuphathwa kwamakhemikhali ayingozi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe.
zu.duties: Tuthukisa futhi usebenzise izindlela, izinqubomgomo, izimiso kanye nezenzo eziphathelene nokugcina kanye nokusetshenziswa okusimeme kwenzivo ze-Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Setha imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe yesayensi nezenzo ezidinga incazelo ebukhona bakaqondo osemthethweni. Sebenzisa izinga lokusebenza futhi uhlanganise izindlela, izinqubomgomo, izimiso kanye nezenzo. Hlakanipha izikhala futhi tuthukisa izinyathelo ezifanele. Ulungiselelo nokubambelela ezintweni zocwaningo. Ukuqoqa idatha ngocwaningo olwensiwe enkabeni. Ukugcina, ukulungisa futhi ukusebenzisa izinto zesayensi. Nikeza ukusekelwa ngobuchwepheshe kanye neneluleko ephathelene nokugcina kanye nokusetshenziswa okusimeme kwenzivo ze-Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Tuthukisa ubudlelwano bokusebenza nomthethi. Khuthaza ulwazi lwentengiwe mayelana nemisebenzi yesayensi. Nikeza idatha yobuchwepheshe / yesayensi, ulwazi kanye neneluleko. Setha ukuhlaziya ngobuchwepheshe yesayensi kanye nemisebenzi evunyiwe ephathelene nokugcina kanye nokusetshenziswa okusimeme kwenzivo ze-Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Ulungiselelo kwedatha kanye nencazelo evamile. Ukuphathwa kwedathabhesi kanye nedatha, ukuhlaziya idatha yobuchwepheshe yesayensi. Ukusabalalisa ulwazi. Sebenzisa izindlela zesayensi nobuchwepheshe ezifanele ukukhiqiza ulwazi nolwazi. Tuthukisa izinkulumo futhi uqoqe imibalo. Tuthukisa futhi ulungiselele izindlela zomsebenzi. Ucwaningo nentuthuko ephathelene nokugcina kanye nokusetshenziswa okusimeme kwenzivo ze-Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Tuthukisa ngobuchwepheshe okuqhubekayo ukuze ugqame nezobuchwepheshe ezintsha kanye nezenzo. Cabangisa futhi tuthukisa izinto zesayensi. Ukubuyela kabusha kwezinto. Ucwaningo / ukufunda izincwadi ukuthuthukisa obuchwepheshe. Shicilela futhi umbule imibalo yobuchwepheshe kanye neziphumo zocwaningo. Xhumana nabaholi / amakhothi ephathelene nezinto zobuchwepheshe. Imali yabantu nentuthuko ephathelene nokugcina kanye nokusetshenziswa okusimeme kwenzivo ze-Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (PGRFA). Khulekela, qeqesha futhi tuthukisa abacwaningi bababiliobuchwepheshe abanye ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kwekhono/ulwazi kanye nokuhambisana nemitsho yesayensi ephilile kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha. Qaphela ukusekelwa ngobuchwepheshe kanye nezenzo. Phatha ukulawula ukusebenza kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi.

xh.title: Isikhululi seSayensi sokwenziwa inqanaba A
xh.summary: Isikhululi seSayense sokwenziwa inqanaba A kwisebe leZolimo ePretoria, lifuna iDiploma yesiZwe kwiSayence nokuqatshelwa kwiSACNASP.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka omnye unamangqina weGrade 12 kwaye aneDiploma yesiZwe kwiSayence okanye nembeko ephanayo. Ukuqatshelwa ngokuyimfuno kwiSouth African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengengcali yeSayense yeNdalo egqityiweyo. Imisebenzi ehambelana nendima ngamava: Uphawu lweminyaka emi-3 ngaphambi kokuba egqibe izifundo kwicala lezityalo, izityalo ezilinywayo, ulutsha lwezityalo, ulimo, okanye ukugcinwa kwezixhobo zelifa lezityalo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nendima: ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Iindlela zokusetyenziswa kwezayense. Uphando nophuhliso. Izicelo zesayense ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuthobela imithetho. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukudala inkqubo yenkonzo ephakamileyo. Isiphatho esikwazobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlaziya idatha. Ukulungisa abanye. Amandla ahambelana nendima: Ukudala. Ukuzilawula. Ukulawula imali. Ukunaka abathengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Uqhagamshelwano. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ukuqamba nokuqamba. Ulawulo lwezingxoxo ezindabanisiweyo. Ulawulo lotshintsho. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlaziya. Ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo. Ukupatha iikhemikhali ezinobungozi. ilayiseni evumelekileyo yokushayela.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa kwaye usebenzise iindlela, iinkqubo, izixhobo kunye nemigaqo ehambelana nokugcinwa nokusetyenziswa ngokungachibi kwesixhobo zelifa lezityalo zeZokolore nolimo (PGRFA). Zenza imisebenzi yesayense yobuchwepheshe nemisebenzi efuna inkcuba yamagama ekhona kuluntu oluqhelanayo. Sebenzisa iinqobo zokuqhuba kwaye uqhube iindlela, iinkqubo, izixhobo kunye nemigaqo. Chonga iindawo ezingazange ziqwalaselwe kwaye uphuhlise iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuhalakaza. Kulungiselelo kwaye ungene kumisebenzi wophando. Ukuqokelela idatha ngophando lwemihla lezinkalo. Ukugcina, ukulinganisa nokusebenzisa izixhobo zesayense. Nikela ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwaye unikezelwe ngengcebiso ehambelana nogcino nokusetyenziswa ngokungachibi kwesixhobo zelifa lezityalo zeZokolore nolimo (PGRFA). Phuhlisa ubudlelwane bokusebenza nomthengi. Khuthaza ulwazi lwentengiso ngemisebenzi yesayense. Nikela ngedatha yobuchwepheshe/isayense, iinkcazelo kunye nengcebiso. Zenza uhlaziyo oluchanekileyo lwezayense yobuchwepheshe nemisebenzi elawulayo ehambelana nogcino nokusetyenziswa ngokungachibi kwesixhobo zelifa lezityalo zeZokolore nolimo (PGRFA). Ulungiselelo lwedatha nokuqonda okujwayelekileyo. Ulawulo lwesiseko sedatha nolawulo lwedatha, uhlaziyo lwedatha yobuchwepheshe yesayense. Ukwabelana nolwazi. Sebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo zesayense yobuchwepheshe ukwenza iinkcazelo nolwazi. Yila iinkqubo kwaye uqokelele iingxelo. Phuhlisa kwaye ulungise iindlela zokuqhuba. Uphando nophuhliso ehambelana nogcino nokusetyenziswa ngokungachibi kwesixhobo zelifa lezityalo zeZokolore nolimo (PGRFA). Uphuhliso obuqhelanayo lobugcisa ukuze wagqibezele kwiiteknoloji namaphakamiswa amatsha. Yila kwaye uphuhlise izixhobo zesayense. Ukuhlola izixhobo. Uphando/ifundo yemibhalo ukuphucula ubugcisa. Shicilela kwaye mbonelele iingxelo zobuchwepheshe nemitimbo yophando. Qhagamshelana namabakhusi/amabhunga afanelekileyo malunga neendaba zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lwabantu nophuhliso ehambelana nogcino nokusetyenziswa ngokungachibi kwesixhobo zelifa lezityalo zeZokolore nolimo (PGRFA). Lungisa, qeqesha kwaye uphuhlise ophando abangagqityanga abayiingcali zobugcisa bophando kwaye abanye ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kolwazi nokuzigcina kwiinkqubo ezilunge zesayense nokuqonda amagama. Lawula inkxaso yobuchwepheshe nokuqhuba. Lawula ulawulo lwenkonzo nokuphuculwa kwabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Permit Processing
jobs.closing_date_text: 04 September 2026 at 16h00, (Applications received after the closing date and faxed copies will not be considered).
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Permit Processing at the Department of Defence in Pretoria, managing conventional arms permit applications, requiring a law or public administration degree and three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) or equivalent with a recognised Bachelor’s Degree / Advanced Diploma in Law, Public Management, Public Administration or any relevant qualification at NQF Level 7. A minimum of three (3) years relevant experience as an Assistant Director within Arms Control or Administration. Special requirements (skills needed): Communication skills (Verbal and written communication), Leadership, Problem Solving Skills, Computer Skills, Management Skills, Policy Analysis and Programming. Personal attributes: Honesty, Integrity, Hard Working, Firm, Fair, High Ethical Standards, Personal Drive and Good interpersonal relations Knowledge of Government Policies, Operational Management. Public Finance Legislation, Extensive knowledge on National Conventional Arms Control, Understanding of the Defence Industry and Arms Control Practices.
jobs.duties: Successful candidate will be responsible to manage the Processing of Permits applications for the movement of Conventional Arms through specific authorisations and perform the following key functions: Administer the processing of various permits (marketing, contracting, export, import and dual use goods and services) applications according to legislative prescripts, Administer company registration, Administer End-User Certificates on behalf of the South African Government, Management of IT system functionality, Management of Resources sub-directorate.
jobs.applications: Department of Defence, Defence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division, Directorate Conventional Arms Control, Private Bag X161, Pretoria, 0001, may be hand delivered during office hours to: Department of Defence, Armscor Building, cnr of Nossob and Boeing Street, Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, 0001 or email to Phumelele.Gabuza@dod.mil.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed form Z83 (obtainable from any Public Service Department office i.e effective 01 January 2021 or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/. Should an application be received using incorrect application employment form Z83, it will be disqualified, which must be originally signed and dated by the applicant and which must be accompanied by a detailed CV only (with full particulars of the applicants’ training, qualifications, competencies, knowledge & experience). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview which should not be older than six months. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in applications being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one post must submit a separate form Z83 (as well as the documentation mentioned above) in respect of each post being applied for. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. Should an application be received where an applicant applies for more than one post on the same applications form, the application will only be considered for the first post indicated on the application and not for any of the other posts. Under no circumstances will photostat copies or faxed copies of application documents be accepted. The successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks and qualification and employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. The level of appointments is dependent upon, qualifications, relevant experience and research output. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preference, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The competency assessment will be limited to successful candidates in the interview process only. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability checks (pre-employment screening) which may include social media profiles checks. A successful candidate will have to undergo a full security vetting while in the employ of the department and negative outcome shall nullify employment contract. Failure to submit the required documents will result in your application not being considered. Successful candidates will be required to disclose their financial interests within one (1) month of appointment. Applicants who do not receive confirmation or feedback within 3 (three) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Due to the large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. For more information on the job description(s) please contact the person indicated in the post details. Successful candidates will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) months in terms of the prescribed rules. OTHER POSTS

xh.summary: Isebe lePhulo: Ukucutshwa kweeMvume kwiSebe lezoTyolo-mbeleko ePretoria, kulawulo kweenkqubo zomcelo-mvume wezikhali zendalo zomkhosi, kufuneka kubekho izinto afunekayo ezingowezemvisi okanye zoburhalwe zenkunzi-mbuso kwaye unamava eminyaka emithathu.

zu.title: ILungu Lekomidi Elibheka Izindleko Zengozi
zu.summary: UMnyango WezokuVikela ufuna ILungu Lekomidi Elibheka Izindleko Zengozi ukuze linike izeluleko ezindabeni zokuphathwa kwezindleko zengozi ezingeni lenhlangano, libe ngasese ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Uphawu oluncane lweGrade 12 (NQF Level 4) noma okulingana nalo olunodiploma ezinga eliphezulu/ i-degree yesiqu eliqashiwe kokuCongo Izindleko Zengozi / uBuchwepheshe bokubala / uKuHlolwa kwezimali / ukuPhathwa kwezeMali noma iziqu ezihambisanayo ezingeni le-(NQF Level 7). Iziqu ezingaphezulu kwezabafundi beziqu ezingenza umuntu aphumelele. Abagqaji abafunekayo kufanele babe nomlando weminyaka engaphezu kwe-(10) wokuba ngabaphathi besiqu esikhundleni sokuba ngamakhono ekuPhathweni kwezindleko Zengozi, ukuHlelwa kokuHleleka, ukuHlolwa ngaphakathi nangaphandle, ukuVikela nokuxotsha ukukhwabanisa, ukuLawulwa kokuhambisana kanye nokuPhathwa kokuQhubekayo kwebhizinisi. Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe namava wokuqhuba nasezikomidi eziyahlulela izinto, njengekomidi elibheka Izindleko Zengozi kanye noma nekomidi eHlola izimali, ikakhulukazi ekuPhathweni kwezempulelo sizwe, kuzoba yinzuzo. Abagqaji kufanele babengamalungu esiqu esiphathwa ngokugqamile ngokomthetho wezinkampani ukuze bakhethwe njengamalungu ekomidi elibheka Izindleko Zengozi ezingeni lomuntu osebenzayo (CRM PRAC/) / umuntu ongamapheshana ekuPhathweni kwezindleko Zengozi (CRM PROF). Izidingo ezikhethekile (amakhono adingekayo): izinga eliphezulu lobuqotho, ukuzimela, ukuqondeka, ukubuzimbuza kanye nokuqonda ibhizinisi loluntu kanye nokulawulwa kwalo. Ukuqonda okuhle kokuPhathwa kwezindleko Zengozi, ukuHleleka kwezimiso zokuholwa ngobuNengamuni, uMthetho wokuLawulwa kweMali yokuLuntu kanye neziqu zaseNqola yezimali, imodeli ye-(COSO) kanye nokuHlelwa kohlelo lokuPhathwa kwezindleko Zengozi ekuPhathweni kwezempulelo sizwe.
zu.duties: Sebenza ngokuvumelana nesibekiweko sokubheka izindleko Zengozi ekuPhathweni kokuHleleka kokuQondiswa kweDOD. Nikeza izeluleko ongumlawuli kanye nabaphathi ezindabeni zokuphathwa kwezindleko zengozi ezingeni lenhlangano. Phinda ubheke futhi ulawule ukuSETSHENZWA kwesinqumosethu sokuphathwa kwezindleko zengozi, isu kanye nendlela yokwenza ngonyaka iNqubo yokuPhathwa kwezindleko zengozi kuDOD. Nikela izeluleko ngokuhlanganiswa kokuPhathwa kwezindleko zengozi kwindlela ekuqondiswa ngayo iqhaza, ekuhlelweni, ekuqondisweni nasekuvezeni izinto. Nikeza iziqondiso nezeluleko ngendlela ekuhlelwa ngayo ukubonwa nokuhlola izindleko zengozi komnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzaliseka kanye nokuqondo kwejilamba lezindleko zengozi. Nikeza iziqondiso ngokusethwa kwejilamba lokuzifela izindleko zengozi iNqubo yokuPhathwa kweDOD kuhlanganise izinga lokubekezela kulo lonke umnyango. Bheka ngaphezulu ukuSetshenziswa kwendlela ekuqinisekiswa ngayo izindleko. Ukuhlangana njalo kanye nokuhlanganisa izinto nekomidi eHlola izimali. Yiba ngusihlalo wekomidi elibheka Izindleko Zengozi ekuQondisweni kweqhaza esikhundleni somuntu oqondisa.

Amagosa kufuneka abe lilungu leshishini elivunyiweyo lolugqatso ngolwazi lokwenzwa njengelungu leKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko kwinqanaba le-Practitioner (CRM PRAC/) / Certified Risk Management Professional (CRM PROF). jobs.title: Director: Management Accounting
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.closing_date_text: 07 September 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Director position leading the Management Accounting Directorate in Pretoria, overseeing financial planning, budgeting and PFMA compliance for the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF7) in Financial Management or relevant qualification within the related field as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at middle/senior management level in management accounting, budgeting or public sector financial management. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by PUBLIC the National School of Government (NSG) must be submitted prior to appointment. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) 1999 (Act No. 1 of 1999), as amended; Treasury Regulations and National Treasury Instructions; Public Service Act, 1994 and Public Service Regulations, 2016; Government planning and budgeting framework; Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) and Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE); Modified Cash Standard and financial reporting framework; Public sector budgeting, expenditure management and financial governance; risk management and internal control; corporate governance principles and audit processes;. Skills: Strategic leadership and management; financial management and management accounting; budget formulation and expenditure management; financial analysis, forecasting and reporting; strategic planning and policy implementation; project and programme implementation; problem solving and analytical thinking; people management and empowerment; communication (written and verbal); presentation and report writing skills; stakeholder engagement, negotiation and influencing skills; computer literacy, particular MS Excel and financial management systems.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and manage the Management Accounting Directorate. Manage the Financial Planning, Budget and Reporting in compliance with PFMA requirements (i.e MTEF, ENE, AENE and Annual budget process. Manage the development and maintenance of accounting, reporting policies, strategies and procedures. Coordinate budget allocations, review, analyse and monitor budget implementations across all programmes. Monitor expenditure, analyse spending trends and recommend corrective interventions where necessary. Coordinate in-year expenditure monitoring, financial forecasting and cash flow management. Prepare and present monthly, quarterly and annual management accounting reports for executive management and oversight structures. Ensure facilitation of Public Entities reporting requirements including providing strategic oversight and financial governance over Transfers and Subsidies budgets, planning, expenditure monitoring, financial reporting and compliance with applicable National Treasury frameworks. Provide strategic financial support for donor-funded and conditional grant-funded programmes where applicable. Provide strategic financial advice and management accounting support to departmental programmes, including environmental and EPWP initiatives. Develop and maintain management accounting policies, frameworks and standard operating procedures. Ensure compliance with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, National Treasury Instructions, Modified Cash Standard and other applicable legislation. Coordinate response to internal and external audit findings relating to management accounting. Identify and manage financial risks and strengthen internal financial controls. Manage the Directorate’s human, financial and physical resources to ensure efficient service delivery.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme.               All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF7) in Finansiële Bestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos erken deur SAQA.
