MTEF, ENE, AENE en die jaarlikse begrotingsproses). Bestuur die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van rekeningkundige en verslagdoeningsbeleid, -strategieë en -prosedures. Koördineer begrotingstoekenings, hersien, analiseer en monitor begrotingsimplementering oor alle programme. Monitor besteding, analiseer bestedingsneigings en beveel korrigerende ingrypings aan waar nodig. Koördineer in-jaar bestedingsmonitering, finansiële vooruitskattings en kontantvloei-bestuur. Berei voor en bied maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse bestuursrekeningkundige verslae vir uitvoerende bestuur en toesigstrukture voor. Verseker fasilitering van verslagdoeningsvereistes vir Publieke Entiteite, insluitend die verskaffing van strategiese toesig en finansiële bestuursbeheer oor Oordragte en Subsidies-begrotings, beplanning, bestedingsmonitering, finansiële verslagdoening en nakoming van toepaslike Nasioniale Tesourie-raamwerke. Verskaf strategiese finansiële steun vir skenkergefinansierde en voorwaardelike toelaag-gefinansierde programme waar van toepassing. Verskaf strategiese finansiële advies en bestuursrekeningkundige steun aan departementele programme, insluitend omgewings- en EPWP-inisiatiewe. Ontwikkel en handhaaf bestuursrekeningkundige beleid, raamwerke en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Verseker nakoming van die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, Nasionale Tesourie-instruksies, Modified Cash Standard en ander toepaslike wetgewing. Koördineer reaksie op interne en eksterne ouditbevindings rakende bestuursrekeningkunde. Identifiseer en bestuur finansiële risiko's en versterk interne finansiële beheer. Bestuur die Direktoraat se menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne om doeltreffende dienslewering te verseker.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ubunikazi BesiZulu Bobulungu
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi sokuhola i-Management Accounting Directorate ePretoria,okuqapha icebo lokuhlela kwezimali,okwesabelo nokuhambisana ne-PFMA kwi-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu eziphakeme (NQF7) kwi-Financial Management noma iziqu ezihlobene nakule minxuluwe njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze kube okuncane iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yohlelo lwenkokeli ezingeni eliphakathi/phezulu kubunikazi besimali esesigabeni sokuphatha,okwesabelo noma ukuphathwa kwezimali kwinkundla kahulumeni. Ukuqedwa ngemvume kwe-Senior Management Pre-entry Programme njengokuqinisekiswe yi-National School of Government (NSG) okumele kuthunyelwe ngaphambi kokwamukelwa. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) 1999 (Act No. 1 of 1999), njengoba lulungisiwe; Izindlela ze-Treasury kanye Nemiyalo ye-National Treasury; I-Public Service Act, 1994 kanye Nemithetho ye-Public Service, 2016; Isakhiwo sohlelo kanye nokwesabelo kahulumeni; I-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), I-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) kanye ne-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE); I-Modified Cash Standard nesakhiwo sobiko lwezimali; Ukwesabelo kwinkundla kahulumeni, okuphathwa kokuchitha kanye nobulungu bezimali; ukuphathwa kweingozi nokulawula ngaphakathi; imigomo yobulungu benkampani kanye nezenzo zokuqoqa;. Amakhono: Inkokeli ebuso kanye nokuphatha; ukuphathwa kwezimali nobunikazi besimali esesigabeni sokuphatha; ukwakheka kwesabelo nokuphathwa kokuchitha; ukuhlazulula izimali, ukubikezela nokwenza imibiko; ukuhlela kwesibhakabhaka kanye nokusebenzisa imigomo; ukusebenzisa amaphrojekthi kanye namaqhube; ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda ukucabanga; ukuphatha abantu kanye nokuqinisekisa; ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuqhubekayo); ukwethula amabiko nokuqamba amabiko; ukuxhumana nabantu abathintekayo, ukuxhumana nokuwusizo ekusebenziseni abanye; ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ikakhulu i-MS Excel nakwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezimali.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo ebuso futhi uphathe i-Management Accounting Directorate. Phatha ukuhlela kwezimali, okwesabelo nokubika ngokuhambisana nezidingo ze-PFMA (okungukuthi MTEF, ENE, AENE nendlela yesabelo sonyaka. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kanye nogcinwo kwemigomo yobunikazi, ubiko lwemigomo, amasu kanye nezindlela. Hlanganisa okwesabelo, futhi uhlaze futhi uphawule ukusetshenziswa kwesabelo kuyo yonke imiqulu. Qaphela ukuchitheka, uhlaze ukuthambeka kokuchitha futhi uphakamise izindlela zokulungisa lapho kunesidingo. Hlanganisa ukuphathwa kwesabelo sonyaka, ukubikezela izimali nokuphathwa kokuhamba kwemali. Lungele futhi usho imibiko yobunikazi yesimali esesigabeni yokuphatha ngenyanga, kota kanye nenyanga ukuze kutholakale ukuphathwa nokuqapha izakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kwezidingo zokubika kwamagugu kahulumeni, okuhlanganisa nokunika ukuqapha okubusile kanye nobulungu bezimali kumasabelo we-Transfers and Subsidies, okuhleliwe, ukuphathwa kokuchitheka, ukubika kwamagugu kanye nokuhambisana nezakhiwo ezifanele ze-National Treasury. Nikeza ukusekela ukwenza izinkomba kumabhaliwe kumabhaliwe kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwamabhaliwe kumabhaliwe ahlinzeka ngayo. Nikeza usizo olubusile kakhulu kwemali futhi uphathe ukusekela izinhlelo, okuhlanganisa imigomo yokusingatha kwezehlabathi nezehlabathi.uthuthukisa futhi wagcina imigomo yokuphathwa kwesimali, izakhiwo kanye nezindlela ezingagcina ukusebenza ngokomthetho. Qinisekisa ukubambelela kumthetho we-PFMA, Izindlela ze-Treasury, Izimiso ze-National Treasury, I-Modified Cash Standard kanye nomthetho ongafanele. Lunganisa impendulo kubiko lwangaphakathi nangaphandle ngezenzo ezihlobene nobunikazi bezimali. Qaphela kanye ukuphatha ubungozi bezimali futhi uqinise ukulawula izimali ezingaphakathi. Phatha izibamazisi ngokwabantu, okwezimali kanye nendawo zokuzuzise ukuze kutholwe ukweseka okubusile.

xh.title: Umphathi: uLawulo oluBalwa ngemali
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMphathi sokuzisa iDirectorate ye-Management Accounting ePretoria, ukugqamisa iNkqubo yokuCwangcisa iMali, ukwabiwa kwemali nokuthobela i-PFMA kwiSebe leForestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphantsi kwe-NQF7 kwilunga leMali okanye iziqu ezinxulumene nendawo ekuyigqibele kuzo njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka esingaphantsi kweyisihlanu (5) yamava phantsi kwenqanaba lolawulo oluphakathi noluphezulu kubalwa iindleko, ngemali okanye ukulawula imali ngaphantsi koluntu. Ukugqiba ngempumelelo i-Senior Management Pre-entry Programme njengoko igunyazwe ngurhululelo weSikolo seSizwe (NSG) kufuneka inikwe ngaphantsi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA) wowe-1999 (Act No. 1 of 1999), ungasukwemithetho; iTreasury Regulations ne-National Treasury Instructions; i-Public Service Act, 1994 ne-Public Service Regulations, 2016; urhululelo lwengcali nokuphuhliswa kwemali; i-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), i-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) ne-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE); i-Modified Cash Standard nengxoxo yokubika ngezimali; ukubeka imali ngaphantsi, ukugcina iindleko nokulawula imali; ukugcina iingozi nolawulo ngaphantsi koluntu; izimvo-mbono yolawulo lwengcali nendlela zokuphonononga; Amapolisa: Inkululelo phantsi kommandments; ukulawula imali kwaye ukubala iindleko; ukuphuhliswa kwemali kunye nokugcinwa kwezindleko; ukuhlalutya imali, ukubetha iThemba nokubika; ukulungiselela amacebo ngokobuchule nokusebenzisa iimali; ukuphuhliswa kwaye ukusebenza ngokubambezele; ukusombulula iingxaki nokucinga ngokobuchule; ukulawula abantu ukubakhuthaza ukuzimela; ukuthetha nokubhala; ukubonisa ngokubhala iingxelo; ukuzibandakanya neentsapho, ukuxoxisana nokuguqula iimvo-mbono; ukusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha, ngethe ngqo i-MS Excel nezinkqubo zokulawula imali.
xh.duties: Nika inkulelelo ekuqaleni kwaye ulawule iDirectorate ye-Management Accounting. Lawula ukuLungelelana kweziMali, uMthethwana weNgcaciso nemisebenzi ngokuthobela iimfuno ze-PFMA (okukunje u-MTEF, i-ENE, i-AENE nenkqubo yemali yonyaka. Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokugcinwa kweendlela zokubala, iinkqubo zokuxela, iindlela zokuqhuba neenkqubo. Hlela ngokubambisana ukwabiwa kwemali, ukuphonononga, ukuhlalutya nokugcina ukusetyenziswa kwemali kuzo zonke iinkqubo. Gqamisa iindleko, hlalutya iindlela zokusebenzisa imali uze uze neengcebiso zokulungisa apho kufuneka khona. Hlela ngokubambisana ukugqamisa iindleko phakathi konyaka, ukubika ngemali ngokubetha iThemba kunye nolawulo lwemali. Lungisa uze uziveze iingxelo zokubala ngezinyanga, ngekhatheli ngamnye nak ngamnye zolawulo oluphezulu nezakwoziguqo. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kolwazi lwezingxoxo malunga neemfuno zokubika kwamanyathelo okurhulisa, kuquka nokuqinisekisa ulawulo oluphezulu ngemali nokurhulisa iNgxowa mali yeTransfers neSubsidies, ukuqamba, ukugqamisa iindleko, ukubika ngemali nokuthobela iinkqubo ze-National Treasury. Nika inkxaso-mali ekuqaleni kwimisebenzi exhaswa ngemali ye-donor nengemali abanikwa ngemigwetho naxa kubakho isidingo. Nika izigqibo-mali ekuqaleni kwamacebo abanceda iinkqubo, kuquka imigangatho yohlu kolwazi nemebo za-EPWP. Yila uze ulawule iindlela zokubala, oonqwenba kunye nemisebenzi elungiselelwe ukuba isebenze. Qinisekisa ukuthobela i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations, iNational Treasury Instructions, iModified Cash Standard nalomnye umthetho osebenzayo. Hlela ngokubambisana impendulo kwezinto zokuqondiswa ezingaphakathi nangaphandle eziquka ukubala iindleko. Chonga uze ulawule iingozi zemali uze uqinisekise ukulawula ngenkqubo iimali ezisingathweni. Lawula abantu, imali nento zedirectorate ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho inkonzo ephilayo.

jobs.title: Director: Media Relations
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 07 September 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Lead media relations and inter-governmental communications to manage the department's reputation, overseeing media liaison, briefings and interviews in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF7) in Communication or relevant qualification within the related field as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at a middle / senior managerial level in the related field. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) must be submitted prior to appointment. Extensive knowledge of media. Good understanding of communication. Strategic capability and leadership; people management and empowerment. Knowledge of public relations. Ability to develop and apply policies. Understanding of media liaison and monitoring. Ability to conduct online research. Project management and financial management (PFMA and Treasury regulations). Ability to lead a multidisciplinary team. Strategic planning management. Good coordination and stakeholder liaison. Sound research, analytical, organising, planning and presentation skills. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written). Sense of responsibility and loyalty. Ability to work long hours.
jobs.duties: Manage media relations and inter-governmental communications functions aimed at proactively managing the reputation of the department and the Ministry in the media. Manage media liaison functions. Manage media briefings PUBLIC information sessions and interviews with the media. Manage the drafting and issuing of media invitations and statements. Manage the media monitoring and analysis function. Manage legislative communication programme from a media perspective. Manage media research and speech writing. Manage the drafting and publishing of opinion pieces for the department. Manage the development and implementation of media strategies and implementation plans for the department. Manage support to Ministry and the Department. Manage effective and efficient media support to Ministry. Manage the drafting of forewords for Ministry and the departmental reports. Manage the facilitation of media training workshops for departmental officials. Manage the implementation of intergovernmental communication programme. Manage Intergovernmental Relation. Participate in GCIS/GCF and other intergovernmental fora. Manage the Working Group 11 on communication. Ensure good relations with the communicators from Entities and provincial Departments.
jobs.enquiries: Dr N Mashiyi Tel No: (012) 399 9484 OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme.               All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Mediaverhoudinge
af.summary: Bestuur mediaverhoudings en intergoewermentele kommunikasie om die departement se reputasie te bestuur, met toesig oor medialiaison, briefings en onderhoude in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF7) in Kommunikasie of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- / seniorbestuursvlak in die verwante veld. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Senior Management Pre-entry Programme soos onderskryf deur die National School of Government (NSG) moet voor aanstelling ingedien word. Uitgebreide kennis van die media. Goeie begrip van kommunikasie. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Kennis van openbare betrekkinge. Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas. Begrip van medialiaison en -bewaking. Vermoë om aanlynnavorsing te doen. Projektebestuur en finansiële bestuur (PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies). Vermoë om 'n multidissiplinêre span te lei. Strategiese beplanningsbestuur. Goeie koördinering en belanghebbende-liaison. Deeglike navorsings-, analitiese, organiserings-, beplannings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Sin van verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit. Vermoë om lang ure te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur mediaverhoudings en intergoewermentele kommunikasiefunksies wat daarop gemik is om proaktief die reputasie van die departement en die Ministerie in die media te bestuur. Bestuur medialiaisonfunksies. Bestuur mediabrigings, openbare inligtingsessies en onderhoude met die media. Bestuur die opstel en uitreik van mediablokkies en verklarings. Bestuur die mediabewakings- en analisefunksie. Bestuur wetgewende kommunikasieprogram vanuit 'n mediaperspektief. Bestuur media-navorsing en skryf van toesprake. Bestuur die opstel en publisering van meningsstukke vir die departement. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van mediastrategieë en implementeringsplanne vir die departement. Bestuur steun aan die Ministerie en die Departement. Bestuur doeltreffende en effektiewe mediasteun aan die Ministerie. Bestuur die skryf van voorwoorde vir die Ministerie en departementele verslae. Bestuur die fasilitering van mediatrainingwerkswinkels vir departementele amptenare. Bestuur die implementering van die intergoewermentele kommunikasieprogram. Bestuur intergoewermentele betrekkinge. Neem deel aan GCIS/GCF en ander intergoewermentele forums. Bestuur die Werkgroep 11 oor kommunikasie. Verseker goeie betrekkinge met die kommunikeerders van Entiteite en provinsiale Departemente.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ubudlelwano Bezindaba
zu.summary: Qondisa ubudlelwano nezindaba nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlangano zikahulumane ngenhloso yokuphatha ukuzwakala komnyango, ngokuqapha uxhumano nezindaba, izinkulumo-mpendulo namaxhoxho e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhathi esingaphansi kwezinga le-NQF7 ku-Communication noma iziqu ezihambisanana nasemkhakheni ohlobene njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani isipiliyoni seminyaka emihlanu (5) ezingeni lokuphatha eliphakathi noma eliphezulu emkhakheni ohlobene. Ukuphothula ngokuphumelele i-Senior Management Pre-entry Programme njengoba kuqashiwe i-National School of Government (NSG) kumele kunikezwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ukuqonda okujulile ezindabeni. Ukuqonda kahle ukuxhumana. Ikhono lokubeka amasu nokuqondisa; ukuphatha abantu nokuqinisa amandla abo. Ulwazi ngobudlelwano nomphakathi. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa futhi kusetshenziswe izinqubomgomo. Ukuqonda ukuxhumana nezindaba nokuzilalela. Ikhono lokwenza ucwaningo ku-inthanethi. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi nezimali (PFMA kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury). Ikhono lokuqondisa iqembu elihlangene izindlela ezahlukene. Ukuphatha ukuhlela amasu. Ukuhleleka okuhle nobudlelwano nabahlanganyeli. Izindlela zokucwaninga, ukuhlaziya, ukuhlela, ukubeka amasu namakhono abakhombisa kahle. Amakhono okuxhumana aphezulu (afakwe emlonyeni nawabhalwayo). Inzwelo ebambekayo nokuqina. Ikhono lokusebenza isikhathi eside.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yobudlelwano nezindaba nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlanganoma zikahulumane ngezinjongo zokuphatha ngokubambisana ukuzwakala komnyango kanye noMnyango ezindabeni. Phatha imisebenzi yokuxhumana nezindaba. Phatha izinkulumo-mpendulo zolwazi lomphakathi nokuthi kubuzwe kwezindaba. Phatha ukubhala nokusabalalisa izimemo nezinkulumo ezindabeni. Phatha umsebenzi wokulalela nokuhlaziya izindaba. Phatha uhlelo lokuxhumana ngemithetho esuka ekuhleni lwezindaba. Phatha ucwaningo ezindabeni nokubhala izinkulumo. Phatha ukubhala nokushicilela umbhalo wezinkulumo-zimiso wamnyango. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusebenza kwezindlela nezinhlelo zokusebenza kwezindaba kumnyango. Phatha ukwesekwa koMnyango kanye noMnyango. Phatha ukwesekwa ngokusebenziseka nangokusebenza kahle ezindabeni kuMnyango. Phatha ukubhala kwezinkulumo zokuqalisa kuMnyango nakumabhikimba omnyango. Phatha ukuhlela izikhashana zokuqeqeshezwa ezindabeni kubasebenzi bomnyango. Phatha ukusebenza kohlelo lokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlangano zikahulumane. Phatha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlangano zikahulumane. Ngenyakato kwi-GCIS/GCF namanye amaphoyindi okuxhumana phakathi kwamahulumene. Phatha i-Working Group 11 mayelana nokuxhumana. Qinisekisa ubudlelwano obuhle nabaxhumi ezinhlanganweni namaphondo eMinyango.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ukunxibelelaniswa Nedolophu ezingamasishwakathwa
xh.summary: Mbakala ukunxibelelaniswa nedolophu ezingamasishwakathwa nakunxibelelaniswa phakathi kolawulo koluntu ukulawula igama elihle lesebe, ukulawula ukunxibelelaniswa nedolophu, iinkcazelo kunye namava ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isifundo se-undergraduate (NQF7) kwiNkundlwaniso noma isifundo esithinteleleyo kummandla onxulumene nayo njengokuqatwa yi-SAQA. Amava angaphaya kweminyaka emihlanu (5) ngowona mongamandi ophakathi / ophakamileyo kummandla onxulumene nayo. Ukuqedela ngempumelelo iNkqubo yokuqaliswa kwabaninngamandi abaphezulu njengokuqinisekiswa yiZiko leZiko leRhulumente (NSG) makhanjiswa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. ulwazi olubanzi ngamadolophu ezingamasishwakathwa. Ukuqonda okuhle ngonxibelelwano. Amandla okuqukelela iindaba nokuba ngumceli-mboleko; ulawulo lwabantu namandla abo. ulwazi ngokuziphatha koluntu. Amandla okwenza nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zomthetho. Ukuqonda ukunxibelelaniswa nokulandela kwadola phu ezingamasishwakathwa. Amandla okwenza uphando kwakhompyutha. Ulawulo lweenkqubo lolawulo lweemali (PFMA namagqabantshintshi eTreasury). Amandla okuba ngumceli-mboleko wethimba elineziqu ezininzi. Ulawulo lokuqukelela iindaba ngenkqubo. Ulawulwa okuhle nonxibelelwano nabathintekayo. Amandla okuphanda, ukuhlaziya, ukuqamba, iindlela zokulawula nokubonisa. Amandla mahle onxibelelwano (olwandle nolubhaliweyo). Inkcazelo yomdaniso noku qinisekisa. Amandla okusebenza iiyure ezininzi.
xh.duties: Lulawule ukunxibelelaniswa nedolophu ezingamasishwakathwa nakunxibelelaniswa phakathi kolawulo koluntu ngenjongo yokulawula ngokuziqhelanisa igama elihle lesebe neliye Nkundla yeeze mith yoluntu kumadola phu ezingamasishwakathwa. Lulawule imisebenzi yokunxibelelaniswa nedolophu ezingamasishwakathwa. Lulawule iinkcazelo kumadola phu ezingamasishwakathwa, iiseshoni zenkcazelo yoluntu nengxoxo namadola phu ezingamasishwakathwa. Lulawule ukubhala nokupapa izimemo kunye namagama ebali kwadola phu ezingamasishwakathwa. Lulawule ukulandela nokwahlula-hlula amadola phu ezingamasishwakathwa. Lulawule inkqubo yokunxibelelanisa ngomthetho ukusuka kumbhalo wadola phu ezingamasishwakathwa. Lulawule uphando kwadola phu ezingamasishwakathwa nokubhala iinkulumo. jobs.title: Deputy Director: Administration and Coordination Support

jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in Pretoria providing administration and coordination support, managing branch budgets, procurement and strategic reporting for the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.

Five (5) years’ experience in administration or relevant field of which three (3) years should be at an entry/junior managerial level (Assistant Director level or equivalent). Knowledge of strategic coordination and planning and professional report writing. Understanding of Project management. Risk management and business planning. Knowledge of policy development and organization performance management. Good understanding of administrative procedures and quality control of documents. Skills required: Planning, Organizing, Facilitation, Communication and technical writing skills. Advance office application such as Ms Package. Proactive approach to meeting deadlines and delivering results with limited supervision. Sense of responsibility and loyalty.

Liaise and develop relationship within internal and external stakeholder. Develop stakeholder database. Ensure the preparation of stakeholder communications material, including presentations, documents, profiles etc.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Administratiewe en Koördineringsondersteuning
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteurpos in Pretoria wat administratiewe en koördineringsondersteuning bied, begrotings van die tak bestuur, asook verkryging en strategiese verslagdoening vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Publieke Administrasie/Bestuur, Kantoorbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in administrasie of 'n relevante veld waarvan drie (3) jaar op 'n toetree/junior bestuursvlak (Assistentdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardig) moet wees. Kennis van strategiese koördinering en beplanning en professionele verslagdoening. Begrip van projektebestuur. Risiko-bestuur en besigheidsbeplanning. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en organisasie-prestasiebestuur. Goeie begrip van administratiewe prosedures en kwaliteitsbeheer van dokumente. Kennis van Regeringsbeleid en wetgewing soos PAJA, PAIA, PFMA en ander Finansiële Bestuur en geassosieerde voorskrifte. Vereiste vaardighede: Beplanning, Organisering, Fasilitering, Kommunikasie en tegniese skryfvaardighede. Gevorderde kantoortoepassings soos die MS-pakket. Vermoë om doeltreffend met belanghebbendes op verskeie vlakke saam te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Proaktiewe benadering tot die nakom van sperdatums en die lewer van resultate met beperkte toesig. Sin vir verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit.
af.duties: Bestuur die begrotings- en verkrygingsadministrasieproses van die tak. Verseker finansiële beheer insluitend kleinkontant en verkryging in die kantoor van die DDG. Monitor en stel maandelikse takverslae op (besteding, verkryging en kontrakbestuur. Verskaf strategiese beplannings- en verslagdoeningsondersteuning aan die Tak Hoofdirektorate. Koördineer en konsolideer Tak-bydraes tot Strategiese Planne en APPs. Monitor en rapporteer oor die implementering van Strategiese en Operasionele Planne. Verskaf dokumentbestuurondersteuning. Implementeer bestuursbesluite. Kwaliteitsverseker alle dokumente voordat dit aan die DDG voorgelê word. Verseker die voorsiening van sekretariaatondersteuning. Koördineer Parlementêre vrae en navrae, asook belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Bestuur en monitor verwysings van die tak. Verskaf kantoorbestuursdienste aan die DDG. Verseker nakoming en bestuur verslagdoening vir die kantoor van die DDG. Verseker logistieke ondersteuning aan die kantoor van die DDG. Verseker die voorsiening van administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Skakel en bou verhoudings met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Ontwikkel 'n belanghebbende-databasis. Verseker die voorbereiding van belanghebbende-kommunikasiemateriaal, insluitend aanbiedings, dokumente, profiele, ens.

zu.title: Umponi: Ukusekelo kokulawula kokuqondanisa
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguMponi e Pretoria sokuqondisa ukusekelwa kokulawula nokuqondanisa, ukuphathwa kwezabelo kanye nokuthenga ngokuhlelekile kanye nemibiko enkulu yokuqondisa i Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe (NQF6) kwi Public Administration/Management, Office Management noma iziqu ezifanele ngaphakathi komkhakha ohlobene njengokuqatshiwe yi SAQA. Isiphepho seminyaka yonke (5) kokuxwaya kweqa iminyaka emi-3 (3) ngokuphathe kabanzi; ukuqonda kokuhlela kogqozi nokuqonda kokubhala imibiko yezempilo. Ukuqonda kokugcinwa kohlelo. Ukuqondaniswa kwezengozi nokuhlelwa kwezentengiso. Isiphepho sezinhlelo zenzele kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza komkhakha. Ukuqonda okuhle kwezinqubo zokulawula kanye nohlelo lwezibalo zemibhalu; ukuqonda kwezinhlelo nobuhlele obungu-gubela zezivumelwano zenhlangano njengaleyo ekuqatshiwe yi SAQA naminye yemithetho. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yokuhlelo emphakathini noma kokusebenza okuhlobene, okokuzayo iminyaka emithathu (3) ihlelele yisikhundla esisezansi sabaphathi (i Assistant Director level noma okulingeneyo). Ulwazi lokubhala imibiko ngokuhlelela ukulungiselela; Ukuqonda kobuquqeko bokuhlela kwamaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kwezingozi nokuhlela kwezentengiso. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuqamba amaphulisidi nokuphathwa kokusebenza kwenhlangano. Ukuqonda okuhle ngezinqubo zolawulo kolwazi nolawulo lwemibhalu. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo nezomthetho kahulumeni ezinjenge PAJA, PAIA, PFMA kanye namanye okulawula imali nemiyalelo ehambisana nazo. Izidingo zikhonza: Ukulungiselela, ukuhlela abantu, ukusekela, ukuthetha nokuxhumana, kanye namakhono okubhala ngokomthetho; Ukuqonda izinhlelo zokusebenza eziyisilinganiso njengokuhlela kweMicrosoft Office; Isikhathi sokusebenzisana ngempumelelo nabalingiswa abanamazinga ahlukene. Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Isikhathi sokusebenzela bodwa futhi nje ngesiqaba. Ukutsha ukubhekana namathemu okuhlela nezethulo ngokulawula okuncane. Isizungu sokubamba izibopho kanye nesibopho.
zu.duties: Ukuqondisa inqubo yokulawula amabhajethi nokuthenga kwe-Branch. Qinisekisa ukulawula kwamabhalansi afaka ne petty cash kanye nokuthenga kofcede i-DDG. Qaphenisisa futhi uhlole imibiko yenqaba leminyaka (isibalo, izinkambiso kanye nokuphathwa izivumelwano). Nikeza ngokusekela ukulungiselela okuwulozibophakamu kanye nokwenza imibiko ukusekela i-Branch Chief Directorates. Hlanganisa futhi uhlanganise imibiko yesiphakamiso se-Branch kuma Strategic Plans kanye nama APPs. Qaphula kanye nokubika ngokusetshenziswa kohlelo lokuqondanisa nezohlelo; Nikeza ngokusekela ukuphathwa kwemibhalu. Setha iziqibo zokuphatha; Hlela ngokulinganisela konke ukulungiswa kwemibhalu ngaphambi kokuthumela kwi-DDG. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezikhungo. Qondanisa imibuzo nezicelo ze Parliament, futhi nanjengoko kuye kwenze imisebenzi yokuxhumana nabahlotshanayo. Phatha futhi uhlole izinhlinzo ezingenwa ngaphakathi kwesikhundla sendawo. Nikeza ngemisebenzi yokuphathwa kohhovisi kwi-DDG. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa komthetho kanye nokuphathwa kokubika kohhovisi i-DDG. Qinisekisa ukunikwa ngokusekela amathuluzi ohhovisi i-DDG. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwemisebenzi yokulawula ngesekelo. Xhumana futhi akhe ubuhlobo nabahlotshaniswa bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Akha isizinda sedata yabahlotshanisi. Qinisekisa ukulungiselela izinto zokuthumela kubahlotshanisi, okuhlanganisa amaphrezenteshini, imibhalu, amaphrofayili njll.

xh.title: Deputy Director: Administration and Coordination Support
xh.summary: Indima ka-Deputy Director ePretoria ebonelela ngolawulo ngenkxaso yokuhlanganisa, ukulawula amabhajeti egatya, ukuthenga nokubika ngokoqeqesho ku-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.

Ulwazi ngokuHlanganiswa nokuCwangcisa ngesigqinsi, nokubhala iingxelo zobungcali. Ukuqonda kokuLawulwa kweeProjekthi. UkuLawulwa kweengozi nokuCwangcisa iishishini. Ulwazi ngokuPhehlwa kwezincwadi ezilawulayo nokuLawulwa kukwanda kwemisebenzi yoNtshatsheli. Ukuqonda okuhle ngeendlela zolawulo nolawulo lolulinganiso lwamaxwebhu. Ulwazi ngeeNqaba zoLuntu kunye neeMithethoYelizwe ezinjenge-PAJA, i-PAIA, i-PFMA nolunye uLawulo lweZimali nemiThetho ehlobene nayo. Ikhono efunekayo: ukuCwangcisa, ukuHlela, ukuNcedisa, ukuThetha nokuBhala ngendlela yobuchwepheshe. Izicelo zofisi ezibhala phambili ezinje ngo-Ms Package. Ulawulo lokusebenza ngokufanayo nabathinti kumanqanaba amaninzi. Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Ulawulo lokusebenza ngodwa nakwindlu. Indlela entshatshuziyo yokugqiba ngeemilo kwaye uze uze nemveliso ngaphandle kolawulo oluninzi. Isidima sokuziphathela nokuthembeka.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqubo yabasetyhini kwaye ulawule imali yegatya. Qinisekisa ulawulo lwemali, kuquka imali encinci yokusebenza yansuku zonke neendlela zokuza kwindlu kaDDG. Lilise kuze kuqokelelwe iingxelo zenyanga zegatya (iindleko, ukuthengwa kwezinto nolawulo lwamagama ahlobene nemisebenzi). Nikela inkxaso yokucinga ngokusesigqini nokubika kumagunya aphambili egatya. Hlanganisa kuze kuqokelelwe iingcinezelelo zegatya kwiziCwangciso eziNgumgama kunye namaAPPs. Lilise kwaye ubike ngemisebenzi yeziCwangciso eziNgumgama nazo eziSebenzayo. Nikezela ngenkxaso yolawulo lwamaxwebhu. Zalisa izigqibo zabaphathi. Qinisekisa umgangatho wamaxwebhu onke phambi kokuba ezisetyhiswe kwiDDG. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwenkxaso yabaphathi. Hlanganisa imibuzo nophando lwePalamente, nokuthetha nabathinti. Lawula kwaye ulilise iinkcukacha ezithunyelwa kwelinye igatya. Nikezela iinkonzo zolawulo lwe-ofisi kwiDDG. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba kwaye ulawule iingxelo ze-ofisi kaDDG. Qinisekisa inkxaso yohambo lwezinto e-ofisini kaDDG. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwenkxaso yemisebenzi yolawulo. Thetha kwaye wakhe ubudlelwane nabathinti bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Yila isiseko sedatha sabathinti. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo lwezinto zokuthetha nabathinti, kuquka iinkcazelo, amaxwebhu, iiprofayili njl.njl.

jobs.closing_date_text: 07 September 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Control Environmental Officer Grade A focusing on climate change adaptation, based in Pretoria with the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: A four-year Degree (NQF8) in Natural / Environmental Sciences or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA plus six (6) years’ post qualification PUBLIC experience in the relevant field. Knowledge of environmental, international governance and development issues (globally, regionally, locally). Knowledge of Climate Change and environmental management and related policies. Financial Management and associated prescripts. Ability to manage and plan activities, including projects and policy matters. Policy formulation skills, presentation skills, negotiation skills, planning and organizing skills, communication skills (written and spoken), Programme and Project Management skills; Writing skills, decision-making skills, report writing skills. Computer Literacy. Innovative and proactive. Ability to work long hours voluntarily. Ability to gather and analyze information. Proven leadership skills. Ability to develop and apply policies. Ability to work independently and in a team. Ability to lead multidisciplinary team. Good interpersonal relations skills. Ability to work under extreme pressure. Conflict management and resolution. Ability to collect and interpret information and reports. Interpersonal relations.
jobs.duties: Support strategic partnerships with international and national stakeholders, including government departments, non-governmental organizations, private sector entities, and academic institutions. Support the United Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) with a strong focus on the Loss and Damage (L&D) programme of work. Provide technical support on the development, resourcing and implementation of climate-related projects. Coordinate the implementation, monitoring, and review of the National Climate Change Adaptation Strategy (NCCAS) to build the nation's resilience to climate change impacts. Support the implementation and operationalization of the National Framework for Climate Services (NFCS) to ensure the provision of climate information and services to key sectors. Facilitate and support adaptation initiatives within critical natural resource sectors (Agriculture, Water, Biodiversity, Oceans & Coast) to enhance their resilience to climate change.

af.title: Beheer Omgewingsbeampte Graad A: Aanpassing
af.summary: Beheer Omgewingsbeampte Graad A met 'n fokus op klimaatsverandering-aanpassing, gebaseer in Pretoria by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
af.requirements: 'n Vierjaar graad (NQF8) in Natuurlike / Omgewingwetenskappe of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, plus ses (6) jaar se post-kwalifikasie OPENBARE ervaring in die relevante veld. Kennis van omgewings-, internasionale bestuurs- en ontwikkelingsvraagstukke (globaal, streeks, lokaal). Kennis van Klimaatsverandering en omgewingsbestuur en verwante beleide. Finansiële bestuur en gepaardgaande voorskrifte. Vermoe om aktiwiteite te bestuur en te beplan, insluitend projekte en beleidsake. Beleidsformuleringsvaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, onderhandelingsvaardighede, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling), Program- en Projeksbestuursvaardighede; Skryfvaardighede, besluitnemingsvaardighede, verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Innoverend en proaktief. Vermoe om vrywillig lang ure te werk. Vermoe om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Bewese leierskapsvaardighede. zu.requirements: Iziqu zeminyaka emine (NQF8) kwi-Natural / Environmental Sciences noma iziqu ezifanele njengokuthathwa ngu-SAQA okuhambisana neminyaka eyisithupha (6) yokuthola iziqu ngemva kokusebenza emphakathini ngesiphiwo esihambisana naleso sikhundla. Ukwazi konke mayelana nemvelo, bobuzwe bokubusa kanye nezinkinga zentuthuko (emhlabeni jikelele, kumazinga, nasendaweni). Ukwazi ngoshintsho lolimo kwezulu nokuphathwa kwemvelo kanye namapholisi ahlobene naleso sikhathi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nemithetho ehambisana nawo. Isikhathi sokuphatha kanye neplani yokwenza imisebenzi, okuhlanganisa amaphrojekthi kanye nezindaba zephulisi. Amakhono wokwenza amapholisi, amakhono wokwethula, amakhono wokuxoxisana, amakhono wokuphathwa nokuhlela, amakhono wokuthintana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa), amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi ohlelo; Amakhono okubhala, amakhono wokwenza izinqumo, amakhono wokubhala izibalo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nomqondo oqhubekayo futhi oqhuba phambili. Isikhathi sokusebenza isikhathi eside ngokuzithandela. Isikhathi sokuqoqa kanye nokuhlaziya ulwazi. Amakhono obuholi abaqinisekisiwe. Isikhathi sokuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwamapholisi. Isikhathi sokuqashwa ngokuzimela kanye nakwisiqu. Isikhathi sokuba ngumholi wesiqu sabantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Isikhathi sokuqashwa ngaphansi kwegcuntu elikhulu. Ukuphathwa kanye nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga. Isikhathi sokuqoqa kanye nokutolisha ulwazi nezibalo. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu.
zu.duties: Ukusekela ubudlelwano bokubamba iqhaza nabalingani bamazwe ngamazwe nasekhaya, okuhlanganisa namaministri kahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingakahulumeni, izikhulu sezimboni, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo. Ukusekela i-United Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) ngokusondelela eqondile kumohlela wokusebenza we-Loss and Damage (L&D). Ukunikeza ukusekelwa ngezobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukisweni, ekunikeni izinsiza kanye nokuphothulwa kwamaphrojekthi ahlobene nezimo ezweni. Ukulungiselela ukuphothulwa, ukulawulwa, kanye nokubuyekezelwa kohlelo i-National Climate Change Adaptation Strategy (NCCAS) ukuze kwakhiwe ukuzinza kwesizwe ezithikamelweni zoshintsho lolimo. Ukusekela ukuphothulwa kanye nokwenziwa kusebenza kohlelo i-National Framework for Climate Services (NFCS) ukuze kuqinisekiswe inikezwa lolwazi kanye nosebenzi mayelana nezimo zezulu kumikhakha ebalulekile. Ukwenza kanye nokusekela izinhlobonhlobo zokuqiniswa kwamandla ezinsiza zendalo ebalulekile (Agriculture, Water, Biodiversity, Oceans & Coast) ukuze kuvikelwe isimo sawo ekushintsheni kwezulu.

Qinisekisa ukuthobela imilinganiso, isikhwama senhlobo, izaziso nezaziso ngokumiswa kwemithetho. Yenza izinhlelo zokuhamba nendawo yokuhlola ukuze kusebenzele uChief Director kanye namadirektorethi. Yamukela abahlaliswe ngaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kusebenzele uChief Director. jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% of total package, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion]. The flexible portion of the package can be structured according to the Senior Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Director of Nursing Stakeholder Management and Compliance at the Department of Health in Pretoria, requiring NQF 7 Nursing qualification and SANC registration with five years managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and an appropriate NQF 7 in Nursing as recognised by SAQA. Postgraduate qualification in Health Science Management and Nursing Education will be an advantage. Honours / Master’s qualification in nursing will PUBLIC be an added advantage. Registration with South African Nursing Council. At least five (5) years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level in nursing environment. Deep contextual understanding knowledge and understanding of the health care system and understanding nursing profession nationally, regionally and internationally. Knowledge in stakeholder management, in- depth knowledge and understanding of nursing and midwifery research-related issues, i.e. key research priorities. Knowledge of key institutions and stakeholders as well as Nursing Act. Good communication (verbal and written), strategic capability and leadership, programme and project management, financial, change and knowledge management, managerial and analytic, problem-solving and analysis, people management and empowerment, and computer skills (MS Office package). A valid driver’s license. SMS pre-entry Certificate is required for appointment finalization.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement plans and priorities for liaison with, and coordination and management of intra and inter professional stakeholders, including health sector workforce professional bodies; regulators organised labour. Revive forums for inter-sectoral collaboration, liaison and networking communities to discuss issues of common concern regarding service rendered by nurses. Identify and ensure the provision of solutions for nursing and midwifery issues based on the research findings. Support cluster directorates in the translation of research findings into nursing education and practice to improve patient outcomes and service delivery. Promote nursing as the career of choice. Develop a marketing and communication strategy for the nursing profession. Provide overall management of the directorate: nursing stakeholder management & compliance. Mobilize resources/support from development partners for the strategic programmes of the Directorate.
