The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Verpleegkundige Belanghebbendebestuur en Nakoming
af.summary: Direkteur van Verpleegkundige Belanghebbendebestuur en Nakoming by die Department of Health in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF 7 Verpleegkwalifikasie en SANC-registrasie met vyf jaar bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n geskikte NQF 7 in Verpleging soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Gesondheidswetenskapbestuur en Verpleegonderwys sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Honneurs-/Meestergraad-kwalifikasie in verpleging sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n verpleegomgewing. Diep kontekstuele begrip, kennis en begrip van die gesondheidsorgstelsel en begrip van die verpleegprofessie nasionaal, streeks en internasionaal. Kennis van belanghebbendebestuur, diepgaande kennis en begrip van navorsingsverwante kwessies in verpleging en vroedvroukunde, d.w.s. sleutelnavorsingsprioriteite. Kennis van sleutelinstellings en belanghebbendes asook die Verpleegwet. Goede kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), strategiese vermoë en leierskap, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële, veranderings- en kennisbestuur, bestuurs- en analitiese, probleemoplossing en analise, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. 'n SMS-toegangsertifikaat word vir aanstelling-finalisering vereis.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer planne en prioriteite vir skakeling met, asook koördinering en bestuur van intra- en interprofessionele belanghebbendes, insluitend die gesondheidssektor se werkkrag-professionele liggame; regulatore en georganiseerde arbeid. Herleef forums vir intersektorale samewerking, skakeling en netwerkgemeenskappe om kwessies van gemeenskaplike belang rakende diens wat deur verpleegkundiges gelewer word, te bespreek. Identifiseer en verseker die verskaffing van oplossings vir verpleeg- en vroedvroukunde-kwessies gebaseer op die bevindings van die navorsing. Ondersteun tuisdirektorate in die vertaling van navorsingsbevindings in verpleegonderwys en -praktyk om pasiëntuitkomste en dienslewering te verbeter. Bevorder verpleging as die loopbaan van keuse. Ontwikkel 'n bemarkings- en kommunikasiestrategie vir die verpleegprofessie. Verskaf algehele bestuur van die direktoraat: verpleegkundige belanghebbende-bestuur en nakoming. Mobiliseer hulpbronne/ondersteuning van ontwikkelingsvennote vir die strategiese programme van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukuphathwa Kwabahlanganyeli Kwezokwelapha Nezobuhlezi kanye Nokuhambisana Nemithetho
zu.summary: Umongameli Wokuphathwa Kwabahlanganyeli Kwezokwelapha Nezobuhlezi kanye Nokuhambisana Nemithetho e-Department of Health e-Pretoria, edinga iziqu ze-NQF 7 kwezokwelapha nokubhaliswa ku-SANC obekufanele abe namava eminyaka yamahlanu yokuba ngumphathi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-NQF 7 efanelele kwezokwelapha njengoba kuhlonzwa i-SAQA. Iziqu zamabomu e-Health Science Management kanye ne-Nursing Education kuzoba ngumsila wendlela. Iziqu ze-Honours / Master’s kwezokwelapha kuzo PUBLIC kuba ngumsila wendlela othuthukisiwe. Ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yamava ezingeni lokuphatha eliphakathi/eliphezulu kwindawo yokwelapha. Ukuqonda okujulile ngomongo nenkulu ukuqonda nge-sistema yezokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nokuqonda ngomsebenzi wezokwelapha ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ulwazi ekuphathweni kwabahlanganyeli, ukuqonda okujulile ngemibuzo ehlobene nocwaningo lwezokwelapha kanye nokubelethisa, okungukuthi, izinto ebalulekile zocwaningo. Ulwazi ngamaphuzu amabalulekile nabahlanganyeli kanye ne-Nursing Act. Isikhombi esihle (sokukhuluma nokubhala), ikhono lokubhekana nezinkinga ngokuhlela kanye nokuba ngumholi, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaprojekthi, kwezimali, koshintsho nolwazi, nokuba ngumphathi nokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukuphatha abantu nokubakhulisa, namakhono ekhompyutha (umsabalaso we-MS Office). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Isitifiketi se-SMS pre-entry sidingeka ukuze kuqedwe ukumiswa ebhorni.
zu.duties: Kuthuthukiswe futhi kuqashelwe izinhlela nezinto ebalulekile zokuxhumanisa, ukuhlanganisa kanye nokuphatha abahlanganyeli bangaphakathi kanye nalabo bangaphandle benkolo, okuhlanganisa amaphuzu abasebenzi bemikhakha yezempilo; abalawuli kanye nabasebenzi abahleziwe. Kubuyekezwe amaphuzu okuxhumanisa ngaphakathi kwamaphuzu, ukuxhumanisa nokudibana namakomkhulu ukuxoxa ngemibuzo enentshisekelo efanayo ehlobene nensebenzi ephiwa ochukunjuzi. Kuhlonze futhi kuqinisekiselwe ukunikwa kwezixazululo zamabuzo ezokwelapha kanye nokubelethisa okusekelwe emthakeni wocwaningo. Kusekelwe amadolobha aphathwayo ekuhumusheni imibuzo yocwaningo emfundweni nasekwenzeni izinkalo ezokwelapha ukuthuthukisa imiphumela yegula libheke nezinsizakalo eziyanikezelwa. Kugqitshwe isikhala sezokwelapha njengesikhundla esikhethwayo sokusebenza. Kuthuthukiswe inqubo yokumaketha nokuxhumana ngomsebenzi wezokwelapha. Kunikezwe ukuphathwa okuphelele komnyango: ukuphathwa kwabahlanganyeli kwezokwelapha kanye nokuhambisana nemithetho. Kuhlanganiswe izinsiza/isekelo abahlanganyeli kwezokuthuthuka izinhlelo eziyisikhungo zomnyango.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ulawulo lwabaMdaniso beNsemakhiwo noKwamkelwa koMthetho kwiNsemakhiwo
xh.summary: Umlawuli woLawulo lwabaMdaniso beNsemakhiwo noKwamkelwa koMthetho kwiSebe leeZempo ePretoria, ofuna ifom yeNQF 7 kwiNsemakhiwo nobhaliso kwiSANC kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava obalulekileyo ekulawuleni.
xh.requirements: Ithificheyithi yeGrade 12 kwaye ifom efanelekileyo yeNQF 7 kwiNsemakhiwo njengoko ivunywa yiSAQA. Ifom engaphezulu kwiQondo lweSayensi yeZempo nokulawula iNsemakhiwo iya kuba yingenzakalo. Ifom yeHonours / Master's kwinsemakhiwo iya PUBLIC kubayongenzakalo engezonywatisiwe. Ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council. Ubuncinane iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi eliphezulu lokulawula kwindawo yonsemakhiwo. Kuqonda ngokucacileyo iimfuno nokukuqonda inkqubo yezeempilo nokuqonda ngcamagama wonsemakhiwo kwimeko yezizwe, ngakwesixeku nakuzo wonke amazwe aphaya. Ulwazi ekulawulweni labamdaniso, ulwazi oluqinileyo nokuqonda ngcenye yonsemakhiwo namaphondo epapatsho ezimalunga nophando, oko kukuthi iindidi ezibalulekileyo zophando. Ulwazi ngeendyikithi ezibalulekileyo nabaMdaniso kunye noMthetho weNsemakhiwo. Unxibelelwano oluhle (lwesityhulwe nolubhaliweyo), amandla okujola nolawula iinxulumano, ukulawula iinkqubo namaphondo, ezimalini, ekushintsheni nolawulo kolwazi, abalawuli nabanxulumani, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlaziya, ukulawula abantu nokwabusakuzayo, namakhono ekhompyutha (i-MS Office package). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ithificheyithi yangoSapho i-SMS pre-entry ifuneka ukugqitywa kokumiselwa.
xh.duties: Pumba uze usebenzise iindlela neendidi ezibalulekileyo zokunxibelelana, nokulawula ukwenziwa kolunye noqweme lwangaphakathi nangaphandle kweendyikithi, kuquka iindyikithi zabasebenzi besektor yezeempilo; abalawuli bamagama ehlabathi alungileyo. Philisa iindawo zokubambisana phakathi kweendyikithi, ukunxibelelana nokudibanisa iidolophu ukuxoxwa ngeendaba ezibalulekileyo ngemithetho enikelwa ngabansemakhiwo. Balula uze uqiniseke ukubonelela ngamaqondo ngenkcazelo yonsemakhiwo namaphondo epapatsho ngokusekelwe kumagama wophando. Sekela iindyikithi ekugqibelelweni kwamagama wophando emfundweni yonsemakhiwo nakunqubo yokuphucula iimpumlo zabagulayo ngenkonzo ebonelelwa. Phakamisa isemakhiwo njengomsebenzi okhethwayo. Pumba inkqubo yokuthengisa nokuqhosha ngokunxibelelana ngommiselo wakho kwindawo yakho yonsemakhiwo. Nikezela ulawulo olubanzi ekulawuleni iindawo: ulawulo lwabamdaniso onsemakhiwo nokwamkelwa komthetho. Hlanganisa amaphakathi/inkxaso kubahlohli bemveliso kumatsha amaqhinga obalulekileyo phantsi koLawulo.

jobs.title: Director: Compliance and Forensic Audit
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% of total package, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion]. The flexible portion of the package can be structured according to the Senior Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Director of Compliance and Forensic Audit at the Department of Health in Pretoria, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience in compliance or forensic auditing.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and an appropriate NQF 7 in Auditing/ Accounting/ Forensic Accounting / Forensic Investigation Law/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing / Forensic Investigation / Law / Forensic Auditing. At least five (5) years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level in compliance management, forensic auditing, risk management, internal auditing, conducting compliance reviews, investigations, and regulatory reporting, fraud detection, forensic investigations, and evidence analysis. Experience in stakeholder engagement, including working with oversight bodies, law enforcement, and internal governance structures as well as experience in policy development, implementation, and monitoring. Demonstrated experience in report writing, case management, and presenting findings to senior management. Sound knowledge of applicable legislation and regulatory frameworks, particularly in the public sector (e.g. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations). Knowledge of governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks. Knowledge of fraud prevention, detection, and investigation methodologies and understanding of forensic audit principles, techniques, and standards. Knowledge of internal control systems and risk management practices and understanding of disciplinary processes, labour relations, and legal procedures related to misconduct. Knowledge of evidence collection, handling, and chain of custody requirements. Knowledge of data analysis techniques and tools used in compliance monitoring and forensic investigations and understanding of ethical standards and codes of conduct in the public service. Good communication (verbal and written), strong analytical and investigative, strategic capability and leadership, programme and project management, financial management, problem-solving and analysis, people management and empowerment, interpersonal and stakeholder engagement, project management and organizational, conflict resolution and interviewing (especially for forensic investigations) and computer skills (MS Office PUBLIC package). Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion. Ability to interpret and apply legislation, policies, and regulatory frameworks. A valid driver’s license. SMS pre-entry Certificate is required for appointment finalization.
jobs.duties: Ensure the organisation adheres to applicable legislation, regulations, policies, and ethical standards, thereby preventing risk and misconduct. Conduct compliance risk assessments and maintain a compliance risk register. Detect, investigate, and respond to allegations of fraud, corruption, and financial misconduct, and support consequence management. Conduct preliminary assessments of reported allegations or irregularities. Plan and execute forensic investigations. Stakeholder engagement on compliance and forensic services. Support consequence management and legal processes. Promote awareness and understanding of regulatory requirements. Management of resources and finance. Monitor the financial resources and assets allocated to the Unit. Oversee and approve the planned audit scope, coverage plans, and work schedules for both Compliance and Forensic Audits, ensuring cohesion and optimal resource deployment across audit functions.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise for SMS posts, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Nakoming en Geregtelike Oudit
af.summary: Direkteur van Nakoming en Geregtelike Oudit by die Department of Health in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring in nakoming of geregtelike ouditering vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n toepaslike NQF 7 in Auditing/ Accounting/ Forensic Accounting / Forensic Investigation Law/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing / Forensic Investigation / Law / Forensic Auditing. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in nakomingsbestuur, geregtelike ouditering, risikobestuur, interne ouditering, die uitvoer van nakomings hersienings, ondersoeke en reguleringsverslagdoening, bedrogspoorweging, geregtelike ondersoeke en bewysontleding. Ervaring in belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, insluitend samewerking met toesigliggame, wetstoepassing en interne bestuursstrukture, asook ervaring in beleidsontwikkeling, implementering en monitering. Agetoonde ervaring in verslagskrywing, saakbestuur en die voorlegging van bevindings aan senior bestuur. Deeglike kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en regulerende raamwerke, veral in die openbare sektor (bv. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations). Kennis van bestuurs-, risikobestuur- en nakomingsraamwerke. Kennis van metodes vir die voorkoming, opsporing en ondersoek van bedrog en begrip van beginsels, tegnieke en standaarde van geregtelike oudit. Kennis van interne beheerstelsels en risikobestuurspraktyke en begrip van dissiplinêre prosesse, arbeidsverhoudinge en regtelike prosedures rakende wangedrag. Kennis van bewysversameling, hantering en bewaringskettingvereistes. Kennis van data-ontledingstegnieke en -instrumente wat in nakomingsmonitering en geregtelike ondersoeke gebruik word, en begrip van etiese standaarde en gedragskodes in die openbare diens. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), sterk analitiese en ondersoekende vermoë, strategiese vermoë en leierskap, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, probleemoplossing en ontleding, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, interpersoonlike en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, projekbestuur en organisatoriese, konflikoplossing en ondervraging (veral vir geregtelike ondersoeke) en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office PUBLIC package). Vermoë om sensitiewe en vertroulike inligting met diskresie te hanteer. Vermoë om wetgewing, beleide en regulerende raamwerke te interpreteer en toe te pas. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. SMS-voortoelatingsertifikaat word vereis vir die finalisering van die aanstelling.
af.duties: Verseker dat die organisasie voldoen aan toepaslike wetgewing, regulasies, beleide en etiese standaarde, en sodoende risiko en wangedrag voorkom. Voer nakomingsrisikobepalings uit en handhaaf 'n nakomingsrisikoregister. Spoor bedrog, korrupsie en finansiële wangedrag op, ondersoek en reageer daarop, en ondersteun gevolgbestuur. Voer voorlopige bepalings van aangemelde beweringe of onreëlmatighede uit. Beplan en voer geregtelike ondersoeke uit. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid rakende nakomings- en geregtelike dienste. Ondersteun gevolgbestuur en regtelike prosesse. Bevorder bewustheid en begrip van regulatoriese vereistes. Bestuur van hulpbronne en finansies. Monitor die finansiële hulpbronne en bates wat aan die Eenheid toegewys is. Hou toesig oor en keur die beplande oudit-omvang, dekkingsplanne en werkskedules vir beide Nakomings- en Geregtelike Oudite goed, en verseker samehang en optimale hulpbronontplooiing oor ouditfunksies heen.

zu.title: Umlawuli: Ukuhambisana Nokuqamba Ukuphepha Kwezimali
zu.summary: Umlawuli Wokuqamba Ukuphepha Kwezimali Nokuhambisana Emnyangweni Wezempilo ePretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 7 kanye namaphuzu amahlanu weminyaka yamava obhalwe ngaphezulu ekubhaleni noma ekuqambeni ukuphepha kwezimali.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samabanga aphakeme kanti nethi NQF 7 efanelekile kwi Auditing/ Accounting/ Forensic Accounting / Forensic Investigation Law/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing / Forensic Investigation / Law / Forensic Auditing. Okungenani amaphuzu amahlanu (5) eminyaka yamava emazingeni aphakeme obhalwe / aphakeme ekuphathweni kokuqonda konke, ekuqambeni izindaba zokopha, ekuphathweni kokuphazamiseka, ekuhloleni ngaphakathi, ekwenzeni ukubuyekeka kokuqonda konke, ekuqweneni izindaba, nasekuqoqeni izindaba ngezinqubo ezisemthethweni, ekuqoqeni ubuxolo, ekuhloleni imikhangelo emibi, ekuhlukuluzeni imikhangelo, kanye nokuhlaziya izinkomba. Amava kubandakanya nolwazi lokukhuluma kanti abantu abaningi kakhulu bakhuluma namaphoyisa futhi bayakwazi ukubona ukuthi inani elithile liyakwazi ukusebenzisa imithetho yonke lezwe, imithetho eya kuhulumeni, ukuphathwa kwemikhangelo, ukuphathwa kwezimali, nokuhloliwa. Amava ekubhaleni amanani, ekuphathweni kwezindaba, ekwaziseni iziphethu ekubhaleni imibhalo. Ukuqonda okukhulu ngemithetho kuhilela kakhulu izinto ezenzeka kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika njengomthetho wezezimali kahulumeni (PFMA), izinqubo ze Treasury Regulations, kanye nezinqubo ezenzeka emsebenzini kahulumeni. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwemikango, nokuphathwa kwezinsongo, nokuqonda konke mayelana nokuqatshelwa kolimi. Ulwazi ngendlela yokubona, ukuqoqa, nokuhola ngokuphathe kwezinsongo zokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokuqonda izindlela ezahlukene zokuhola izinsongo. Ulwazi lokuqonda izinhlelo zokulawula kulezo zindawo kanti futhi ukwazi ukubala izinsongo ngendlela ezofanelekile nokuphathwa kokungabazeki, izinqubo ezithintwa ngabasebenzi, imithetho ephenya ngokubakho komsebenzi ongafanele. Ulwazi lokuqoqa izinkomba, ukuphatha, kanye nokugcina izindaba ezibuyiselwa emuva. Ulwazi lokuhlaziya imininingwane kanye nezinsimbi ezisetshenziswa kumakhulu okuhlola ukuziphendula kwezinye izinto nokuphenya ngemicimbi yokuqamba imali. Amava nokuqonda ngemithetho nokuziphatha okuhle emsebenzini kahulumeni. Amakhono okukhuluma (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), amakhono okuhlaziya nokuphenya okomehlwe, amakhono aqeqeswe kakhulu, ukuphathwa kwemikhiqizo namaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa imali ngokwesiboniso, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphatha abantu nokubakhuthaza, kanye nokuba khona nokuxhumana ngalendlela abasebenzi abangamthanda, futhi nothisha abakhulu abasebenza njengabaqondisisi babantu ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye nokuqamba ngokuphepha kwezimali nakumakhono ekhompyutha (MS Office PUBLIC package). Ukukwazi ukuphatha ulwazi oluncane kanti futhi oluyimfihlo ngokwesibonakaliso. Ukukwazi ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imithetho, izinqubo, namaphoyisa ahambisana nemithetho. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Isitifikedi se-SMS pre-entry sitholakala njengoba nje kudingekile.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi inhlangano ihambisana nemithetho, izinqubo, izinqumo kanti izinqubo kanti izinkambu zihlolwe phantsi ukuqinisekisa izinqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuthintana nemithetho nezinye izigqibo ezingathintwa mntu. Yenza ukuvivinywa kolwazi mayelana nokuqinisekiswa kolwazi nokugcina irekhodi lokungabazeki kolwazi. Thola imibuzo ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi, izindlela zokwenza imali ezingekho mthethweni, nokwenza imali ezingekho mthethweni kwezinye izindawo, kanti futhi uxhase ukuphathwa kwezindaba. Yenza isilinganiselo sokungaqondiswa iziphakamiso noma izinkomba ezikhankaswe. Cwangcisa futhi usebenze ngokuphenya izindaba ezinkulu. Ukuxhumana namaphoyisa ngokuvivinya nokuphenya imikhangelo. Xhasa ukulawula imikhangelo nemigqa yomthetho. Khuthaza ukuqonda nokwaziswa ngemithetho nokuqinisekiswa. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nokuphathwa kwezibonelelo. Okwamanje ukuphathwa kolwazi kungakhulumi ngaphandle kokuba uxhumana nabantu abafuna imibuzo yolwazi. Qinisekisa nokugcina i-ofisi ehleliwe yokuvivinya ukulungiswa kwemikhiqizo nokuhlelwa kolwazi lokuqinisekiswa nokuqamba imali.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ukuhambelana nemigaqo nokuhlola ubukrelekrere bokuziphatha
xh.summary: Umphathi wekuHambelana nemigaqo nokuhlola ubukrelekrere bokuziphatha kwiSebe leeMpepho ePretoria, efuna izifundo zeNQF 7 namashumi amahlanu (5) eminyaka yamava obulungisa obuphezulu kukuHambelana nemigaqo nokuhlola ubukrelekrere bokuziphatha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 nesidima esifanelekileyo seNQF 7 kukuHlola/ukuTshata/ukuHlola ubuKrelekrere bekuTshata/ukuPhanda ngoBulawu bokuHlola ubuKrelekrere/ukuLawula iingoYi/ukuHlola ngaphakathi/ukuPhanda ubuKrelekrere/ iMigaqo/ ukuHlola ubuKrelekrere bokuziphatha. Kubangele amashumi amahlanu (5) eminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lolawulo ekulawuleni ukuhambelana, ekuhloleni ubukrelekrere bokuziphatha, ekulawuleni iingoYi, ekuhloleni ngaphakathi, ekwenzeni iinqubo zokuHlolwa kokuHambelana, iimVavanyo, neengxelo ezisemthethweni, ekuboneni nobuhlolojwa, iimVavanyo zokuPhanda ubuKrelekrere, nodyulu lwamabungu. Amava kumanyano nabantu, kuquka ukusebenza namabumba okuQondisa, amagosa oMthetho, neenkqubo zokuLawula ngaphakathi kanjalo namava ekuyilweni kweengqungquthela, ekuzisebenzisweni kwazo, nokuZilumkisa. Amava abonakalayo ekubhaleni iingxelo, ekulawuleni iimeko, nokuBingelela abaphathi abaphezulu iziphumo. Inguqulo elungileyo yomthetho osebenzayo neenkqubo zemigaqo eNqanaba lesiXeko, ikakhulu kwicandelo likaWonke wonke (umz. uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA), iMigaqo yoLawulo lweQhamla, iMigaqo yoLawulo lweNkonzo kaWonke wonke). Inguqulo yolawulo, ekulawuleni iingoYi, neenkqubo zokuHambelana. Inguqulo yokuthintela, ukubona, neendlela zokuPhanda ubuKrelekrere nokupela kokuhlola ubuKrelekrere bokuziphatha, iindlela, nemigaqo. Inguqulo yeenkqubo zokuLawula ngaphakathi neendlela zokuLawula iingoYi nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuRhohliswa, ubuHlobo bezaBasebenzi, neendlela zomthetho ezinxulumene nokwenza okungalunganga. Inguqulo yokuQoqa amabungu, ukuphatha, neemfuno zomthunywa wamabungu. Inguqulo yendlela zodyulo lwedata nezixhobo ezisetyenziswa ekulawuleni ukuHambelana nasemVavanyweni zokuPhanda ubuKrelekrere nokuqonda imigaqo yobuNgcali neemithetho yokuziphatha kwinkonzo kaWonke wonke. Ilisima lokunxibelelana (ngokuthetha nokubhala), amandla okuhlola nokuphanda, isakhono esiNzulu nobuNkokheli, ulawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi, ulawulo lweMali, ukusombulula iingxaki nodyulo, ulawulo lweSatya nokunika mandla abantu, ubuHlobo nomanyano nabantu, ulawulo lweeProjekthi nokuhlelwa kweNdlela, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuxoxisana (ikakhulu ziimVavanyo zokuPhanda ubuKrelekrere) nesebe leKhompyutha (iNkqubo yeMS Office). Isakhono sokuphatha iNkcazelo eNzima nokuYigcina yakho. Isakhono sokuchaza nokusebenzisa umthetho, iingqungquthela, neenkqubo zemigaqo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Kufuneka kubekho isatifikethi sokuNgena phambi koxolo ngesikhathi seSMS ukugqibelelwa isikhundla.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba ingcambu ithobela umthetho osebenzayo, imigaqo, iingqungquthela, nemigaqo yokuziphatha ngendlela efanelekileyo, kuze kuthinteleke iingoYi nokwenza okungalunganga. Yenza iimVavanyo zeeNgoyi zokuHambelana uze ulondoloze uKushicilelwa kweeNgoyi zokuHambelana. Bona, phanda, phendula iingxelo zobukrelekrere bokuQhosha, ukuKhohlisa nokuQhosha ngezeMali nokuziphatha okungalunganga, uze uxhase ulawulo lweziphumo. Yenza iimVavanyo zokuQala zeengxelo ezibhiyozelweyo okanye ezingalunganga. Cwangcisa uze uphumeze iimVavanyo zokuPhanda ubuKrelekrere. Unxibelelwano nabantu malu neenkonzo zokuHambelana nokuHlola ubuKrelekrere. Xhasa ulawulo lweziphumo neenkqubo zomthetho. Khuthaza ukuQonda nokuPela kweemfuno zemigaqo. Ulawulo lwezixhobo neseMali. Lumiise imali nezixhobo ezabelwe iCandelo. Qonda uze uvume indawo eCwangcisiweyo yokuHlola, iNkqubo yoBunkelele, namaxesho oMsebenzi wokuHlola nakokuHambelana nakokuHlola ubuKrelekrere, ukuqinisekisa ulwalamano nokusetyenziswa okulungileyo kwezixhobo kuzo zonke iinkqubo zokuHlola.

jobs.title: Director: Ethics and Risk Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% of total package, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion]. The flexible portion of the package can be structured according to the Senior Management Service guidelines
jobs.summary: Director of Ethics and Risk Management for the Department of Health in Pretoria, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and an appropriate NQF 7 in Auditing/ Accounting/ Forensic Accounting / Forensic Investigation Law/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Forensic Investigation/ Law/Forensic Auditing. At least five (5) years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level in ethics, risk management, compliance, auditing, developing and implementing risk management and ethics frameworks. Experience in public sector environment will be an advantage. Professional registration with a recognised body (e.g., IRMSA, IIA, or equivalent) will be advantageous. Sound knowledge of applicable legislation and regulatory frameworks, particularly in the public sector (e.g. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations). Knowledge of Public Services ethics and corruption. Knowledge of governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks. Good communication (verbal and written), strategic planning and leadership, risk analysis and mitigation planning, policy development and implementation, research and analytical thinking, project and programme management, presentation and facilitation, conflict management and problem-solving, decision-making, strategic capability and leadership, programme and project management, financial management, problem-solving and analysis, people management and empowerment and computer skills (MS Office package). A valid driver’s license. SMS pre-entry Certificate is required for appointment finalization.
jobs.duties: Manage and render ethics management services. Develop and implement ethics management policies, strategies, and plans. Coordinate ethics awareness campaigns and training. Manage and render risk management. Develop and maintain the risk management framework and policies. Facilitate strategic and operational risk assessments. Ensures compliance with applicable legislation, policies, and frameworks while embedding a culture of accountability, transparency, and sound risk practices. Develop and implement ethics and risk management strategies aligned with organisational objectives. Establish and maintain an Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework. Provide strategic advice for stakeholder relationships and promote a culture of ethical conduct and effective risk management across the department and with external partners. Create and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders (Executive Management, Senior Management, Audit and Risk Committees). Ensure that requests for Remunerative Work Outside the Public Service (RWOPS) are processed for approval in accordance with applicable policies and procedures. Provide overall management of the directorate. Monitor the financial resources and assets allocated to the directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Q Gambu Tel No: (012) 395 8314 PUBLIC OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise for SMS posts, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Etiek en Risikobestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Etiek en Risikobestuur vir die Department of Health in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n toepaslike NQF 7 in Auditing/ Accounting/ Forensic Accounting / Forensic Investigation Law/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Forensic Investigation/ Law/Forensic Auditing. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in etiek, risikobestuur, nakoming, oudit, ontwikkeling en implementering van risikobestuur- en etiekraamwerke.ervaring in 'n openbare sektor-omgewing sal 'n voordeel wees. Professionele registrasie by 'n erkende liggaam (bv. IRMSA, IIA, of gelykwaardig) sal voordelig wees. Deeglike kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en regulatoriese raamwerke, veral in die openbare sektor (bv. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations). Kennis van openbare dienste se etiek en korrupsie. Kennis van bestuurs-, risikobestuur- en nakomingsraamwerke. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), strategiese beplanning en leierskap, risiko-analise en beplanning vir risikobeperking, beleidontwikkeling en -implementering, navorsing en analitiese denke, projeks- en programbestuur, voorlegging en fasilitering, konflikbestuur en probleemoplossing, besluitneming, strategiese vermoë en leierskap, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, mensebestuur en bemagtiging asook rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n SMS-toelatingsertifikaat word vereis vir die finalisering van die aanstelling.
af.duties: Bestuur en lewer etiekbestuursdienste. Ontwikkel en implementeer etiekbestuursbeleide, -strategieë en -planne. Koördineer etiekbewusmakingsveldtogte en -opleiding. Bestuur en lewer risikobestuur. Ontwikkel en handhaaf die risikobestuursraamwerk en -beleide. Fasiliteer strategiese en operasionele risikobevalings. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide en raamwerke terwyl 'n kultuur van aanspreeklikheid, deursigtigheid en gesonde risikopraktyke ingebed word. Ontwikkel en implementeer etiek- en risikobestuurstrategieë wat met organisatoriese doelwitte ooreenstem. Stig en handhaaf 'n Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)-raamwerk. Verskaf strategiese advies vir belanghebbende verhoudinge en bevorder 'n kultuur van etiese gedrag en doeltreffende risikobestuur regdeur die departement en met eksterne vennote. Skep en handhaaf doeltreffende verhoudinge met interne belanghebbendes (Uitvoerende Bestuur, Senior Bestuur, Oudit- en Risikokomitees). Verseker dat versoeke vir Remunerative Work Outside the Public Service (RWOPS) vir goedkeuring verwerk word in ooreenstemming met toepaslike beleide en prosedures. Verskaf algehele bestuur van die direktoraat. Monitor die finansiële bronne en bates wat aan die direktoraat toegewys is.

zu.title: Umphathi: Izimfanelo Nokuphathwa Kwezingozi
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezimfanelo Nokuphathwa Kwezingozi weDepartment of Health ePretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 7 nethuba leminyaka yihlanu lelokube ngumphathi ophakeme.
zu.requirements: Ifayeda le-Grade 12 kanye ne-NQF 7 efanele kwi-Auditing/ Accounting/ Forensic Accounting / Forensic Investigation Law/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Forensic Investigation/ Law/Forensic Auditing. Ubuncane beminyaka yihlanu (5) yemisebenzi ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi/ophakeme kwezimfanelo, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, ukuvumelana, ukuhlola, ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izakhiwo zokuphathwa kwezingozi nezimfanelo. Ukuhlola ngokomphakathi komphakathi kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukuqanjwa njengelungu esimnyameni esamukelekayo (isb., IRMSA, IIA, noma okulinganayo) kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukwazi okuhle ngemithetho nezakhiwo zokulawula ezisebenzayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni kahulumeni (isb. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations). Ulwazi ngomezimfanelo nokukhokha komphakathi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, kanye nezakhiwo zokuvumelana. Ukuxhumana okuhle (ngokuloba nangokukhuluma), ukuhlela ngokusobala nokuba nogogo, ukuhlaziya izingozi nokuqamba izinhlelo zokunciphisa, ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, ucwaningo nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuphathwa amaphrojekthi namahlelo, ukwethula nokuhola izinkomfa, ukuphathwa izinkinga nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthatha izinqumo, ikhono elikusobala nokuba nogogo, ukuphathwa amahlelo namaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa kwezezimali, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphathwa nabantu nokuwasiza, kanye nekakhono lekhalikhuletha (iphakheji le-MS Office). Isitifiketi esivunyelwe sokushayela. Isitifiketi sokuqala sokuqinisekisa ukungena kwi-SMS sidingeka ukuze kuqedwe ukumiswa.
zu.duties: Phatha nikeza amasevisi okuphathwa kwezimfanelo. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo, izuHLA, nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezimfanelo. Hlela izinkomba zokwazisa ngomezimfanelo nokulolonga. Phatha futhi unikeze ukuphathwa kwezingozi. Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze isakhiwo nezinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kwezingozi. Hola ukucwaningwa kwezingozi ezibusobala kanye nezenzakalo. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, nezakhiwo ezisebenzayo nokwakha isiko lokubheka izibopho, ukukhanyela, kanye nokuziphatha okuhle kwezingozi. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezimfanelo nezingozi ezihambisana namagunu enhlangano. Misa futhi ulondoloze isakhiwo se-Enterprise Risk Management (ERM). Nikeza izeluleko ezibusobala mayelana nobudlelwano bathuntu abahlanganyeli futhi ukhuthaze isiko lokuziphatha ngemfanelo nokuphathwa kwezingozi okusebenzayo kunyango onke nakubahlanganyeli bangaphandle. Dala futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano obusebenzayo nabahlanganyeli bangaphakathi (Executive Management, Senior Management, Audit and Risk Committees). Qinisekisa ukuthi izicelo zokuqasha kwangaphandle komsebenzi kahulumeni (Remunerative Work Outside the Public Service (RWOPS)) zithunyelwa ukuze zitholwe isiqinisekiso ngokwezinqubomgomo nemikhakha esebenzayo. Nikeza ukuphathwa jikelele kwesikhundla. Bheka izinsiza zezimali nokuhlakahlisbo ezinikelwe kulesikhundla.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ezingqwalasweni nokulawula iingozi
xh.summary: Umphathi wamagqabantshintshi nolawulo lweengozi kwisebe lezeempilo ePretoria, efunwa ngamava emfundo yeNQF 7 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava okulawula abantu kumgangatho ophezulu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 nengqwalaselo efanelekileyo yeNQF 7 kwiAuditing/ Accounting/ Forensic Accounting/ Forensic Investigation Law/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Forensic Investigation/ Law/Forensic Auditing.ubuncinane iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kumgangatho wolawulo wabaphakathi/ophezulu kwizigqabantshintshi, kulawulo lweengozi, ukuzinikela ngemithetho, ukuhlola, ukuphuhlisa nokusesekela iinkqubo zolawulo lweengozi nezobugqila. Iimfuno zesithili sabantu: Amafundo angeniswa ngaphandle kwe-NSIF angenisa ilizwe kwaye abonelele ngamava awayelawula iingcali namashishini. Ukuqwalaselwa ngobuchwepheshe kwikomiti ethi ivakalelwe ngamagunya akanazingingcida ekuvunyweni kweso sisiqu (umz. IRMSA, IIA, okwangokulinganayo) kuya kuba luncedo. Ulwazi olululo malunga nemithetho yezesimo yobuchwephesha ngeendlela ezilawulayo, ikakhulu ngaphakathi kwesithubi sabantu (umz. umthetho weenkonzo zeemali ezingaphandle (PFMA), iNkqubo yamacebo eTreasury, iNkqubo yeenkonzo zaBantu basemmandla). Ulwazi olunzulu ngeemfuno ezichaziweyo kwimithetho edibanisa iindawo zentlalo nokusingathiwa kwezimali, nakuqeqesho olubonakalisa ulawulo lweemfuno zabantu basemmandla. Ulwazi ngokusungula kwaye kulawulwe amacebo okulawula iingozi noyilo lokuhambisana nemithetho. Ulwazi ngamacebo okulawula iingozi, izikqamba ezisetenziswa ekulawulweni kobomi bokuzenzela nokubandakanya izindulamthetho ezikwimigangatho yokuzalisekisa kwemithetho yokuzimela. Ulwazi olululo ngemigaqo yolawulo, ukulinganisa iingozi, kwaye ulawule iindlela zokuzinikela ngokutsha kwamagqabantshintshi kwiindawo ezifunyaniswe yoMthetho wezeMali kuwo wonke umntu (umz. umThetho wokuLawula iimali ezingowoluntu, iTreasury Regulations, iSimo esilawulayo soMsebenzi woLuntu). Ulwazi ngezikqubo zokuphucula ubugqila kwiindawo ezahlulahlukeneyo zoluntu. Amava amaninzi ekubonisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, iplani yamacebo kunye noyilo olukumgangatho ophezulu, nokulawula iingozi nokuyicupha iindonga ezinokubakho kwindawo yokusuka ngokuphuhlisa iinkqubo, ukucinga ngokutsha nokwahlula amacebo, ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi, amacebo okubonisa nokubeka iindaba, ulawulo lweemfazekude nokusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza iigqibo, amandla okulawula iinkqubo, ulawulo lweeprojekthi namaxesha amaninzi, ulawulo lweemali, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela, ukulawula abantu nokubakhulisa nokubakhuthaza, namava okusebenzisa iikhompyutha (MS Office package). Ifayile yokhuseleko efanelekileyo yokushitya. Iatifikethi yokungena kwi-SMS kufunwa igqitywe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni.
xh.duties: Lawula kwaye unikele iinkonzo zolawulo lwamagqabantshintshi. Phuhlisa kwaye usekenze iinkqubo zamagqabantshintshi, iindlela zamagqalo, kunye neendawo ezicebisa amagqabantshintshi. Lawula kwaye unikele ulawulo lweengozi. Phuhlisa kwaye zigcine iinkqubo zolawulo lweengozi kunye namagqabantshintshi. Phuhlise iindlela zokulinganisa iingozi eziphakamileyo kwaye ezisebenzayo. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela ngemithetho, iinkqubo namagqala alawulayo ngelixa wakha inkqubo yokuziphendulela, ukuvuleka, kwaye ulawule ngokuchanekileyo amagqabantshintshi. Phuhlisa kwaye usekenze amagqabantshintshi kunye namagqibo esixhobo sokulawula iingozi ukuya ngokomnqweno wenkundla yamagqabantshintshi. Zinze kwaye zigcine iinkqubo ezikumgangatho ophezulu wokulawula iingozi (ERM). Nikela iingcebiso zamagqabanentshintshi ekwakhiweni kolwalamano kwaye Sikuthobele inkqubo yokuziphatha ngamagqabantshintshi kwaye ukulawule ngokuchanekileyo iingozi kwisebe kunye namashishini asekusini avela ecaleni. Dala kwaye ulondoloze ulwalamano oluchanekileyo nabantu abangaphakathi (abaphathi, ulawulo lwabaphathi, banomdla ekubakho kwesityhiba esisetenziswa ekubeni ngamabali, kunye nekomiti elinamava ngokuqonda iingozi). Songa ulwalamano kumhlaba jikelele osekela iinkqubo ezithile. Lawula ngokubanzi ujongo kunye namava abasebenzayo. Qinisekisa ukuba izicelo zomsebenzi ongeneleko wemali ngaphandle kwenkonzo kaBantu basemmandla (RWOPS) zithunyelwe ngokwemigaqo yomthetho esebenzayo ukuze zivunywe ngokuhambisana neendawo ezinjalo nezindlela ezichaziweyo. Lawula ngokubanzi iNkundla yomphathi. Songa ngokubanzi iNkundla yomphathi ngemithetho ephaya kwendalo yokuvunywa kwenkonzo.

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Policy Specialist
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 137 354 per annum Grade 2: R1 241 454 per annum
jobs.summary: Pharmaceutical Policy Specialist needed in Pretoria to manage pharmaceutical product specifications and item compilation for the Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: A A-Pharm degree, current registration as a Pharmacist plus a minimum of five (5) years’ appropriate experience after registration as a Pharmacist with the SAPC. Grade 2: B-Pharm degree, current registration as a pharmacist plus thirteen (13) years appropriate experience after registration as a Pharmacist with the SAPC. Salary grade will be determined in accordance with the above requirements as per the OSD. Qualifications and years of experience required are indicated above. Knowledge of evidence-based medicine, clinical pharmacology, rational medicine use, basic health financing and pharmaco-economics. Knowledge and understanding of the National Drug Policy, National Health Policy, Medicine and Related Substances Control Act 101, Pharmacy Act 53, NHI Act 20, as amended and Public Finance Management Act. Good communication (verbal and written), interpersonal, planning, organizing, analytical, critical thinking, clinical research, presentation, problem solving abilities, strategy and policy development, supervisory and computer skills (MS Office package). Ability to work independently and self- motivated. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Management of pharmaceutical products item specifications. Review item specifications list based on previous applicable contract and ensure that all proposed changes previously recommended by the BEC are considered. Oversee all matters pertaining to the compilation of the items’ specifications, ensuring that each specification is clear, unbiased, unequivocal and not brand specific. Management of Bid advertisement and closure. Oversee the bid advertisement ensuring that: item specification list is finalised, SRCC is signed off, all relevant documents are published via Government Printing Works (GPW). Prepare the presentation pack for the briefing sessions. Management of Bid evaluations. Perform technical evaluation of bids, which will include but not limited to: analysis of security of supply inclusive of API source, manufacturing sites and production capacity, Validation of products compliance with legislative requirements and specifications. Prepare the technical evaluation report for tabling at the Bid Evaluation Committee (BEC) meeting. Management of the adjudication of the bids. Quality assurance of the Departmental Bid Adjudication Committee (DBAC) submissions. Ensure DBAC submissions are done within project plan timelines. Management of tender award and contracted items. Quality assurance the DG submissions for awards, the drafted letter of acceptance and rejection as well as the contract circular. Risk management. Develop, maintain and review identified SOPs on an annual basis. Respond to audit queries that pertain to the administrative aspects of the tender process ensuring appropriate drafting on request.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. af.title: Farmaseutiese Beleidspesialis
af.summary: Farmaseutiese Beleidspesialis benodig in Pretoria om farmaseutiese produkspesifikasies en itemSamestelling vir die Department of Health te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 1: 'n B-Pharm-graad, huidige registrasie as 'n Apoteker plus 'n minimum van vyf (5) jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Apoteker by die SAPC. Graad 2: B-Pharm-graad, huidige registrasie as 'n apoteker plus dertien (13) jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Apoteker by die SAPC. Salarisgraad sal in ooreenstemming met bogenoemde vereistes bepaal word volgens die OSD. Kwalifikasies en jare van ervaring word hierbo aangedui. Kennis van bewysgebaseerde geneeskunde, kliniese farmakologie, rasionele geneesmiddelgebruik, basiese gesondheidsfinansiering en farmako-ekonomie. Kennis en begrip van die National Drug Policy, National Health Policy, Medicine and Related Substances Control Act 101, Pharmacy Act 53, NHI Act 20, soos gewysig, en Public Finance Management Act. Goede kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), interpersoonlike, beplannings, organisatoriese, analitiese, kritiese denk, kliniese navorsings, aanbiedings, probleemoplossingsvermoëns, strategie- en beleidsontwikkeling, toesighoudende en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-paket). Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk en selfgemotiveerd te wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur van farmaseutiese produkte se itemspesifikasies. Hersien itemspesifikasielys gebaseer op vorige toepaslike kontrak en verseker dat alle voorgestelde veranderinge wat voorheen deur die BEC aanbeveel is, oorweeg word. Toesig oor alle aangeleenthede rakende die samestelling van die items se spesifikasies, wat verseker dat elke spesifikasie duidelik, onpartydig, ondubbelsinnig en nie handelsmerkspesifiek is nie. Bestuur van aanbiedingsadvertensies en -sluiting. Toesig oor die aanbiedingsadvertensie om te verseker dat: itemspesifikasielys gefinaliseer is, SRCC onderteken is, alle relevante dokumente via Government Printing Works (GPW) gepubliseer word. Berei die aanbiedingspak vir die inligtingsessies voor. Bestuur van aanbiedingsevaluering. Voer tegniese evaluering van aanbiedinge uit, wat sal insluit maar nie beperk is tot: ontleding van voorsieningssekuriteit insluitend API-bron, vervaardigingspersele en produksiekapasiteit, validasie van produkte se voldoening aan wetgewende vereistes en spesifikasies. Berei die tegniese evalueringsverslag voor vir voorlegging by die Bid Evaluation Committee (BEC)-vergadering. Bestuur van die aanspraakbeoordeling van die aanbiedinge. Kwaliteitsversekering van die Departmental Bid Adjudication Committee (DBAC)-voorleggings. Verseker DBAC-voorleggings word binne projekplan-tydlyne gedoen. Bestuur van tenderbekendmaking en gekontrakteerde items. Kwaliteitsverseker die DG-voorleggings vir bekendmakings, die opgestelde aanvaardings- en afwysingsbrief asook die kontrakkennisgewing. Risikobestuur. Ontwikkel, handhaaf en hersien geïdentifiseerde SOP's op 'n jaarlikse basis. Reageer op ouditnavrae wat betrekking het op die administratiewe aspekte van die tenderproses en verseker toepaslike opstel op versoek.

zu.title: Ingcali yenqubomgomo yamakhemikhali okwelapha
zu.summary: Kudingeka ingcali yenqubomgomo yamakhemikhali okwelapha ePretoria ukuphatha izici zemikhiqizo yamakhemikhali okwelapha nokuhlela izinto kuDepartment of Health.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: I-degree ye-A-Pharm, ukubhalisa okwamanje njengePharmacist kanye nokuba namava afanele angaphansi kokuthi eminyaka emihlanu (5) emva kokubhalisa njengePharmacist ne-SAPC. Izinga 2: I-degree ye-B-Pharm, ukubhalisa okwamanje njengePharmacist kanye namava afanele aminyaka eyishumi nantathu (13) emva kokubhalisa njengePharmacist ne-SAPC. Izinga leholo lizohlonywa ngokuvumelana nezidingo ezingenhla njengoba kushiwo i-OSD. Izifundo neminyaka yamava edingekayo miboniswa ngenhla. Ulwazi ngegama elisuselwa ezibonweni, ephathelene nobuPharmacist bokuqashwa komtholampilo, ukusebenzisa imithi ngokuhlakanipha, izimali ezisisekelo zezempilo kanye ne-pharmaco-economics. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-National Drug Policy, i-National Health Policy, i-Medicine and Related Substances Control Act 101, i-Pharmacy Act 53, i-NHI Act 20, njengoba kulungisiwe kanye ne-Public Finance Management Act. Amakhono okuxhumana (abomlomo nakubhalwe), abantu, ukuhlela, ukulungiselela, ukuhlaziya, ukucabanga ngokujulile, ucwaningo lwenhlabathi, okwemibhalo, ukusombulula izinkinga, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo nomshini, okabaphathi nakwamakhompyutha (i-MS Office package). Ikhono lokusebenza kedwa nokuzimotshisela. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezici zemikhiqizo yamakhemikhali okwelapha. Ukuhlola uhlu lwezici ngokusekelwe esivumelwaneni sangaphambilini esifanelekile futhi waqiniseka ukuthi zonke izinguquko eziphakamiswe ngaphambilini yi-BEC zibhekwa. Ukuphatha wonke amaphuzu ahlobene nokuhlelwa kwezici zezinto, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi into ngayinye ihlaziwe ngokucacile, ngaphandle kokuthanda okuthile, ngokucacile futhi ayihlobene namaphuzu ethiwe. Ukuphathwa kokumemezwa nokuyivala ibid. Ukuphatha ukumemezwa kwebid kuqinisekisa ukuthi: uhlu lwezici luphelile, i-SRCC isayiniwe, wonke amadokhumenti afanele ashicilelwe nge-Government Printing Works (GPW). Ukulungiselela ipakheji yokwethula masikhathi okwethulwa. Ukuphathwa kokuhlola amabid. Ukwenza ukuhlolo ngobuchwepheshe kwamabid, okufaka kodwa okungaqothelwe: ukuhlaziywa kobunye basemthwengi bokulethwa okuhlanganisa umthombo we-API, izindawo zokukhiqiza namandla okukhiqiza, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo ihambelana nezidingo zomthetho nangezici. Ukulungiselela umbiko wokuhlola ngobuchwepheshe ukuwethula emhlanganweni we-Bid Evaluation Committee (BEC). Ukuphathwa kokuqaphula amabid. Ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yezinikezelo ze-Departmental Bid Adjudication Committee (DBAC). Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinikezelo ze-DBAC zenziwa ngaphakathi kwanoma ikuphi uhlelo lwesikhathi senqubo. Ukuphathwa kokunikezwa kwethenda nezinto ezilaywe. Ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yezinikezelo ze-DG ezipha amanikezelo, incwadi ebhaliwe yokwamukela nokwenqaba kanye nesexwayo sesivumelwano. Ukuphathwa kozingozi. Ukuthuthukisa, ukugcina kanye ukuhlola ama-SOP abhalwe ngonyaka wonke. Ukuphendula imibuzo ye-audit ehlobene namaphuzu obuqonde obuphathwayo benqubo yetenda kuqinisekiswa ukubhalwa okufanele uma kucelwa.

xh.title: Igcwele kwiMiba yeZopolitiko zezeNhlahlela zeziYeza
xh.summary: Kufuneka igcwele kwiMiba yeZopolitiko zezeNhlahlela zeziYeza ePretoria ukulawula iinkcukacha zemveliso yeziyaza nokuqokelela izinto zeSebe lezeMpilo.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Isidanga se-A A-Pharm, ukuBhalisa ngokwangoku njengogqithisa wezeye nakanjani amashumi amathathu nanhlanu (5) eminyaka yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengogqithisa wezeye kwi-SAPC. Inqanaba 2: Isidanga se-B-Pharm, ukuBhalisa ngokwangoku njengogqithisa wezeye nakanjani amashumi amathathu (13) eminyaka yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengogqithisa wezeye kwi-SAPC. Inqanaba lomvuzo liza kuqatshulwa ngokwale mfuno ingentla njengoko kuchazwe kwi-OSD. Iziqinisekiso neminyaka yamava efunekayo iboniswe ingentla. Ulwazi ngonyazi-wezazi eziseko lwesayensi, iziyenza zokwelapha, ukusebenzisa iziyenza ngokwezangqondo, ezemali eziseko zenkcubeko yempiIlo yempilo nokuqonda-yeziyenza. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNqamba leZizwe yeziYeza, iNqamba leZizwe lezeMpilo, umThetho woLawulo lweziYeza nokuNgqamana nawo umThetho 101, umThetho weZiyeza 53, umThetho we-NHI 20, njengoko ulungisiweyo nakuwo na umThetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu. Amandla okunxibelelwana (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo), okubonisana nabantu, okucwangcisa, okuhlela, ukuhlalutya, okucinga ngokujonga ngokudlulisela oluvo, uphando lokwelapha, okubonisa, amandla okusombulula iingxaki, iNqamba lezoLuntu nokuQamba iNqamba, okulawula nakhompyutha (i-MS Office package). Amandla okusebenzela lodwa nokuzithabisela. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: uLawulo lweenkcukacha zezinto zemveliso yeziyaza. Ukuqwalasela uluhlu lweenkcukacha ezinto ngokwemitsho egqibeleleyo yangaphambili nokuqinisekisa ukuba bonke ootshintsho abacebiweyo ngaphambili abagqitywa yi-BEC bacatshangelwa. uKuqwalasela yonke imiba enxulumene nokuqokelelwa kweenkcukacha ezinto, kuqinisekiswe ukuba inkcukacha nganinye icacile, ingenamva wokuthi, icacile kwaye ayichazi ngomvelisi. uLawulo lokwenziwa kwesaziso nokuvalwa kwemitsho yokunikezela. ukuqwalasela isaziso somtsho kuqinisekiswe ukuba: uluhlu lweenkcukacha lwezinto luqediwe, i-SRCC sayiniwe, yonke amaxwebhu afanelekileyo ashicilelwe ngokwendlela yoLawulo loLuntu i-GPW. ukuLungiselela ipakethe yokuBekisa okuHlabathayo. uLawulo lokuQatshulwa kwemiTsho. ukuZenza uhlalutyo olubuchule lweMitho, oko kuya kuquka kodwa akugqityelwa kuko: ukuHlalutya uKhuseleko lokuNika ngokubandakanya umThombo we-API, iindawo zenziwa kwemiVeliso namandla okuVelisa, ukuQinisekisa ukuzinikela kwezinto ngokwemigaqo yomThetho nakuNkcukacha. ukuLungiselela ingxelo yohlalutyo yobuChule yokubekwa kuqumrhamba koBhunga loQatshulwa lokuNgqamana lweziYiza (BEC). uLawulo lokugqibela ngokwemigaqo kwemiTsho. uQinisekiso lokhuseleko lwangaphakathi koluhlu lokuBhaliswa koludwe oluvela kwiSebe (DBAC). uQinisekisa ukuba izibhaliso ze-DBAC zenziwa phakathi kwamaxesha oCwangciso lweProjekthi. uLawulo lonikezelo lweMitho nezi nto eziNikiweyo ngesivumelwano. uQinisekiso lokhuseleko olutsha ngokusembhaxweni iingxelo ze-DG zenikelwa kumVuzo, ileta ekhaliweyo yokuMamkela nokuYala nakuwo na nesisexebhu sesivumelwano sasebe. uLawulo lomBa wolingo. ukuQamba, ukuGcina nokuQwalasela i-SOP ezibaluliweyo ngaphakathi kwamava kwakhona ngokwamanyaka. ukuPhendula imibuzo yoluko ekuxhumaneni nemiba yolawulo lenkqubo yomtsho, kuqinisekiswe ukuba ixhaxha ngokufanelekileyo ngokwesicelo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Accounting
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package). The flexible portion of the package can be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Financial Accounting role in the Department of Health, Pretoria, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and middle management experience to produce financial statements and liaise with AGSA.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and an appropriate NQF 7 in Financial Accounting / Public Finance / Auditing as recognised by SAQA. NQF 8 on any of the above- mentioned qualification will be an advantage. At least three (3) years’ experience in Financial Accounting at middle management (ASD) level in financial accounting or auditing field. Knowledge of effective financial administration within the Public Service including Government banking procedures, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Safety Net, PERSAL, SAGE system, Financial Delegations, Departmental policies and procedures and the Basic Accounting System (BAS). Knowledge of suspense/control accounts PUBLIC used by the Division: Bookkeeping. Knowledge of the Personnel Staff Codes as well as PSCBC Resolution 3 of 1999. Good communication (verbal and written), management, analytical, financial, auditing, problem solving and computer skills (MS Office package). A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Produce complete and accurate quarterly, Interims and annual financial statements report, including coordination of RFIS and communication of audit findings and liaise with AGSA on audit related matters. Collect inputs from various business units for the compilation of Financial Statements. Report fraud, irregular, unauthorized, fruitless & wasteful expenditure after it is detected. Manage accurate processing of financial transactions in respect of salaries and S&T claims. Monitor payroll certification process and ensure complies to National Treasury deadlines. Monitor monthly reconciliation of tax, SARS payment processed prior the 7th of each month. Bi-Annual and annual reconciliation finalized on a set due date. Ensure complete and accurate processing of sundry payment efficient bookkeeping and banking. Guide subordinates on clearing control accounts to ensure efficient accounting month and year end closure. Enforce adherence to Treasury requirements in relation to revenue management and bank reconciliation. Ensure effective movement of debtors and loss control (I,R,O irregular expenditure, fruitless and wasteful expenditure and unauthorized expenditure). Ensure that debt files, that is departmental debts and COVID 19 vaccination debts from public and private sites are followed up in writing monthly. Ensure movement of debts in respect of departmental debts and COVID 19 vaccination debts (accrued departmental revenue) from public and private sites. Manage personnel and risk management. Submit all inputs for operational plan and progress reports (including statistics) by internal due dates. Submit all performance agreements, appraisals and reviews by due dates stipulated by Human Resource.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001.
