af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Rekenkunde
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Rekenkunde- pos in die Department of Health, Pretoria, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en middelbestuurservaring vereis om finansiële state op te stel en met AGSA te skakel.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n toepaslike NQF 7 in Finansiële Rekenkunde / Openbare Finansies / Ouditering soos deur SAQA erken. NQF 8 vir enige van bogenoemde kwalifikasies sal 'n voordeel wees. Ten minste drie (3) jaar ervaring in Finansiële Rekenkunde op middelbestuurs (ASD) vlak in die finansiële rekenkunde- of ouditeringsveld. Kennis van doeltreffende finansiële administrasie binne die Staatsdiens insluitend Regeringsbank prosedures, PFMA, Tesourie regulasies, Safety Net, PERSAL, SAGE-stelsel, Finansiële Delegasies, Departementele beleide en prosedures en die Basiese Rekenkundige Stelsel (BAS). Kennis van sekuriteits/kontrole rekeninge wat deur die Afdeling gebruik word: Boekhouding. Kennis van die personeel se personeelkodes sowel as PSCBC Resolusie 3 van 1999. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), bestuurs-, analitiese, finansiële, ouditerings-, probleemoplossings- en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Vervaardig volledige en akkurate kwartaallikse, tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële stateverslae, insluitend die koördinering van RFIS en kommunikasie van ouditbevindings, en skakel met AGSA oor ouditverwante aangeleenthede. Versamel insette van verskeie besigheids eenhede vir die opstel van finansiële state. Rapporteer bedrog, onreëlmatige, ongemagtigde, nuttelose en vermorsende uitgawes nadat dit opgespoor is. Bestuur akkurate verwerking van finansiële transaksies ten opsigte van salarisse en S&A-eise. Monitor die sertifikasieproses van betaallyste en verseker voldoening aan Nasionale Tesourie- sperdatums. Monitor maandelikse herberedening van belasting en SARS-betalings wat voor die 7de van elke maand verwerk is. Tweejaarlikse en jaarlikse herberedening teen 'n vasgestelde sperdatum voltooi. Verseker volledige en akkurate verwerking van diverse betalings, doeltreffende boekhouding en bankwese. Lei ondergeskiktes oor die skraping van kontrole rekeninge om doeltreffende rekenkundige maand- en jaareindsluiting te verseker. Handhaif voldoening aan Tesourie-vereistes met betrekking tot inkomste bestuur en bankherberedening. Verseker doeltreffende beweging van debiteure en verliesbeheer (I,R,O onreëlmatige uitgawes, nuttelose en vermorsende uitgawes en ongemagtigde uitgawes). Verseker dat skuldlêers, dit wil sê departementele skulde en COVID 19- inentingskuld van openbare en private sentrums maandeliks skriftelik gevolg word. Verseker beweging van skulde ten opsigte van departementele skulde en COVID 19- inentingskuld (opeengehopde departementele inkomste) van openbare en private sentrums. Bestuur personeel en risikobestuur. Dien alle insette vir operasionele plan en vorderingsverslae (insluitend statistiek) teen interne sperdatums in. Dien alle prestasie ooreenkomste, evaluerings en hersienings teen sperdatums wat deur Menslike Hulpbronne gestipuleer is, in.

zu.title: Umaboza Womqondisi: Ukubhaliswa kwemali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMqondisi Womaboza: Ukubhala ngokuphathwa kwemali ephishele kwaDepartment of Health, e-Pretoria, esidinga isabelo se-NQF 7 kanye noqeqesho ezingeni eliphakathi nobuphathi ukukhiqiza iminikelo yemali ephathwayo kanye nokuxhumana ne-AGSA.
zu.requirements: Isitifikadi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-NQF 7 elifanele kumabhuloho wezimali ephathwayo / imali yomphakathi / ukuhlola njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. I-NQF 8 kunoma yisiphi isabelo esingentla nezivezelwe izoba yinzuzo. Okungenani ungamakhulu amabili nesikhombisa (3) iminyaka yokuhlola kwababhali bengcuphethe ngemali ephathwayo esigabeni sokuphatha (ASD) enkabeni yemali ephathwayo noma ukuhlola. Ukwazi ukuphatha ngokunembile kwemali ephathwayo ngaphakathi kwaPublic Service okuhlanganisa izinqubo zamabhange kabusos, i-PFMA, imiyalo yeTreasury, i-Safety Net, i-PERSAL, inkqubo ye-SAGE, ukwabiwa kwemali, izinqubo namapholisi womnyango kanye nesistimu yokuBhala ngemali ephathwayo (BAS). Ukwazi izikhwama zokubamba isinkwa i-PUBLIC ezisetshenziswa yiqembu: Ukubhala izincwadi. Ukwazi amakhodi abasebenzi kanye kanye nokuqinisekisa ngokuqondile ngenqubo ye-PSCBC Resolution 3 of 1999. Ukuxhumana kuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe), ukuphatha, ukuxazulula, ngokwezimali, ngokokuqondisa, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda ikhompyutha (i-MS Office package). Ilayisensi yokushayela ngokusemthethweni.
zu.duties: Kukhiqize umbiko ohleliwe futhi ongaguqguqiki wezinkathi ezinhathu (3), ezingaphakathi konyaka noweminyaka yemali ephathwayo, okuhlanganisa ukuqondanisa i-RFIS kanye nokuxhumana ngemithelo yokuhlola bese ukuxhumana ne-AGSA ngemikhuba ehlobene nokuhlola. Qoqa iminikelo evela kumagumbi ahlukene ebhizinisi ukuze kuqoqwe iminikelo yemali ephathwayo. Khipha umbiko wenkohlakalo, okungavunyelwe, okungagunyaziwe, okungalubusekile namabi & okushiselwe emva kokutholwa. Phethe ngokunembile ukwenza umsebenzi wemali ephathwayo mayelana noholo nezinkomba ze-S&T. Qedelela inqubo yokufakazwa kwe-payroll ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ihambisana nezinsuku eziqokiwe ze-National Treasury. Lilise inqubo yokuqinisekiswa kwesikhathi esingu-7 senyanga ngayinye, kanye nokuhlela izimali zentela ezenziwe ngaphambi kosuku loku-7 lwenyanga ngayinye. Ukuqinisekiswa kweminyaka yonke nakuqediwe ngosuku olumisiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali ephathwayo ehlukene, ukubhala izincwadi ezinembile kanye namabhange kwenziwe ngokugcwele futhi ngokunembile. Hola abangaphansi ukuba basule izikhwama zolawulo ukubona ukuthi ukubala ngokwemali ekupheleni kwenyanga kanye noma ngonyaka kuqediwe. Phoqa ukuhambisana nezidingo zeTreasury kokuqashwa kwezimali zentela nokulinganiswa kwamabhange. Qinisekisa ukuhamba okusebenzayo kwabangwe imali nokulawula ukulahlekelwe (I,R,O ukuchithwa kwenkohlakalo, ukulahlekelwa okungalubusekile namabi kanye namabi kanye nokuchithwa okungalunyaziwe). Qinisekisa ukuthi amafayela abangwe imali, okuyimadlana kombuso namadlana e-COVID 19 yegciwane lokugomela abavela kolwangu lomphakathi nobuyangasese alandelwa ngokubhala nyanga ngayinye. Qinisekisa ukuhambisa imali ebekwe owesikhulu mayelana namadlana kombuso namadlana e-COVID 19 yegciwane lokugomela abavela kolwangu lomphakathi nobuyangasese. Phatha abantu bese ulawula imikhuba engabangela ubungozi. Hambisa onke amaminikelo ohlelo lokusebenza namaberula ukuba ahambe (okuhlanganisa izibalo) ngosuku olumisiwe. Hambisa onke amasivumelwano, izilinganiso nezibuyekezo ngosuku olumisiwe yi-Human Resource.

xh.title: Iphini lekhowuntu: I-Financial Accounting
xh.summary: Inkundla yokuba yIphini lekhowuntu: I-Financial Accounting kwi-Department of Health, ePretoria, efuna ifom ye-NQF 7 namava obekwe phakathi wokulawula ukuyalela iinkcukacha zemali ezisemthethweni nokudibana ne-AGSA.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 12 nendlela efanelekileyo ye-NQF 7 kwi-Financial Accounting / Public Finance / Auditing njengoko kujuluse i-SAQA. Indlela ye-NQF 8 nakuphi na kwezi ndlela zangasentla kuya kuba lusizo. Ubuncinane iiminyaka elithathu (3) yamava kwi-Financial Accounting kwinqanaba lolawulo olubekwe phakathi (ASD) kundlu yemali nokuhlola. Ulwazi ngolawulo olusebenzayo lwezimali kwindlu kaRhulumente, kuquela iinkqubo zebhanki zaRhulumente, i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Safety Net, i-PERSAL, inkqubo ye-SAGE, i-Financial Delegations, iinkqubo namagunya osebe kunye ne-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Ulwazi nge-accounts zokwalathi/zilawulo PUBLIC ezisetyenziswa nguMmandla: i-Bookkeeping. Ulwazi ngamakhodi abasebenzi kunye ne-PSCBC Resolution 3 ka-1999. Amakhono amahle othetha nabanye (ethethwayo nobhalwayo), yolawulo, wokuhlola, wezimali, wokusombulula iingxaki kunye namakhono ekhompyutha (i-MS Office package). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Yalela iinkcukacha zemali ezizizo, ezichanekileyo zethotu, ze-Interims nezomnyaka, kuquela ulawulo lwe-RFIS nokuvelisa iziphumo zohlolo nokudibana ne-AGSA kumatz we-audit. Qokelela izixhobo ezivela kumagosa ahlukeneyo ekuyaleleni iinkcukacha zemali ezisemthethweni. Bika inkohliso, iindleko ezingemthethweni, ezingagunyazisiweyo, ezingenasiphicile kumnqa nezingalunganga emva kokuzifumana. Lawula ngokuchanekileyo ukuqhubwa kweendleko zemali malunga namaholo nemitshwalayo ye-S&T. Qaphula inkqubo yokugunyazisa iholo uze uqiniseke ukuba ihambelana nemigaqo yexesha eyimigibe yo-National Treasury. Qaphula ukuqwalaselwa kwemigqeniselo yenyanga yomvuzo, namahlawulo e-SARS aqhubwe phambi kwe-7 yenyanga nganye. Ukuqwalaselwa kabini ngeminyaka nakamnyaka kuqwalaselwa ngomhla obekiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kugqitywa ngokuchanekileyo nangokuziio kwemihlawulo eyahlukileyo nge-bookkeeping ebangalweni nangebhanki. Qondisa abasebenzi ngokususa i-accounts zolawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvalwa ngokusebenzayo kwenyanga nophelo kwikanjaye. Phakamisa ukuzigcinwa kwemigaqo ye-Treasury mayelana nolawulo lweentsruso nokuqwalaselwa kwebhanki. Qinisekisa ishishini elisebenzayo kwabatyala bathunyelwe kwindlu yolawulo I,R,O iindleko ezingagunyaziswanga, ezingenasiphicile nengalunganga kunye nezingemthethweni). Qinisekisa ukuba iifayile zotyala, oko kukuthi amatyala osebe kunye namatyala e-COVID 19 vaccination avela kwindawo zoluntu nezabucala zilandelwa ngobhalo nyanga zonke. Qinisekisa ishishini kwamatyala malunga namatyala osebe kunye namatyala e-COVID 19 vaccination (inkcitho yemali evela kwindlu kaRhulumente) evela kwindawo zoluntu nezabucala. Lawula abasebenzi nolawulo lwengozi. Nika zonke izixhobo zeplani yoshishino kunye nemibekiso yentsovo (kuquela izibalo) ngemigaqo yexesha yangaphakathi. Nika zonke izivumelwano zokusebenza, izibeko kunye namaphononongo ngemigaqo yexesha ebekekayo yi-Human Resource.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Database Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: The Department of Health seeks a Deputy Director for Database Management in Pretoria to oversee digital health databases, data governance, and health data quality.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate and NQF 7 qualification in one of the following: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Database Administration, Data Science, Health Informatics or Health Information Management. A postgraduate qualification (NQF 8) in Health Informatics, Data Science, Information Systems, or Public Health will be an advantage. Certification in any of the following: Microsoft SQL Server certification, Oracle Database certification, PostgreSQL/MySQL administration, Cloud database platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud), and Data management and governance certifications. At least five (5) years of experience post- qualification in health-related database management and analytical data queries at a middle management level. Knowledge of data management and governance, Relational Database and Programming, Legal and operational compliance, Process knowledge and skills, database design and analysis knowledge, research and development, Web-based services, Technical report writing. Knowledge of DHIS2 (District Health Information System), Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, National Health Laboratory information systems, National health data reporting requirements, POPIA compliance and health data confidentiality, Data integration and interoperability. Excellent communication (written and verbal) with all stakeholders. Effective organisational and time management, resilience, assertiveness, ethical behaviour, and self-management skills. Ability to work independently and within a diverse multidisciplinary team. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Ensure reliable and efficient operation of all digital health databases. Protect sensitive patient and healthcare information with reference to benchmark data governance practices and related legislative frameworks. Maintain integrity, consistency, and quality of health data. Coordinate new data development, ensuring consistency and integration with the existing data warehouse structure. Ensure continuity and recoverability of critical healthcare data. Participate in continuous improvement efforts in enhancing performance and providing increased functionality of the databases. Ensure databases support growing digital health demands. Analyse and determine information needs and PUBLIC elements, data relationships and attributes, data flow and storage requirements, and data output and reporting capabilities. Enable seamless operation of health information systems. Provide reliable data environments for analytics and decision-making. Review business requests for data and data usage, research data sources for new and better data feeds.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise for SMS posts, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Databasisbestuur
af.summary: Die Department of Health soek 'n Adjunkdirekteur vir Databasisbestuur in Pretoria om digitale gesondheidsdatabasisse, datagoederbestuur en gesondheidsdatakwaliteit te oorsien.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie in een van die volgende: Rekenaarwetenskap, Inligtingstegnologie, Inligtingstelsels, Databasisadministrasie, Datawetenskap, Gesondheidsinformatika of Gesondheidsinligtingbestuur. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF 8) in Gesondheidsinformatika, Datawetenskap, Inligtingstelsels of Volksgezondheid sal 'n voordeel wees. Sertifisering in enige van die volgende: Microsoft SQL Server-sertifisering, Oracle Database-sertifisering, PostgreSQL/MySQL-administrasie, Clouddatabasisplatforms (Azure, AWS of Google Cloud), en databestuur- en goederbestuursertifiserings. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervare na kwalifikasie in gesondheidsverwante databasisbestuur en analitiese data-navrae op 'n middelbestuursvlak. Kennis van databestuur en -goederbestuur, relasionele databasisse en programmering, regskundige en operasionele nakoming, proseskennis en -vaardighede, databasisontwerp en -analisekennis, navorsing en ontwikkeling, webgebaseerde dienste, tegniese verslagskrywing. Kennis van DHIS2 (District Health Information System), Electronic Medical Record (EMR)-stelsels, National Health Laboratory-inligtingstelsels, nasionale gesondheidsdata-verslagdoeningsvereistes, POPIA-nakoming en gesondheidsdata-vertroulikheid, data-integrasie en interoperabiliteit. Uitstekende kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling) met alle belanghebbendes. Effektiewe organisatoriese en tydbestuur, veerkragtigheid, aansienlikheid, etiese gedrag en selfbestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om selfstandig en binne 'n diverse multidissiplinêre span te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verseker betroubare en doeltreffende werking van alle digitale gesondheidsdatabasisse. Beskerm sensitiewe pasiënt- en gesondheidsorginligting met verwysing na maatstafgegevensbestuurspraktyke en verwante wetgewende raamwerke. Handhaaf integriteit, konsekwentheid en kwaliteit van gesondheidsdata. Koördineer nuwe data-ontwikkeling en verseker konsekwentheid en integrasie met die bestaande datawarehouse-struktuur. Verseker kontinuïteit en herstelbaarheid van kritieke gesondheidsorgdata. Neem deel deurlopende verbeteringspogings om prestasie te verbeter en verhoogde funksionaliteit van die databasisse te bied. Verseker dat databasisse groeiende digitale gesondheidsbehoeftes ondersteun. Analiseer en bepaal inligtingsbehoeftes en OPENBARE elemente, datarelasies en -eienskappe, data-vloeien bergingsvereistes, en data-uitset en verslagdoeningsvermoëns. Moontlik naatlose werking van gesondheidsinligtingstelsels. Verskaf betroubare data-omgewings vir analise en besluitneming. Hersien besigheidsversoeke vir data en data-gebruik, ondersoek databronne vir nuwe en beter data-strome.

zu.title: Onozimele: Ulawulo Lwesiqu Lwemininingwane
zu.summary: I-Department of Health ifuna uOnozimele woLawulo lweSiqu leMininingwane ePretoria ukuba abheke imininingwane yesiqu yezempilo yedijithali, ulawulo lwemininingwane, nengakhamba kahle kwemininingwane yezempilo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nefayela le-NQF 7 kwenye yalezi: i-Computer Science, i-Information Technology, i-Information Systems, i-Database Administration, i-Data Science, i-Health Informatics noma i-Health Information Management. Ithuba elikhulu loba ibiyunivesithi (i-NQF 8) kwi-Health Informatics, i-Data Science, i-Information Systems, noma i-Public Health lizoba yinzuzo. Ukwaba nokuqinisekiswa nakwenye yalezi: isitifiketi se-Microsoft SQL Server, isitifiketi se-Oracle Database, i-PostgreSQL/MySQL administration, izinkundla zesiqu ledijithali ye-Cloud (i-Azure, i-AWS, noma i-Google Cloud), kanye nezitifiketi zokuphatha kanye nezokuqondisa imininingwane. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yeminyaka yokusebenza emva kokuthola ithuba kwimisebenzi ephathene nezempilo ekuphathweni kwesiqu lemininingwane kanye nemibuzo yemininingwane yokuhlaziya emazingeni okuphathwa abaphathi abaphakathi. Ulwazi ngokuphatha kanye nokuqondisa imininingwane, i-Relational Database kanye nokuhlela ikhodi, ukuvumelana ngokomthetho nangokomsebenzi, ulwazi namakhono eenqubo, ulwazi lwezibalo zokwakha isiqu kanye nokuhlaziya, uphando nentuthuko, izinsizakusebenza ezinguxazavalathi, kanye nokubhala okunemfundo. Ulwazi nge-DHIS2 (i-District Health Information System), izinhlelo ze-Electronic Medical Record (EMR), izinhlelo zemininingwane ze-National Health Laboratory, izidingo zokubika imininingwane yezempilo yezwe, ukuvumelana ne-POPIA kanye nobumfihlo bwemininingwane yezempilo, ukuhlanganiswa kwemininingwane nendlela yokusebenza ndawonye. Ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana okubhalisiwe nokuveza okwenziwa ngomlomo nakwabo bonke abanethonyo. Amakhono okuhlelwa komphakathi nokuphatha isikhathi, ukomelela, ukuzimela, ukuziphatha ngokuzethemba, kanye namakhono okuziphathela. Ikhono lokusebenza nodwa kanye ngaphakathi kwenkambu yamakhono amaningi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezingafani. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukusebenza okuzethemba kanye okusebenza kahle kubo bonke imininingwane yesiqu yezempilo yedijithali. Vikelana imininingwane ebucayi yesiguli kanye nezokwelapha ngokubheka izinqubo eziyisibalo ekubuqondiseni imininingwane kanye namakamu okomthetho ahlobene nalenkinga. Gcina ubunye, ukuhambisana, nengakhamba kahle kwemininingwane yezempilo. Hlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemininingwane entsha, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana kanye nokuhlanganiswa nesakhiwo esikhona sesiqu segceke elikhulunywa. Qinisekisa ukuqhubeuka nokubuyiswa kwemininingwane ebalulekile yezokwelapha. Thatha inxaxheba kumazamo okuthuthukisa ngokuqhubekayo ekwandiseni ukusebenza kahle kanye nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza okwandisiwe kwemininingwane yesiqu. Qinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yesiqu ixhasa izidingo ezikhulayo zezempilo yedijithali. Hlaziya futhi uthathe izinqumo mayelana nezidingo zemininingwane kanye nezakhiwo zikawonke wonke, ubuqu bemininingwane kanye nokuhlobana kwabo, ukugeleza nokugcinwa kwemininingwane okudingekayo, kanye namanani okukhipha imininingwane namakhono okubika. Yenza ukuthi izinhlelo zemininingwane yezempilo zikwazi ukusebenza ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Hlinzeka ngamazinga ethembekile emininingwane ayengozini yokuhlaziya kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Buyisa izicelo zebhizinisi ezingemininingwane kanye nengxenye yokusetshenziswa kwemininingwane, uphenye imithombo yemininingwane yamajareji amasha nabasengozini yokuhlakaniphiswa kwemininingwane.

xh.title: UMongameli weNqanaba leQela leQela
xh.summary: Kwindawo ePretoria, iNyuso yezempilo yenza isabelo sokuba nguMongameli we-Database Management ukuze alawule iinkqubo ezibhala ngendlela ephilayo yolwazi lwamaphakathi nezempilo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGraji 12 kwaye unemvuzo osukweni 7 kwelinye ibali elifanayo leSayensi ekhompyutheni, ubuchwepheshe bolwazi, iindlela zokuphatha iinkqubo, iindlela zokulawula ulwazi, iSayensi yoLwazi, izinto ezenzeka kwindawo yempilo okanye ukulawula iNkqubo yolwazi ngemithi yezempilo. Isatifikethi seGraji 8 kwizinto ezinje ngokuphucula ulwazi ngemithi yezempilo, iSayensi yoLwazi, iindlela zokuphatha iinkqubo, okanye iNtlalo yamaphakathi kuya kuba ngumsinga ophezulu. Isatifikethi kwezi ndlela zilandelayo: Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL/MySQL administration, iinkqubo ze-database ezikwi-Intanethi (Azure, AWS, okanye Google Cloud), kunye nezatifikethi zokuphatha nokulawula ulwazi. Ukuba nakho obuncinane eminye emihlanu (5) yamava emva kokufumana isatifikethi ekuphathweni kwe-database ezidibana nezempilo nakuphandwa kolunye ulwazi olubandakanya izigqibo kwisinga sokuqhuba. Ulwazi ngokuphatha nokulawula ulwazi, iindlela zokuqamba iinkqubo kunye nezinto ezibhalwayo, ulwazi ngokuhambelana kwemithetho kunye nokuqhuba, ulwazi nakhono lokwenza iinkqubo nezinto ezibonisana nezinto ezizodwa, ulwazi ngokuphucula izinto ezintsha, ulwazi ngokuphucula iinkqubo, ulwazi oluchazwe ngobuGcisa beNkqubo. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo ye-DHIS2 (iNkqubo yoLwazi ngokuQhoboshwa kwamaphakathi ezempilo), iinkqubo ezibhalwa ngemidlamo yeMedyisini (EMR), iinkqubo zoLwazi zezempilo ezikumazwe ngamazwe ngokuphindaphinda kolwazi, iindlela ezifunwa ngokubika ngolwazi ngokuqhweshelela iNtetho yeButho ngokuPhepha koLwazi (POPIA) nokulondoloza imfihlo yolwazi ngemithi yezempilo, ukudibanisa ulwazi nakho kokubakwa kolunye ulwazi. Ukubakho khona ukudibanisa ulwazi nokuhlalutywa olucacileyo. Ukuchuma kokuchuma nokudluliswa kolunye ulwazi olucacileyo. Ubuchule bokudluliswa kolunye ulwazi. Amava okusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nangaphakathi kweqela labantu abanabasebenzi abanabasebenzi abahlukeneyo. Isatifikethi sokusebenza esivunyelweyo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukusebenza okuzinzileyo nokusebenza kakuhle kwezo database eziphathwa ngemidlomo eziphathwa ngemithi yezempilo. Khuseleka ulwazi oluzekelayo lwesigulane nelunxibelelwano lwamagosa ezempilo ngokubhekiselela kumaxabiso amabini aqhelekileyo ekulawuleni ulwazi nakumaphakamiso omtshato wokusebenza avela kumthetho. Ukugcina ukuzinza, ukuhambelana, namagunya olo lwazi oluhambelanayo ngokumayelana nempilo yabantu. Qhoboshela iindlela ezintsha ezenza ulwazi oluqhelekileyo oluqhelekileyo, ukuqinisekisa amaxabiso amabini kwaye abe nalangeniselo olutsha kwisakhiwo sophuhliso olungezelelweyo. Qinisekisa impilo yokudlula nokugcina ulwazi olubekiweyo olubalulekileyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiindlela ezizezokuqhuba nokuphucula iziphumo ezenza iziphakamiso ngokwamandla okuqhuba imisebenzi ngakumbi. Ukuyalela iindawo ezinokwenzeka ukuba zincede ukuphucula iindlela ngemithi yezempilo, ukusombulula iindlela ezisezantsi zokuqinisekisa ulwazi nokudlulisela kolunye ulwazi. Lungiselela iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuhlangabezana nezigqibo ezizezokuhlalutywa. Lungiselela iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuhlangabezana nezigqibo ezizezokuhlalutywa nokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi oluqhelekileyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Data Scientist
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines
jobs.summary: Lead data science projects within the Department of Health in Pretoria, developing analytical solutions to transform health data into actionable insights for decision-making.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate and NQF 7 qualification in one of the following sciences: Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Actuarial Science, Engineering (with a data analytics focus). A postgraduate qualification (NQF 8) in Data Science, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Public Health, or Health Informatics will be an advantage. Proven work experience of 3–5 years in data analysis, analytics, statistics, machine learning, or health data management. This experience may be in the fields of: Health information systems, Clinical data, Public health programmes, Research datasets, Monitoring and evaluation systems or Disease surveillance systems. Experience related to building ETL processes will be an advantage. Proven competencies in: Epidemiology and disease surveillance, Health systems and service delivery, Health indicators and reporting frameworks, Health information systems, Data quality management, Health data interoperability standards, Research methods and biostatistics, Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Ethical use of health data during the handling and manipulation of large health datasets using enterprise database technologies. Key technical skills required include: Programming Languages such as Python and SQL. Data Science and Analytical skills related to: Machine learning, Statistical modelling, Predictive analytics, Data mining and Natural language processing will be advantageous. Data visualisation skills required include: Power BI, Tableau or Python visualisation libraries. Database Technology proven experience includes: MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Plan, coordinate and execute data science project activities that transform health data into actionable insights in support of decision-making. Develop and maintain advanced analytical solutions. Ensure the integrity and reliability of health data. Enable evidence-based digital health products and services. Advance digital health knowledge and innovation. Ensure analytical work supports organisational objectives. Ensure responsible use of health data that relates to regulatory compliance, privacy (POPIA) and ethics in health data, including ethical use of AI, ML and DL in the digital health ecosystem. Enhance the analytical maturity of Data Science in the Digital Health Unit. Contribute towards solutions for solving analytic problems that can be incorporated into the Business Intelligence (BI) solutions for the NHI Fund Design. Participate and contribute to Data Governance and ensure compliance with relevant legislation.

Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Datawetenskaplike
af.summary: Lei datawetenskapprojekte binne die Department of Health in Pretoria, en ontwikkel analitiese oplossings om gesondheidsdata tot bruikbare insigte vir besluitneming te transformeer.
af.requirements: A Graad 12-sertifikaat en NQF 7-kwalifikasie in een van die volgende wetenskappe: Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Actuarial Science, Engineering (met 'n data-analitiese fokus). A nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF 8) in Data Science, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Public Health of Health Informatics sal 'n voordeel wees. Bewese werkervaring van 3–5 jaar in data-analise, analitiek, statistiek, masjienleer, of bestuur van gesondheidsdata. Hierdie ervaring kan in die volgende velde wees: Gesondheidsinligtingstelsels, kliniese data, openbare gesondheidsprogramme, navorsingsdatastelle, monitering en evalueringstelsels of siektebewakingstelsels. Ervaring rakende die bou van ETL-prosesse sal 'n voordeel wees. Bewese bevoegdhede in: Epidemiologie en siektebewaking, gesondheidstelsels en dienslewering, gesondheidsaangeduiders en verslagdoeningsraamwerke, gesondheidsinligtingstelsels, datakwaliteitsbestuur, interoperabiliteitsstandaarde vir gesondheidsdata, navorsingsmetodes en biostatistiek, Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), etiese gebruik van gesondheidsdata tydens die hantering en manipulasie van groot gesondheidsdatastelle met behulp van ondernemingsdatabasetegnologieë. Belangrike tegniese vaardighede wat vereis word, sluit in: Programmeertale soos Python en SQL. Datawetenskap- en analitiese vaardighede verwant aan: Masjienleer, statistiese modellering, voorspellingsanalitiek, datamynbou en Natural language processing sal voordelig wees. Datavisualiseringsvaardighede wat vereis word, sluit in: Power BI, Tableau of Python-visualiseringsbiblioteke. Databasetegnologie-bewese ervaring sluit in: MS SQL Server en PostgreSQL. A geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Beplan, koördineer en voer datawetenskapprojekaktiwiteite uit wat gesondheidsdata tot bruikbare insigte transformeer ter ondersteuning van besluitneming. Ontwikkel en onderhou gevorderde analitiese oplossings. Verseker die integriteit en betroubaarheid van gesondheidsdata. Moontlik maak bewysgebaseerde digitale gesondheidsprodukte en -dienste. Bevorder digitale gesondheidskennis en -innovering. Verseker dat analitiese werk organisatoriese doelwitte ondersteun. Verseker verantwoordelike gebruik van gesondheidsdata wat verband hou met regulatoriese nakoming, privaatheid (POPIA) en etiek in gesondheidsdata, insluitend etiese gebruik van AI, ML en DL in die digitale gesondheidsekosisteem. Verhoog die analitiese volwassenheid van Datawetenskap in die Digital Health Unit. Dra by tot oplossings vir analitiese probleme wat in die Business Intelligence (BI)-oplossings vir die NHI Fund Design geïnkorporeer kan word. Neem deel en dra by tot Data Governance en verseker nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing.

zu.title: Onibusi Ohlelane: Isayensi Yedata
zu.summary: Buka amaphrojekthi esayensi yedata endaweni i-Department of Health ePretoria, uthuthukise izixazululo zokuqonda eziguqula idatha yezempilo ibe ulwazi olusebenzisekayo ekwenzeni izinqumo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 kanye nesifundo se-NQF 7 kwezinye zale sayensi ezilandelayo: Isayensi Yedata, izibalo, Isayensi Yezikhompyutha, izibalo, Izibalo Eziyisisebenziso, Izinhlelo Zolwazi, Ulwazi Lwezempilo Olucatshangelwayo, I-Epidemiology, Izibalo Zezokempilo, Isayensi Ye-Actuarial, Ubunjineli (okugqamisa ukuhlola idatha). Isifundo esiphezulu (NQF 8) kwiSayensi Yedata, Izibalo Zezokempilo, I-Epidemiology, Izempilo Zomphakathi, noma Ulwazi Lwezempilo Olucatshangelwayo kuzoba yinzuza. Ukwazisa ukusebenza okushibhile kweminyaka engu-3–5 ekuhloleni idatha, ukuhlola, izibalo, ukuhlela imishini, noma ukuphatha imininingwane yezempilo. Le mamebe angaba emikhakheni engu: Izinhlelo zolwazi lwezempilo, imininingwane yezifo, izinhlelo zezempilo zomphakathi, imininingwane yocwaningo, izinhlelo zokuqaphela nokubuyekezwa noma izinhlelo zokuqaphela izifo. Ukwazisa ukuhlela izinqubo ze-ETL kuzoba yinzuza. Ukuqonda okushibhile kwezikhono: I-Epidemiology nokuqaphela izifo, izinhlelo nezinkonzo zezempilo, izinkomba zezempilo kanye nezinhlelo zokubika, izinhlelo zolwazi lwezempilo, ukuphathwa kokulinganiswa kwemininingwane, izinga lokusebenzisana kwemininingwane yezempilo, izindlela zocwaningo kanye nezibalo zezezempilo, Umthetho Wokuvikela Ulwazi Olumuntu Ngamunye (POPIA), ukusetshenziswa okuhambisana nesiko kwemininingwane yezempilo ngesikhathi kusetshenziswa futhi kuhlukaniswa imininingwane enkulu yezempilo kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe bedatha ezebedayo. Izikhono ezibalulekile zezobuchwepheshe ezidingwayo zihlanganisa: Izilimi zokubhala amakhalodi njengoba i-Python ne-SQL. Izikhono zeSayensi Yedata Nokuqhathanisa eziyisisebenziso ezihlobene nokuhlela imishini, ukwakhiwa kwezibalo, ukubikezelwa okusekelwe kwedatha, ukukhiqiza idatha kanye nenkqubo yokucutshungula ulimi lwemvelo kuzoba yinzuza. Izikhono zokubonisa idatha ezidingwayo zihlanganisa: i-Power BI, i-Tableau noma izilimi ze-Python zokubonisa idatha. Ubuchwepheshe bedatha okunikeza isitifikedi kuhlanganisa i-MS SQL Server kanye ne-PostgreSQL. Iselayisense esivumelekile sokushayela.
zu.duties: Hlela, lungisanise futhi ufeze imisebenzi yamaphrojekthi yesayensi yedata eguqula imininingwane yezempilo ibe ulwazi olusebenzisekayo ekwesekweni kwezinqumo. Tuthukisa futhi ugcine izixazululo zokuhlola ezithuthukile. Qinisekisa ukuzinza nokuthembeka kemininingwane yezempilo. Yenza imikhiqizo nezinkonzo zezempilo eziyisithombe-esikhaleni ezisekelwe ngobufakazi. Phambisa ulwazi nentuthuko yezempilo eziyisithombe-esikhaleni. Qinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wokuhlola usekela imigomo yenhlangano. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuphathene nemininingwane yezempilo okuhlobene nokuzethemba kwezomthetho, imfihlo (POPIA) kanye nesiko emininingwaneni yezempilo, kuhlanganise ukusetshenziswa okuhambisana nesiko kwe-AI, ML ne-DL emkhakheni wezempilo eziyisithombe-esikhaleni. Khuphula izinga lokuhlola kwesayensi yedata Eyunithi Yezempilo Eziyisithombe-esikhaleni. Nikeza ngeminikelo ekuxazululeni izinkinga zokuhlola ezingafakwa kuzixazululo ze-Business Intelligence (BI) ekwakhiweni kwe-NHI Fund. Hlanganyela futhi unikeze ngeminikelo Ekuqondiseni Imininingwane futhi uqinisekise ukuzethemba kwezomthetho ohlobene nalokho.

xh.title: Umqongqongo Wabasebenzi: Isayensi Yamanani
xh.summary: Qhuba amaprojekthi esayensi yamanani ngaphakathi kwisebe Lezempilo ePretoria, ngokuthuthwa kwezisombulo zolungisiso ngalolu lwazi ukuze lwaguquke lwabe lulwazi olusebenzisekayo ekwenzeni izigqibo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 nengenisa umgangatho weNQF 7 kwelinye lezazinzulu ezilandelayo: Isayensi Yamanani, IziBalomlinganiselo, Isayensi Yekhompyutha, IziBalo, IziBalo Ezifunyaniswayo, Iinkqubo Zolwazi, IziNkqubo Zolwazi LwezeMpilo, isiGqibo soMhlaza, IziBalo ezingoMmandla wezoNtleliso, Isayensi yokuBala ngokulinganisa iingozi, uNzululwazi (onganikela ngokuchonga amanani). Ikwaziso elipheleleyo leNQF 8 kwisayensi yamanani, izibalo ezisetyenziswa kwimida yamagciwane, isigqibo somhlaza, impilo yoluntu, okanye iinkqubo zolwazi loluntu luya kuba lilungelo. Uqeqesho olubonwayo olumiselwewe oluqinisekisiweyo lokuqhuba imisebenzi yeminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwengama-5 kulungiso lwamanani, ukuqwalasela amanani, izibalo, ukufunda ngamakhompyutha, okanye ulawulo lolwazi ngempilo. Lo msebenzi unokuba kwimida egejwayo kwi: iinkqubo zolwazi lwezeMpilo, iinkcukacha zamagciwane ezeMpilo, amaqonga aphakathi kwentlalo, ukuqokelelwa kwamanani okulinganisayo, ulawulo loluhlu lokulinganisa nokuqwalasela okanye iinkqubo zolondolozo zokhwankqiselwa kokubakho kwezifo. Uqeqesho olubonelela ngokuyilwa kweenkqubo zeETL luya kuba lilungelo. Amandla aqinisekisiweyo kwi: ukubakho kokhwankqiselwa kokubakho kwamagciwane kwiinkqubo ezijongeziimVELISO, iinkqubo neenkonzo eziqwalaselwa kwizibonelelo, iinkqubo ezingagqibekanga kunye neendlela ezahlukahlukeneyo zokubeka iinkqubo ezinokuzinikela ngokwazo, ulawulo lolwazi lwamagciwane egazini, ulawulo lweempazamo ezingagqibekanga ngokwamanani amaninzi, amanani afana neempawu ezahlukeneyo ezifanayo kwizinto ezingafaniyo, iindlela zolwazi ngeempawu, IsiNdlu SoLwazi ngokubakho kwabantu kunye nokubakwa kwabantu baseMzantsi Afrika (POPIA), nokusebenzisa iinkcukacha zamagciwane ngokusesikweni ngexesha lokusingatha nokuqamba iinkqubo ngokusebenzisa ulwazi oluninzi ngamagciwane. Amandla obuchwepheshe aba balulekile afaka: iindlela zokulungisa iinkqubo ezifana nePython kunye neSQL. Amandla esayensi yamanani nokuqwalasela ngokulinganisela okuhambelana: ukufunda ngekhompyutha, ukulinganisa okubalulekileyo, ukuqwalasela okusesikweni, ukungena kolwazi ngamakhompyutha nokusingatha iintetho zendalo zonke. Amandla okubonisa amanani ofuna ukuba nalo afaka: iPower BI, iTableau okanye amathala ePython okubonisa amanani. Ikhompyutha yedathabhisi ebonelela nokuqinisekiswa okubonakalayo ifaka: iMS SQL Server kunye nePostgreSQL. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa, ulungelelanise kwaye uphumeze iinkqubo zamaprojekthi esayensi yamanani aziguqula amanani ezeMpilo abe lulwazi olusebenzisekayo ekuxhaseni ukwenziwa kwezigqibo. Yila kwaye ulondoloze izisombulu zolungisiso ezibe ngowona mgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka nokuthembeka kwamanani ezeMpilo. Yenza ukuba kube khona iimveliso nandiinkonzo ezoNtlobo zamaKhompyutha ezisekelwe kwiziqinisekiso. Phuhlisa ulwazi nobuchwephesha obutsha kwintlobo yamakhompyutha ezeMpilo. Qinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi wolungisiso uxhasa iinjongo zoLuntu. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokusesikweni kwamanani ezeMpilo okuhambelana nokuthotyelwa kwemigaqo, urhulumente (POPIA) kunye nezinja ngokusesikweni kwamanani ezeMpilo, kuquka nokusetyenziswa okusesikweni kwe-AI, i-ML kunye ne-DL kwintlobo yamakhompyutha ezeMpilo. Phucula amandla esayensi yamanani kwioYuniti yamaKhompyutha ezeMpilo. Yegca ezisombululweni ezingenelela ezingenwa kulunngisiso lwamaxaaxa angangenwa kwiiNkqubo ze-BI ezakelwe uMgxalaba we-NHI. Thatha inxaxheba kwaye ungenelele kwiNkundla yoLawulo lwamaNani kwaye uqinisekise ukuthotyelwa kwemigaqo ehambelana nayo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Recrutment, HR Policy and Planning
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Recruitment, HR Policy and Planning at the Department of Health in Pretoria, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and three years' experience at Assistant Director level.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate and NQF 7 qualification in Human Resource Management or related qualification. Certificate in PERSAL (Personnel Administration). At least three (3) years of experience at Assistant Director level in Recruitment, Selection, Appointments, Policy Development and HR Planning. Knowledge of Public Service Regulations 2016, Public Service Act PUBLIC 1994, Employment Equity Act 1998, Basic Condition of Employment Act 1997, Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Knowledge and understating of DPSA policies, directives and frameworks relating to recruitment, HR planning and policy management. Knowledge and understanding of policy development and policy analysis. Good communication (verbal and written), planning, organizing, interpretation, facilitation, people management, negotiation, conflict resolution, problem solving, decision making and computer skills (MS Office package and PERSAL). Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive human resource information. Ability to engage effectively with senior management, organized labour and external stakeholders. Ability to work extended hours to meet operational deadlines. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Manage and facilitate the advertisement and response handling in the department. Manage and oversee the implementation of recruitment and selection process to ensure timely filling of vacant posts in accordance with approved policies, procedures and legislative requirement. Manage appointments and employee mobility on the PERSAL system. Manage and oversee the implementation of appointments, transfer, promotions, translations, deployments, secondments, and other personnel movements on the PERSAL system. Verify and authorize appointment and transfer transactions on PERSAL system. Develop, review, monitor and implement human resources policies and planning. Develop the Human Resource Plan and Human Resource Implementation Report for submission to DPSA. Manage risk, audit and resources. Coordinate responses to audit findings. Evaluate and monitor performances and appraisal of employees.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise for SMS posts, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Werving, HR-beleid en -beplanning
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Werving, HR-beleid en -beplanning by die Departement van Gesondheid in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en drie jaar se ervaring op Assistentdirekteur-vlak vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. Sertifikaat in PERSAL (Personeeladministrasie). Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring op Assistentdirekteur-vlak in Werving, Keuring, Aanstellings, Beleidsontwikkeling en HR-beplanning. Kennis van Public Service Regulations 2016, Public Service Act PUBLIC 1994, Employment Equity Act 1998, Basic Condition of Employment Act 1997, Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Kennis en begrip van DPSA-beleide, direktiewe en raamwerke met betrekking tot werving, HR-beplanning en beleidsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van beleidsontwikkeling en beleidsanalise. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), beplanning, organisering, interpretasie, fasilitering, menslikebestuur, onderhandeling, konflikoplossing, probleemoplossing, besluitneming en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket en PERSAL). Vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf en sensitiewe menslike hulpbron-inligting te hanteer. Vermoë om doeltreffend met senior bestuur, georganiseerde arbeid en eksterne belanghebbendes te skakel. Vermoë om lang ure te werk om operasionele sperdatums na te kom. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur en fasiliteer die advertensie en reaksiehantering in die departement. Bestuur en oorsien die implementering van die werwings- en keuringsproses om tydige vul van vakante poste te verseker in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde beleide, prosedures en wetgewende vereistes. Bestuur aanstellings en werknemersmobilititeit op die PERSAL-stelsel. Bestuur en oorsien die implementering van aanstellings, oorplasings, bevorderings, vertalings, ontplooiings, tweedings en ander personeelbewegings op die PERSAL-stelsel. Verifieer en magtig aanstellings- en oorplasingstransaksies op die PERSAL-stelsel. Ontwikkel, hersien, monitor en implementeer menslike hulpbronbeleide en -beplanning. Ontwikkel die Menslike Hulpbron-plan en die Menslike Hulpbron-implementeringsverslag vir voorlegging aan DPSA. Bestuur risiko, oudit en hulpbronne. Koördineer reaksies op ouditbevindings. Evalueer en monitor prestasies en waardering van werknemers.

zu.title: Umqondisi Ohlanganyele: Ukuqasha, Imigomo yezInsiza zabantu noHlelo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMqondisi omlandelayo weNqubo yokugcina amaphuzu, Nqubo kanye neNqubo yokuhlela izindaba eNgqikithi yezeMpilo ePretoria, kudinga isitifikati seNQF 7 kanye neminyaka engu-3 yokuhamba kahle kwesikhulu esibhalisile ngomkhakha ohambisana nalokhu.
zu.requirements: Isitifikindi seGrade 12 kanye nokuqeqeshwa okufanele kuNQF 7 ekuqeqeshweni kokuqasha kwabasebenzi noma ezinye iziqu ezifana nalezi. Isitifikati kusishoshovi sokubumba abasebenzi kahulumeni (PERSAL). Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 (3) yokuhamba kahle njengesebe lesikhulu ekuqashweni abasebenzi, ekukhethweni, ukumisweni, ekwakheni imigomo nakuhlelweni lokuqesha abasebenzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho wasezikhundleni kahulumeni 2016, umthetho wezinsiza zabantu kahulumeni PUBLIC 1994, umthetho wokuqinisekisa ukulingana kwamathuba emisebenzi 1998, umthetho wokuqinisekisa ukulingana kwemisebenzi 1997, umthetho wokuqondisa imali kahulumeni kanye nemigomo yokuqondisa amanani kahulumeni. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinhlelo zomsebenzi kahulumeni ezithinteka ekubumbeni abasebenzi, ekuhlelweni kwezinsiza zabantu nasekuphathweni kwemigomo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ekwakheni imigyo nokuhlaziya imigomo. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (akhotho ukubhala noma ukukhuluma), ukuhlela, ukuhlela kabusha, ukuphatha, ukuxhumana nabantu, ukuqondanisa izindaba, ukulawula abantu, ukuxoxa, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (ohlelweni lwe-MS Office kanye nePERSAL).
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlele ukuthunywa kwemiklamo nokuphathwa kwabezimpendulo kumnyango. Phatha futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokubumba abasebenzi nokukhetha ukuqinisekisa ukugcwaliswa kwesikhathi esifanele kwamaphuzu angekho ngokuvumelana nemigomo, izinqubo nezidingo zomthetho ezamukeliwe. Phatha ukumiswa kwabasebenzi nokunyakaza kwabasebenzi kwesikhathi eside kukahlelo emnyangweni. Phatha futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kokumiswa kwabasebenzi, ukudluliswa, ukukhushulwa, ukuhumusha, ukumiswa esikhundleni, ukumiswa ngaphakathi, nokunyakaza kwabantu ngamunye emkhankulweni kahlelo. Qinisekisa futhi uvume ukumiswa kwabasebenzi nezinye izenzo zokudluliselwa kukahlelo lokubumba abasebenzi. Hakisa, buka kabusha, kwesikhathi eside bese usebenzisa izinhlelo futhi uhlele imigomo kahlelo. Hakisa iNani labaQinisekiso, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amasevisi ahlinzeka kahale nokuvikelwa kwemfanelo yakho ngokulawuleka okufanele kwamaphuzu imali nemis inkokhela. Lawula izinsongo, ukubuyekezwa kanye namathuluzi. Hambisa izimpendulo ezitholakalayo ezibuyekeziwe. Hlola futhi ulawule ukusebenza kahle nokubuyekezwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi.

xh.title: iSekela nguMlawuli: ukuQeqeswa kumSebenzi, iNqaku ye-HR kunye noCwangciso
xh.summary: iSekela nguMlawuli wokuQeqeswa kumSebenzi, iNqaku ye-HR kunye noCwangciso kwiSebe leeMponele ePretoria, lifuna ifom ye-NQF 7 kunye neminyaka mitatu yamava kwinqanaba loMlawuli oMncedi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 kunye nefom ye-NQF 7 kwintlawulo yoluntu kumSebenzi okanye ifom ehambelana nayo. Isatifikethi kwi-PERSAL (intlawulo yabasebenzi). Ubuncinane iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwinqanaba loMlawuli oMncedi kwikuQeqeswa kumSebenzi, ukuKhethwa, ukuMiselwa kumSebenzi, uPhuhliso lweNqaku kunye noCwangciso lwe-HR. Ulwazi ngeZiqendu zeNkonzo kaRhulumde zika-2016, uMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumde ka-1994, uMthetho wokuLingana koBasebenzi ka-1998, uMthetho weeMfuno eZisiseko zoBusebenzi ka-1997, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumde kunye neZiqendu zeQoso. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo, iimiyalelo kunye nezakhiwo ze-DPSA ezithatha ngqo ngokuQeqeswa kumSebenzi, uCwangciso lwe-HR kunye nolawulo lwenqaku. Ulwazi nokuqonda nguphuhliso lwenqaku nokuqwalasela inqaku. Iakhono ezilumkisayo zokuNxibelela (ngelizwi nangokubhalwayo), ukuCwangcisa, ukuLungelelanisa, ukuThelekisa, ukuKhokelela, ukuLawula abantu, ukuXoxisana ngeengozi, ukuxoxa iziphithiphithi, ukuxoxa iingxaki, ukuthatha izigqibo kunye nekhompyutha (i-MS Office package kunye ne-PERSAL). Iakhono lokugcina iyimfihlo kunye nokuphatha iinkcukacha ezifihlakeleyo zamakhono abantu. Iakhono lokunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo nabaphathi abaphezulu, basebenzi baqeshwe ngokudibana naye (organized labour) kunye neendlela zangaphandle. Iakhono lokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo ukuze kugqitywe emthethweni wokusebenza. ilayisenisi evakalayo yomqhubi.
xh.duties: Lawula ukukhuthaza nokubeka ngaphandle iinkqubela phambili ekubeni nzuzo ukuboniswa kwentshabalalo kwaye kuphendulwe ngayo kulo msebe. Lawula ukugcina iqondo elihle ngokusebenziswa koluntu kwakuqeqeswa ekukhetheni abantu ukuze kugqitywe ngokuhamba kwexesha okuzo kuzalwa izithuba ezingenalutho ngokwemigaqo ekuqinisekisiweyo neyamkelekileyo iingcebiso, iinkqubo nemfuno yomthetho. Lawula imiselwa yabasebenzi kunye nokuhamba komntu kwinkqubo ye-PERSAL. Lawula ulondolozo lokuyala kubakho imisebenzi yokumiselwa, ukudluliselwa, inkuzo yokhuthazo, ukuguqulwa kolwimi, ukumiselwa kwindawo entsha, ukuthunyelwa kwenkokeli, nangaphezulu iintshukumo zabasebenzi kwinkqubo ye-PERSAL. Qinisekisa uvume izibhalo zomsebenzi wokumiselwa nokudluliselwa kunkqubo ye-PERSAL. Zenza, ukuba ngumyalelo, ukugcina iqondo elihle kwaye usebenzise iinkqubela phambili koluntu kwamakhono abandulela nokuqonda ukuyilwa kwentshabalalo. Thetha inkqubela phambili yeSango lokuQeshwa koluntu nesiko sokwenza isivakalisi seSango lokuQeshwa koluntu sokwaziswa kwi-DPSA. Lawula iingozi, ukulinganisa koluntu nokuqina kwentshabalalo ekuhlaziyiweyo. Hlanganisa ezo ngxelo zokwaziswa ngokusetyenziswa koluntu. Qwalasela kwaye ugqibe ukulingana nokuqina kwentsimbi kubasebenzi.

At least three (3) years’ experience in office administration and financial management at Senior Administrative Officer or equivalent level (Salary level 8). Knowledge of the Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act. Sound understanding of financial policies as guided by Treasury Regulations. Good communication (verbal and written), planning, organizing, interpersonal, problem solving and decision making, liaison and coordination, analytical, project management and computer skills (MS Office package). Administer the finances of the Chief Directorate. Co-ordinate procurement activities and assist with MTEF submissions. Provide secretariat support to the Chief Directorate. Ensure proper co-ordination of meetings and ensure timeous submission of minutes and agenda. Management of human and physical resources. Ensure proper control of leave records, asset register, procurement of assets/equipment etc.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Administrasie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Administrasie wat administratiewe steun aan die Hoofdirektoraat binne die Department of Health in Pretoria verleen.
af.requirements: Grade 12 (NQF 4)-sertifikaat en 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie in Office Administration/ Office Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration/ Business Management of Business Administration soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring in kantooradministrasie en finansiële bestuur op Senior Administrative Officer of gelykwaardige vlak (Salary level 8). Kennis van die Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act. Deeglike kennis van finansiële beleide soos deur Treasury Regulations gelei. Goede kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), beplanning, organisasie, interpersoonlike, probleemoplossing en besluitneming, skakeling en koördinasie, analitiese, projekbestuur en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Vermoë om met ander eenhede van die departement te koördineer. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verleen administratiewe steun aan die Hoofdirektoraat. Beplan, organiseer en beheer administratiewe aktiwiteite wat op die Hoofdirektoraat betrekking het. Bestuur die vloei van dokumente binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker doeltreffende vloei van inligting tussen die Hoofdirektoraat en die hele departement. Administreer die finansies van die Hoofdirektoraat. Koördineer verkrygingsaktiwiteite en help met MTEF-voorleggings. Verleen sekretariaatsteun aan die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker behoorlike koördinasie van vergaderings en verseer tydige indiening van notules en agenda. Bestuur van menslike en fisiese hulpbronne. Verseker behoorlike beheer van verlofrekords, bate-register, verkryging van bates/toerusting ens.

Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle (okuqondwayo nokubhalwayo), ukucubungula, ukuhlela, okomuntu nobunye, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo, ukuxhumana nokuhlelwa kokuhlangenwe imibono, ukuhlaziya, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye namakhono ekhompyutha (MS Office package). Ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimele nangaphansi kwengcindezi. Ikono lokusebenzisana namanye amayunithi e-Department. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.

Phatha ukugeleza kwemibhalo ngaphakathi kweBukho Eliphambili. Qinisekisa ukugeleza okusebenzayo kolwazi phakathi kweBukho Eliphambili naye umnyango wonke. Phatha izimali zeBukho Eliphambili. Qinisekisa ulawulo olulungilekwemibhalo yokuhamba, uhlaziyo lwempahla, ukuthengwa kwempahla/empahla okunjalo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Child Health
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Child Health role in Pretoria coordinating child health policy development and stakeholder engagement for the Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) Certificate and an NQF Level 6 qualification in Health Sciences or a related field, recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). A minimum of three (3) years' experience in a health-related environment, with knowledge and experience in the implementation of the Integrated Management of Childhood Illness (IMCI) strategy. Knowledge of child health programmes, basic financial management, policy development PUBLIC processes, and the relevant health policies and legislative framework. Knowledge and experience in IMCI training methodologies, including online and distance IMCI (DIMCI), and proven skills in facilitation and presentation. Good communication (written and verbal), interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, organisational, management, and computer skills. A valid driver's licence, willingness to travel, and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the development, review and implementation of child health policies, strategies, guidelines, protocols, norms and standards to strengthen child health services; Facilitate stakeholder consultations, technical working groups and intersectoral engagements to inform child health policy, programme planning and implementation. Provide technical support and oversight to provinces on the implementation, monitoring and strengthening of IMCI. and other child health Programmes. Lead initiatives to promote the updating, distribution, utilization and quality improvement of the RTHB. Lead the development and dissemination of advocacy, information, education and communication (IEC) materials, including the design, production and distribution of child health promotional resources. Collaborate with national and international partners, including agencies involved in child health and Early Childhood Development (ECD), and coordinate with relevant directorates and stakeholders to promote an integrated approach to child health service delivery. Monitor and evaluate child health programme performance, including tracking key indicators such as under-five mortality, diarrhoea case fatality rates and pneumonia case fatality rates, and support quality improvement initiatives. Identify, monitor and mitigate programme risks, respond to audit findings and queries, and support the implementation of governance, accountability and risk management measures within the child health programme.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Kindgesondheid
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Kindgesondheid-pos in Pretoria wat die koördinering van kindgesondheidsbeleidontwikkeling en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid vir die Department of Health behels.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (NQF Level 4)-sertifikaat en 'n NQF Level 6-kwalifikasie in Gesondheidswetenskappe of 'n verwante veld, erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in 'n gesondheidsverwante omgewing, met kennis en ervaring in die implementering van die Integrated Management of Childhood Illness (IMCI)-strategie. Kennis van kindgesondheidsprogramme, basiese finansiële bestuur, beleidontwikkelingsprosesse, en die tersaaklike gesondheidsbeleide en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis en ervaring in IMCI-opleidingsmetodes, insluitend aanlyn en afstand-IMCI (DIMCI), en bewese vaardighede in fasilitering en aanbieding. Goeie kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), interpersoonlike, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, organisatoriese, bestuurs- en rekenaarvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie, bereidheid om te reis, en die vermoë om beide onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span doeltreffend te werk.
af.duties: Koördineer die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van kindgesondheidsbeleide, -strategieë, -riglyne, -protokolle, -norme en -standaarde om kindgesondheidsdienste te versterk; Fasiliteer belanghebbende-konsultasies, tegniese werkgroepe en intersektorale betrokkenheid om kindgesondheidsbeleid, programbeplanning en -implementering te inlig. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en toesig aan provinsies oor die implementering, monitering en versterking van IMCI. en ander kindgesondheidsprogramme. Lei inisiatiewe om die bywerking, verspreiding, benutting en gehalteverbetering van die RTHB te bevorder. Lei die ontwikkeling en verspreiding van voorligtings-, inligtings-, opvoedings- en kommunikasie- (IEC) materiaal, insluitend die ontwerp, produksie en verspreiding van kindgesondheidsbevorderingsbronne. Werk saam met nasionale en internasionale vennote, insluitend agentskappe betrokke by kindgesondheid en Early Childhood Development (ECD), en koördineer met tersaaklike direktorate en belanghebbendes om 'n geïntegreerde benadering tot kindgesondheidsdienslewering te bevorder. Monitor en evalueer kindgesondheidsprogramprestasie, insluitend die naspoor van sleutelaanwysers soos sterftes onder vyf jaar, diarree-gevallesterftesyfers en longontsteking-gevallesterftesyfers, en ondersteun gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Identifiseer, monitor en verminder programrisiko's, reageer on ouditbevindings en -navrae, en ondersteun die implementering van bestuurs-, aanspreeklikheids- en risikobestuursmaatreëls binne die kindgesondheidsprogram.

zu.title: Assistant Director: Child Health
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Assistant Director: Child Health ePretoria esihlele ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho yezempilo yezingane kanye nobambiswano ngabathintekanye kanye ne-Department of Health.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 (NQF Level 4) kanye nesidanga se-NQF Level 6 kwezemfundo ezibhekene nezEzulwini noma enzuzweni efanana, esamukelwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Uhubangu ohlangeneyo eminyakeni eyisithupha (3) ukusebenza kwezemfundo eziphathelene nezempilo, okuhlanganisa imininingwano kanye nokusebenza ekuphothulweni kwenkomba ye-Integrated Management of Childhood Illness (IMCI). Imininingwano yemithetho yezempilo yezingane, ukulawula kwezimali ngokuqondile, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqamuleli zabantu, kanye nemithetho kanye nenkambiso ezimpilweni ezibalulekile. Imininingwano kanye nokusebenza kwezindlela zokuqeqesha i-IMCI, okuhlanganisa i-IMCI kwi-inthanethi kanye noma ikude (i-DIMCI), iziphiwo eziqinisekisiwe ekukhuthazeni kanye nokuhlanganisa imininingwane. Iziphiwo ezinhle zokuxhumana (okulotshiwe nokuvezwa ngomlomo), zabantu, ngabathintekayo, zenhlele, zokuphatha, kanye ngekhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela eseziqinisekile, ukuthanda ukuhamba, nothando lokusebenza kahle nawedwa naseqenjini.
zu.duties: Emuncwe ekuthuthukisweni, ukubuyekeleni nokuphothula izinqamuleli, izuha, iziqondiso, amaphrothokholi, amanani kanye namazinga ezempilo yezingane ukuze kuqiniswe izinsiza ezimpilweni zezingane; Kubhekise kubambiswana nabathintekayo, amaqembu okusebenza ngokobuchwepheshe kanye nezinhlangano ezingaphakathi kwemikhakha ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqamuleli, ukuhlelwa kohlaka kanye nokuqaliswa kwenzuzo yezempilo yezingane. Nikeza usizo ngokobuchwepheshe futhi ulawule izifundazwe ekuphothulweni, okuhloliweyo nokwenzeni ngamandla i-IMCI. kanye nezinye izinhlela ezimpilweni yezingane. Holisa izinhlela zokukhuthaza ukubuyekela, ukusabalalisa, ukusetshenziswa nokuthuthukisa izinga le-RTHB. Holisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusabalalisa kweminye yezempilo, imfundo yemininingwano kanye nokuqwashisa (I-IEC), okuhlanganisa ukuklama, ukukhiqiza nokusabalalisa izinsiza zokukhuthaza izempilo zezingane. Sebenzisana nabalingani abangaphakathi nasaphesheya kwezilwandle, okuhlanganisa izinhlangano ezingabalulekwa kwezempilo yezingane kanye Nokuqaliswa kwekhaya lasebuntshatalweni (I-ECD), futhi uhlelise nabahleli abahlobene nabathintekayo ukukhuthaza indlela ehlanganisiwe yokunika insiza yezempilo yezingane. Hlola futhi uhlolisise imiqondo yezinhlela ezimpilweni yezingane, okuhlanganisa ukulandelwa kwezinkomba ezibalulekile njengokushona kwabangaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu, isilinganiso sokufa kwegciwane lesu, kanye nesilinganiso sokufa kwegciwane lesifubesi, futhi useke izinhlela zokuthuthukiswa kwezinga. Qaphula, hlola futhi unciphise izengozi zezinhlela, phendula okutholakele kuhlolo kanye nemibuzo, futhi useke ukuphathwa kwayo, ukubaluleka kanye nezinye izinto ezibhekene nezengozi ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezempilo yezingane.

xh.title: Assistant Director: Child Health
xh.summary: Indima kaMphathi Othunyelwe: Iimpilo zabantwana kwPretoria, oqhubeza izinto ezahlukeneyo ngokulawula inkqubo yamagunya namaziko abanengi
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 (NQF Level 4) nesidanga se-NQF Level 6 kwizifundo ezenza ngempilo ok nawo nawo nawo nawo na apho kusemthethweni ngesiGqeba saase South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Kufuneka kube khona imihla engamathathu (3) eneminyaka engamajoritha apho ukwazile nolwazi ngokusetyenziswa koluhlu lokusingathwa koluhlelo (IMCI). Ulwazi ngamagunya abantwana naZemfundo, ulawulo olusuka kolunxibelelwano, ukwazi ukwenza amagunya amagunya esidango, iinkqubo zoluntu namaziko alawulayo ezempilo. Ulwazi namava ngamava okuqeqesha i-IMCI, kuquka nokuqhuba ngokwenziwa ngenethiwekhi nokwenziwa kude (DIMCI), nakhetho elityhaliweyo ekuthinteleleni nakuboniso. Ulwazi ngokusingathwa kwamandla emali, ukuqeqesha amagunya neziselo ezimali ngokusuka kwinkqubo yamalungu. Isatifikethi seLicense Driver esemthethweni, ukuzimisela ukuhamba, ukunyamezela ukusebenza ngokwakho nakuloqembu.
xh.duties: Qhubeza ukuqeqesha, ukuphonononga nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zamagunya ezempilo zabantwana, iindlela ezisetyenziswayo, iindlela eziyimigcaqo, amagunya, iimigangatho nemigangatho efanelekileyo ukuze kuphuculwe iinkonzo ezempilo zabantwana; Qhuba izindululo phakathi kweentsapho ezithintekayo, amaqela abasebenzi basebuchule nemiboniso phakathi kweenyanga ukuze kuthsonjulwe inkqubo yamagunya ezempilo zabantwana, ulungelelwaniso lweenkqubo nokusebenziswa kwayo. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchule nolawulo olubhekisa kumaphondo malunga nokusebenziswa, ukuqokelela ulwazi nokuphucula i-IMCI. namanqanaba amanye azenkqubo ezempilo zabantwana. Yiba ngumsunguli wamava okhuthaza ukuhlaziiswa, ukusasazwa, ukusetyenziswa nokuphuculwa kwesixa se-RTHB. Qhubeza ukuqeqesha nokusasaza iimpahla zokhuthazo, ulwazi, imfundo nokunxibelelwana (IEC), kuquka ukuqumba, ukwenza nokusasaza iimpahla ezikhuthazayo ezempilo zabantwana. Sebenzisana nabalingani bengingqi nabamhlaba ngamanye, kuquka nabaqeshi abanegalelo ezempilo zabantana nasoPhuhliso lwabantwana basekuqaleni (ECD), uze uqhubeze namabala ohlelo abalulekileyo nabanjiniyeni bazokuze kuthuthuzwe indlela ephathelele iinkonzo ezempilo zabantwana. Qokelela ulwazi lonke ukusebenza kwenkqubo ezempilo zabantwana, kuquka nokulandela izalathiso eziphambili ezinjengokugxotha kwabangaphela kweminyaka emihlanu, isilinganiso sokufa ngxesha lethayi nediseries nezinye izifo ezithwelwa ngumzimba kwaye uncedise ekuphuculweni koluhlu lweemilinganiselo. Phawula, qokelela ulwazi ukujonga nokuthintela iingozi zenkqubo, phendula iimfuno nemibuzo yokujongwa nokuqokelelwa ulwazi, uncedise ekuphuculweni kwenkqubo yokulawula iingozi ezempilo zabantwana.

Ten minste twee (2) jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak in die veld van administrasie en die werk met tenderdokumente. Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van relevante voorskrifte, en toepassing van menslikehulpbronbeleid asook begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. af.title: Fisiese Beheer Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Pretoria soek 'n Fisiese Beheer Veiligheidsbeampte om veiligheidsondersoeke uit te voer, dokumentasie bymekaar te maak, en met belanghebbendes oor kriminele sake te skakel.
af.requirements: Grade 12-sertifikaat (NQF4) en National Diploma (NQF 6)-kwalifikasie in Security Management/Policing of Security Risk Management soos deur SAQA erken as PUBLIC. Grade A PSIRA-sertifikate. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring in sekuriteitsdienste op toesighoudende vlak. Kennis van Minimum Information Security Standard en ander departementele beleide/riglyne en prosedures. Kennis van Financial Management for Managers en departementele rekenaargesteunde bestelstelsel (LOGIS en Doctrack System). Kennis van algemene ondersoekfunksies en sekuriteitsbeleid. Kennis van noodplan met betrekking tot noodsituasies. Kennis van Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993, Criminal Procedure Act en regeringswetgewing. Goede kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), beplanning, organisasie, besluitneming, mensebestuur, ondersoek, aanbieding, interpersoonlike verhoudings, konflikbestuur en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk, asook in 'n span. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Voer 'n voorlopige ondersoek uit voordat 'n lêer/saakdossier geregistreer word. Versamel, verifieer en koördineer inligting en dokumentasie wat vir veiligheidsondersoeke benodig word. Koördineer en skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Skakel met interne belanghebbendes oor kriminele sake, sekuriteitskendinge, verliese, bedrog, korrupsie en wangedrag binne die Department. Koördineer en monitor operasionele en fisiese sekuriteit. Onderhou en beskerm vertroulike sekuriteitslêers, verslae en saakdossiers ooreenkomstig goedgekeurde sekuriteitsprotokolle. Hou toesig oor die implementering van sleutelbeheermaatreëls en verseker nakoming van departementele sleutelbeheerprosedures. Bestuur hulpbronne en ouditnavrae. Skep sekuriteitsregisters vir operasionele en fisiese sekuriteit vir toegangsbeheermaatreëls. Administrasie van menslike hulpbron-aangeleenthede en ander take deur toesighouer opgedra. Koördineer verlofbestuursprosesse en onderhou verlofplanne vir sekuriteitspersoneel.

zu.title: IOfisa Yokuphepha Kolawulo Lwezinto Eziphatwayo
zu.summary: IOfisa Yokuphepha Kolawulo Lwezinto Eziphatwayo kudingwa ngu Department of Health e Pretia ukuthi yenze izinhlobo zocingo lokuphenya ngokuphepha, qoqe imibhalo yemibhalo, futhi uxhumane nabantu abathintekayo ezindabeni eziphatelene nobugebengu.

Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kuwo amasevisi okuphepha ezingeni labaphathi. ulwazi ngo Minimum Information Security Standard namanye amapholisi/ Iinkomba zomnyango nendlela yokwenza. ulwazi nge Financial Management for Managers ngesistimu yokulawula ngekhompyutha yomnyango (LOGIS and Doctrack System). ulwazi ngemisebenzi yocingo lomubuzo jikelele nepholisi lokuphepha. ulwazi ngephulani lesimo esibucayi ngokuphatelene nezimo eziphuthumayo. ulwazi ngo Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993, Criminal Procedure Act nomthetho kahulumeni. ukuxhumana okuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe), ukuhlela, ukuqamba, ukwenza izinqumo, ukulawula abantu, ucingo lomubuzo, okubonakalayo, izinkinga zokuqondana, ukuphatha izinkinga namakhono ekhompyutha (MS Office package). ukuthi ukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nangaphansi kwegxa, kanye nakuqembu. ilayiseni yomshayeli egunyaziwe.
zu.duties: Yenza ucingo lokuqala lokuphenya ngaphambi kokuqamba ifayela/ isikhululu senkulumo. Qoqa, qinisekisa, futhi uhlele ulwazi nemibhalo edingekayo kocingo lokuphenya ngokuphepha. Hlela futhi uxhumane nabantu abathintekayo ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Xhumana nabantu abathintekayo ngaphakathi ezindabeni eziphatelene nobugebengu, ukuwohloka kokuphepha, ukulahlekelwa, ukukhwabanisa, ukuphanga, nokuwohloka kwendlela yokuziphatha ngaphakathi kwi Department. Hlela futhi ulawule ukuphepha kokusebenza nokuphepha kwezinto eziphatwayo. Gcina futhi uvikele amafayela okuphepha afigaziwe, imibiko, nezikhululu zenkulumo ngokuvumelana nezipholise ezamukele zokuphepha. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokulawula amakhhi futhi qinisekisa ukuzinikezela kwezinyathelo zomnyango zokulawula amakhhi. Phatha amas ngamaphuphu baka. Dala izibhalo zokuphepha ukusetshenziswa kokuphepha kwezinto eziphatwayo ngezigaba zokulawula ukungena. Ukuphatha izindaba zezinsiza zabantu kanye neminye imisebenzi ebanjwe umphathi. Hlela izinqubo zokuqamba imigqa futhi gcina imigqa yokuphumela yabasebenzi bokuphepha.

xh.title: Isikhululi Sokhuseleko Lokulawula Iinto
xh.summary: Isikhululi Sokhuseleko Lokulawula Iinto sifunwa yi Department of Health e Pretoria ukwenza uphando lokhuseleko, ukuqokelela uxwebhu, nokuqhathanisa nabanomdla kwiimeko zobugebengu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se Grade 12 (NQF4) nesidanga se National Diploma (NQF 6) kwi Security Management/ Policing okanye Security Risk Management njengokuvunywa yi SAQA. Iisatifikethi ze Grade A PSIRA. Ubuncinane iiminyaka elithathu (3) zemfundo ezisezinkonzeni zokhuseleko kwinqanaba lomlawuli. Ulwazi malunga ne Minimum Information Security Standard namanye amapoliisi/iindlela zesebe nendlela zokwenza izinto. Ulwazi malunga ne Financial Management for Managers nenkqubo yokuthengela ngekhompyutha yesebe (LOGIS and Doctrack System). Ulwazi malunga nemisebenzi jikelele yophando nepoliisi yokhuseleko. Ulwazi malunga necebo lokubhalisa ngenkulungwane ephuthumayo. Ulwazi malunga ne Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993, Criminal Procedure Act nomthetho kahulumeni. Amandla okunxibelelanaxa (ngomlomo nangokubhalayo), ucwangciso, ukuqamba, ukwenza izigqibo, ulawulo lwabantu, uphando, okubonwayo, ubudlelwane nabantu, ulawulo lweengxabano namandla ekhompyutha (MS Office package). Amandla okusebenzela kodwa nangaphantsi koxinzelelo, kunye nalawulo olusebenza njengesiqhema. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando lwangaphambili phambi kokubhalisa ifayili/idosiyi yecala. Qokelela, qinisekisa, ze uqhagamshele iinkcukacha nomaxwebhu afunekayo kuphando lokhuseleko. Qhagamshele oxide ngabanomdla baphakathi nangaphandle. Qhagamshela nabomdla baphakathi kwiimeko zobugebengu, ukuphuka kokhuseleko, iintsengo, ukulunga, ukonakaliswa, nosulelo kwi Department. Qhagamsheleze ulawule ukhuseleko lokusebenza nolwezinto ezibonakalayo. Gcina ugcine ngokukhuselekileyo iifayili ezimfihlo zokhuseleko, iingxelo, namadosiyi ezimeko ngokwesigqibo esamkelekileyo sokhuseleko. Lawula ukuSetyenziiswa kwezinto zolawulo lwamagungqwana uqinisekise ukuzithobela iinkqubo zolawulo lamagungqwana zesebe. Lawula izibonelelo nemibuzo yokuhlola. Udidiyo lwezarejista zokhuseleko ngeenjongo zokusebenza nokukhuseleka iinto ezibonakalayo ngenjongo zolawulo lokungena. Ulawulo lweemikhonzo zabantu neminye imisebenzi eyinikwe ngumlawuli. Qhagamshele iinkqubo zolawulo lokushiya ugcine iinkqubo zokushiya kwabasebenzi bokhuseleko.

Ukuphatha irejista leposi, ukwamukela, ukubhalisa kanye nokusabalalisa amadokhumenti kubantu abahambisana naleso kanye phakathi kwedirekhetha. Ukuphatha imisebenzi yolawulo lwamabalulelane. Ukuphatha, ukubuyekeza kanye nokulawula wonke amarekhista abasebenzi ngokuhamba emsebenzini, ukuqeqeshwa, izilinganiso kanye nokukhushulwa. Ukusiza ekuphathweni kwesabelomali sedirekhetha kanye nesibonelelo esinemibandela. Ukulungisa imibiko yemali echithiweyo kanye nokusiza ekwabeleni isabelomali imisebenzini ekuhlelweni lokusebenza. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlela izinkomfa, amaseminari, imisebenzi, indawo yokuhlala kanye nokuhamba abasebenzi. Ukubeka amafomu kanye nokuphatha izinkokhela zamaseminari, ukudleka, izinkomfa kanye nokudleka komnyango.

Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwendlela yokubhala iifayile. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okukhuselekileyo kolwazi noluxwebhu. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo lweemihlangano, amashishini, imisebenzi, indawo yokuhlola nokuhamba kubaphathi. Ukubeka iiodolo nokuphatha intlawulo yamashishini, ukutya, iimihlangano nokuzonwabisa kwisebe.

Ukuthuthukisa iziphakamiso zamaphrojekthi, izinhlobo zamabhizinisi kanye nezinhlelo zokuphothula izinhlelo ezihamisana. Ukusiza ekusekelweni nasekomelezeni kwezobudlelwano nobuhle obuphakathi kwamabhizinisi, uhulumeni kanye nama-organizations afanele. Ukuqhamisa amathuba okukhiqiza inzuzo kwaye nokufundisa ngokusebenzelisana kumsebenzi. Ukulawula izobudlelwano kahulumeni wendawo nowesifundazwe kwaye ugcine isheduli yamaphrojekthi ahlobene nenhle. Amakhona aphezulu ekuxoxweni ngenkqubo yokubonisana, ekuthunyelweni kolwazi, ekulawuleni amashishino, ekuqokelelweni kwakho nasekuchazweni iziganeko kubakho ulwazi olucacileyo.

Phuhliza iinkcazelo zamaprojekthi, iinqobo zoshishino neeplani zokuzezelwa ezenziwa ngokubambisana. Qedelela ukusekwa nokuqiniswa kweentengiselwano noshishino, urhulumente namanxibelelo ahambelana nayo. Chaza amathuba okwenza imali nokuqhelwa kwabafundi ngakwinkqubo yomsebenzi. Lungiselela ukungeniswa kwamatendi, iinkqubo zemali ekunikelwa kuyo neengxelo kwi-DHET nakwabanye abathathi nxaxheba. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwemali abantu kwaye kwezinye iinkcukacha ngaphakathi kwesebe.
