Applicants must have a recognised National Diploma (NQF Level 6)/ Degree recognised by SAQA in Supply Chain Management, Logistics Management or a related field. Three (3) to Five (5) years’ experience at supervisory level on a salary level 7 or 8 in Supply Chain Management, specifically in tender processes and logistics management, is required. The candidate must have in-depth knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Treasury Regulations, the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE) Act, and the Supply Chain Management Framework. A comprehensive understanding of the entire supply chain cycle, including demand planning, acquisition, logistics, asset disposal, and supplier relationship management, is essential, along with knowledge of asset management practices and National Treasury guidelines. The ideal candidate must demonstrate advanced administrative, planning, and organisational skills, as well as competencies in financial management, report writing, and project coordination. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and excellent communication and interpersonal skills are critical. Proficiency in relevant computer applications, client-focused service delivery, leadership, and effective team and people management are expected. High levels of integrity, professionalism, technical expertise, and a commitment to service excellence are key attributes required for this role.

This includes ensuring effective provisioning, procurement, stock control, and reporting processes, while conducting policy awareness across the College. The incumbent will oversee the procurement of goods and services, ensuring compliance with SCM procedures, timely authorisation of official orders, alignment of procurement plans with the College’s budget, and proper documentation of all purchasing activities. The role also includes the administration of demand and acquisition management, coordinating tender processes, supporting bid specification, evaluation, and adjudication committees, and ensuring that procurement is aligned with preferential procurement objectives. The candidate will further be responsible for managing the College’s asset portfolio by maintaining an accurate and up-to-date asset register, ensuring the barcoding of assets, verifying asset movement, and facilitating asset disposals in line with policies. In addition, the incumbent will oversee the development and maintenance of a secure and current supplier database, monitor supplier compliance, and ensure records are properly maintained. The role also entails the management and supervision of staff within the unit, ensuring performance agreements are in place, and supporting staff development in accordance with institutional performance management systems.

af.requirements: Die kandidaat moet 'n relevante Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 / NCV-sertifikaat (Vlak 4) hê. Aansoekers moet 'n erkende Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) / Graad erken deur SAQA in Voorsieningskettingbestuur, Logistieke Bestuur of 'n verwante veld hê. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op toesighoudende vlak op 'n salarisvlak 7 of 8 in Voorsieningskettingbestuur, spesifiek in tenderprosesse en logistieke bestuur, word vereis. Die kandidaat must diepgaande kennis hê van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Treasury Regulations, die Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE) Act, en die Voorsieningskettingbestuur-raamwerk. 'n Omvattende begrip van die hele voorsieningskettingsiklus, insluitend vraagbeplanning, verkryging, logistiek, bate-ontslag, en verskaffersverhoudingsbestuur, is noodsaaklik, tesame met kennis van batebestuurspraktyke en National Treasury-riglyne. Die ideale kandidaat must gevorderde administratiewe, beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede toon, asook bevoegdhede in finansiële bestuur, verslagskrywing, en projekoördinatie. Sterk analitiese denke, probleemoplossingsvermoëns, en uitnemende kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike vaardighede is krities. Bedryfsheed in relevante rekenaartoepassings, kliëntgerigte dienslewering, leierskap, en effektiewe span- en mensebestuur word verwag. Hoë vlakke van integriteit, professionaliteit, tegniese kundigheid, en 'n toewyding aan diensuitnemendheid is sleutelkenmerke wat vir hierdie rol vereis word.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die ontwikkeling, implementering, hersiening, en monitering van Voorsieningskettingbestuur (VKB)-beleid in ooreenstemming met relevante wetgewing en regulasies. Dit sluit in die versekering van effektiewe voorsiening, verkryging, voorraadbeheer, en verslagdoeningsprosesse, terwyl beleidsbewustheid dwarsoor die College uitgevoer word. Die ampsdraar sal toesien oor die verkryging van goedere en dienste, en verseker nakoming van VKB-prosedures, tydige magtiging van amptelike bestellings, belyning van verkrygingsplanne met die College se begroting, en behoorlike dokumentasie van alle aankoopaktiwiteite. Die rol sluit ook in die administrasie van vraag- en verkrygingsbestuur, die koördineer van tenderprosesse, die ondersteuning van bodspesifikasie-, evaluerings- en uitspraakkomitees, en die versekering dat verkryging belyn is met voorkeurverkrygingsdoelwitte. Die kandidaat sal verder verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur van die College se bateportefeulje deur 'n akkurate en op-datum bate-register te handhaaf, die versekering van die strookkodering van bates, die verifiëring van batebeweging, en die fasilitering van bate-ontslae in ooreenstemming met beleid. Daarbenewens sal die ampsdraar toesien oor die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van 'n veilige en huidige verskaffersdatabasis, verskaffersnakoming monitor, en verseker dat rekords behoorlik gehandhaaf word. Die rol behels ook die bestuur en toesig van personeel binne die eenheid, die versekering dat prestasieooreenkomste in plek is, en die ondersteuning van personeelontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met institutionele prestasiebestuurstelsels.

zu.title: Onxantsumi: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zokulethwa Nempahla
zu.summary: Onxantsumi wokuphathwa kwezinsiza zokulethwa nempahla ehhovini likamqondo le Ingwe TVET College, odinga idiploma nokuqashwa kwabantu ngomphathi kwindlela yokuphathwa kwezinto ezithunyelwa emzamweni wokuqasha.
zu.requirements: Umphathi kufanele abe ne-Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4) ehambisana nalokhu. Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6)/ Degree evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwindlela yokuphathwa kwezinsiza zokulethwa, ukuphathwa kwezidingo noma indawo efanayo. Kudingeka abe namava eminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kwemihlanu (5) ezingeni lomphathi ohola kwizinga 7 noma 8 ekuqashweni kwemisebenzi, ikakhulu kumasinga amathuba amakhulu okungenisa izinkambu kanye nokuphathwa kwezidingo. Umuntu oqashwayo kufunke azi kahle i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), imithetho ye-Treasury Regulations, i-Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE) Act, kanye nezindinganiso zokuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Kubalulekile ukuba aqonde ngokugcwele isikhathi esihamba ngokuphathwa kwezinsiza zokulethwa, okuhlanganisa ukuhlelwa kwemfuno, ukufinyelela imali etholakalayo, izidingo, ukuphathwa kwempahla, kanye nokuqashwa kwabathengisi, kanti futhi alwazi ngendlela yokuphathwa kwempahla nemithelela ye-National Treasury. Umuntu oqashwayo kufanele abe nobuhlakani obuhle bokubhala, ukuhlela, nokuhlelela imisebenzi, kanye nobuhlakani ekuphathweni kwemali, ukubhala imibiko, nasekuqashweni kwemigqa yomsebenzi. Ukugxeka ngokucabanga, ukusombulula izinkinga, kanye nokuqasha nokuqondana ngokuphathwa okuhle kubalule kakhulu. Kulindelekile ukuba azi kahle izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuletha izidingo ngokwegxalo labathengi, ukukhonza abantu, kanye nokuphathwa kwabanini bomsebenzi kanye nabantu abangaphansi kwabo. Izici ezibalulekile kulesi sikhundla zihlanganisa ukuba nomfanekiso omuhle wokuzethemba, ukusebenza ngobungcweti, ulwazi lwemfundi, kanye nokuzibophezela ekuletheni izinto ezingcono kubathengi.
zu.duties: Umphathi ophumelelayo uzobhekene nokuhlela, ukuphatha, ukubuka kabusha, futhi alolule imithetho yokuphathwa kwezinsiza zokulethwa ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemithelela ekhona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemali ezingeni eliphezulu, ukuthenga, ukulawula izinkomba zemali, kanye nemibiko, kanti futhi kwakhiwa ngokwazi ngale mithetho kulo lonke iKolishi. Umphathi uzobheka ukuthenga impahla kanye nemisebenzi, aqinisekise ukulandelwa kwemithetho yokuphathwa kwezinsiza, ukuvuma ngokushesha izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuhambisana izinkomba zokuthenga nomgogodla weKolishi, futhi aqophe ngokufanele konke ukusebenza kokuthenga. Lomsebenzi futhi uhlanganisa ukuphathwa kokwemfuno nethuba lokutholakala, ukuqasha izinkomba zokuthengisa imisebenzi, ukusekela amakomidi we-bid specification, evaluation, and adjudication, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthenga kuhambisana nemithelela yokuthengisa okukhethiwe. Umphathi uzobe nephakade ekuphathweni kwempahla yeKolishi ngokugcina inkomba yempahla eqinisekisiwe nelayisiwe, nasekuqinisekiseni ukubholidwa kwempahla, ukuqinisekisa isikhathi semali, futhi akhohlise ukuphathwa kokuqothulwa kwempahla ngokuhambisana nemithetho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphathi uzobheka ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokugcinwa kwegqazi eliphephile futhi elifanele labathengisi, okubheka ukuthi abathengisi bayayilandela imithetho, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi agcinwe kahle. Lomsebenzi futhi uhlanganisa ukuphathwa nokubhekana nabantu abangaphansi kwalomnyango, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunezinkomba zomsebenzi ezibekiwe, nokusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu ngokuvumelana nezinhlelo zokuphathwa komsebenzi kusikhungo.

xh.title: Umlawuli ongumncedisi: Ulawulo lwoqoqosho lamacebo nokulawula iimpahla
xh.summary: Umlawuli ongumncedisi woLawulo lwoqoqosho lamacebo nokulawula iimpahla kwindlu enkulu yemibhalo ye-Ingwe TVET College, efuna idiploma nemfunwano yamava kwimisebenzi yokulawula i-SCM.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umntu ofaneleyo abe ne-Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). Kufuneka abafaki bele benazo i-National Diploma (NQF Level 6)/ Degree ezaziwayo yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management, i-Logistics Management okanye kwicala elinxulumene nalo. Kufuneka abe namava eminyaka elithoba (3) ukuya kwelihlanu (5) kumgca wolawuli kwinqanaba lomvuzo 7 okanye 8 kwi-Supply Chain Management, ngokukodwa kwiinkqubo zithengiso nokulawulwa kwe-logistics. Kufuneka umgqatswa abe nolwazi oluqinileyo nge-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), i-Treasury Regulations, i-Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE) Act, kunye ne-Supply Chain Management Framework. Kuyimfuneko kuqonde kakuhle umjikelo wonke wolawulo lwoqoqosho lwamacebo, kuquka uqhelaniso lwemfuno, ukufumana izinto, i-logistics, ukuyahlulela iimpahla, kunye nokulawulwa kobudlelwane nabahanjisi things, kunye nolwazi malunga nokulawulwa kweempahla kunye neengcebiso ze-National Treasury. Umgqatswa oqileleyo kufuneka abonise amakhono aphambili okulawula, uqhelaniso, kunye nokuhlelwa kweenkqubo, kunye nobuchule ekulawulweni zemali, ekubhalweni kweengxelo, nakwindibano yamaprojekthi. Ukucinga okuqinisekileyo, amandla okusombulula iingxaki, kunye namakhono amakhulu othungelwano nabantu babalule kakhulu. Kulindelekile ukuba bagqone ekusebenziseni izicelo zekhompyutha ezifanelekileyo, ukubonelela ngenkonzo ejqikelela umnxuni, ukuba ngabakhokeli, kwaye balawule iqela nabantu ngokuchanekileyo. Amaqondo aphakamileyo yokuzithemba, ukuba ngumuntu wezifundo, uchwanguliswe ngobugcibo obutswayo, kwaye uzibophelele ekuphumeleleni kwenkonzo ngokuchanekileyo ngamagunya abalulekileyo kwesi sithuba.
xh.duties: Umgqatswa opumelelayo uya kuba nawo umrhumo wokuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa, okokucoca kunye nokulawula iinkqubo (SCM) kumalungiselelo amacebo ngokwemigaqo-sisiseko kunye nemigaqo ethize. Oku kuquka ukuqinisekisa ukubonelela ngokuchanekileyo, ukuthenga, ukulawula isitokhwe, kunye nemisebenzi yokwenziwa kweengxelo, ngelixa usenza ingqiqis malunga nemigaqo-sisiseko kuyo yonke i-College. Umntu ofaneleyo uya kulawula ukuthengwa kweempahla kunye neenkonzo, aze aqinisekise ukuzinikela kumanyathiso e-SCM, igunya elibonelelayo ngoxesha elongezileyo lezidalidi ezisemthethweni, ulungelelwaniso lweenkqubo zokuthenga jike ngebhajeti ye-College, nokubhalwa kakuhle kwezenzo zonke zokuthenga. Esi sithuba sijonga nangokulawula imfuno nokufumana izinto ngokulawulwayo, ulungelelwaniso lweenkqubo zokuthengiswa, inkxaso kumagqabi eemviwo eebhodi ezikhankanye iinkalo ezithile, ziqhutywa zifunyaniswe igunya kwikomiti yokuqikelela nokunika amaxwebhu, iqinisekisa ukuba ukuthengwa kolungelelaniswe nengqikelelo ekuthengeni okukhethwa ngokuthandwa. Umgqatswa oya kuba nomrhumo walawula iqela leempahla zekholishi ngokugcina uludwe oluchanekileyo nolusasayiyo kwexesha elifanelekileyo malunga neempahla, aqinisekise izikhowudi zamacebo athengiswayo, aqinise isihamba sempahla, aphuhliswe inkqubo yokuqwalasela iimpahla ezingasetyenziswa ngokulandela imigaqo-sisiseko. Ukongezelela, umntu ofaneleyo uya kujonga ukuphuhliswa nokugcinwa koludwe olukhuselekileyo nolusasayiyo lwabanikazi, alawule ukuzinikela kwabanikazi kumigaqo-sisiseko, aze aqinisekise ukuba amagatya agcinwe ngokufanelekileyo. Esi sithuba siquka nokuqwalasela kunye nokuqgibha igqiba ekulawulweni abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwecandelo, aqinisekise isivumelwano ngokusebenza kwabo sisezantsi, anxaxele inkqubo ekuphuhlisweni kwabo ngokulandela iinkqubo zolawulo-msebenzi.

jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Administer Employee Health and Wellness programmes at the Department of Higher Education and Training's central office, requiring a degree in psychology or social work.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate recognised Bachelor’s Degree (NQF7) n Psychology or BA Social Work (Major in Psychology) or Sports Science, or equivalent qualification Valid driver’s license. Computer proficiency (MS office Suits). 1-2 years in Employee Health and Wellness environment or related field. Knowledge of integrated Employee and Wellness strategic framework. Understanding of Wellness Management including psychosocial, physical, financial and organisational wellness. Understanding of HIV/AIDS and TB Management. Understanding Health and Productivity, including PILLIR, Understanding Safety Health Environment, and Risk Quality Management including processes of COIDA. In depth knowledge in conducting counselling. Understanding of special programmes such as Gender and Disability. Knowledge and understanding of research methods. Knowledge of PERSAL. Client oriented. Project management. Team leadership. People management and Presentation. Values/ attributes: Client focus; integrity; Committed; Proactive; Loyal and Ethics.
jobs.duties: Provide Effective and efficient administrative support in the implementation of Employee Health and Wellness strategic framework. Provide support in the implementation of Employee Wellness programme service. Provide effective and efficient administrative support in the mitigation of the impact on HIV/ AIDS, TB and STI epidemic in the college. Provide logistical support in commemoration of HIV/ AIDS, STI and TB events in accordance with the nation strategic plan. Provide effective and efficient administrative support.

Waardes/kenmerke: Kliëntfokus; integriteit; Toegewyd; Proaktief; Loyaal en Etiek.
af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende en doeltreffende administratiewe ondersteuning by die implementering van die strategiese raamwerk vir Werknemergesondheid en Welstand. Verskaf ondersteuning by die implementering van die Werknemerswelstandsprogramdiens. Verskaf doeltreffende en doeltreffende administratiewe ondersteuning by die matiging van die impak van die MIV/VIGS-, TB- en SOI-epidemie in die kollege. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuning by die herdenking van MIV/VIGS-, SOI- en TB-gebeurtenisse in ooreenstemming met die nasionale strategiese plan. Verskaf doeltreffende en doeltreffende administratiewe ondersteuning.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Management Accounting
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package that needs to be structured)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role at the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion, managing the Management Accounting Sub-directorate with budgeting, expenditure monitoring and financial reporting responsibilities.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), Bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) in Financial Management / Accounting / Cost and Management Accounting / Commerce / Financial Accounting / Public Finance or an equivalent financial qualification recognised by SAQA. Minimum 5 years' experience in Management Accounting, Financial Accounting or Financial Management environment. At least 3 years' experience at Assistant Director level or equivalent supervisory/junior management level. Experience managing budgeting processes. Experience in expenditure analysis and reporting. Experience in public sector financial accounting and financial planning. Skills and competencies: financial management, strategic planning, budget management, financial analysis, report writing, project management, leadership and people management, problem solving, communication skills, analytical thinking, change management, presentation skills, stakeholder management, computer literacy and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the Management Accounting Sub-directorate and providing strategic financial management support through the coordination and management of budgeting, planning, expenditure monitoring, cash flow management, financial reporting, adjustments budgeting, virement processes and financial analysis in support of JICS. Coordinate the annual budget process, Medium-Term Expenditure Framework submissions and adjusted estimates; analyse expenditure trends and budget pressures; prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports; monitor cash flow requirements and commitments; advise programme managers on budget utilisation and corrective measures; manage virements, rollovers and shifting of funds; To provide financial accounting services through the preparation of interim and annual financial statements. Ensure compliance with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Modified Cash Standards (MCS) and departmental financial prescripts; Participate in internal and external audit processes, provide information required by auditors, support the implementation of audit recommendations, and maintain adequate financial records and supporting documentation for audit and compliance purposes. Supervise staff, manage performance and ensure accurate records, audit files and financial information are maintained for decision and reporting.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Bestuursrekenkunde
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos by die Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion, wat die Bestuursrekenkunde Subdirektoraat bestuur met verantwoordelikhede vir begroting, bestedingmonitering en finansiële verslagdoening.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12 (Senior Certificate), Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) in Finansiële Bestuur / Rekenkunde / Koste- en Bestuursrekenkunde / Handel / Finansiële Rekenkunde / Openbare Finansies of 'n ekwivalente finansiële kwalifikasie erken deur SAQA. Minimum 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n Bestuursrekenkunde-, Finansiële Rekenkunde- of Finansiële Bestuursomgewing. Ten minste 3 jaar se ervaring op Assistent-direkteurvvlak of ekwivalente toesigtige/junior bestuursvlak. Ervaring in die bestuur van begrotingsprosesse. Ervaring in bestedingsontleding en verslagdoening. Ervaring in openbare-sektor finansiële rekenkunde en finansiële beplanning. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: finansiële bestuur, strategiese beplanning, begrotingsbestuur, finansiële ontleding, verslagskrywing, projekbestuur, leierskap en personeelbestuur, probleemoplossing, kommunikasievaardighede, analitiese denke, veranderingsbestuur, aanbiedingsvaardighede, belanghebbende-bestuur, rekenaarvaardigheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur van die Bestuursrekenkunde Subdirektoraat en die verskaffing van strategiese finansiële bestuurstegniese ondersteuning deur die koördinering en bestuur van begroting, beplanning, bestedingmonitering, kontantvloei-bestuur, finansiële verslagdoening, bygestelde begroting, oorboekingsprosesse en finansiële ontleding ter ondersteuning van JICS. Koördineer die jaarlikse begrotingsproses, Medium-Term Expenditure Framework voorleggings en aangepaste raming; ontled bestedingstendense en begrotingsdruk; berei maandelikse en kwartaalwiese finansiële verslae voor; monitor kontantvloei-behoeftes en verbintenis; adviseer programbestuurders oor begrotingsbenutting en korrektiewe maatreëls; bestuur oorboekings, deurrolfondse en verskuiwing van fondse; Verskaf finansiële rekenkundige dienste deur die opstel van tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state. Verseker nakoming van die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, Modified Cash Standards (MCS) en departementele finansiële voorskifte; Neem deel aan interne en eksterne ouditprosesse, verskaf inligting wat deur ouditeure benodig word, ondersteun die implementering van ouditaanbevelings, en handhawe toereikende finansiële rekords en ondersteunende dokumentasie vir oudit- en nakomingsdoeleindes. Sien toe op personeel, bestuur werksprestasie en verseker dat akkurate rekords, ouditlêers en finansiële inligting gehandhaaf word vir besluitneming en verslagdoening.

zu.title: IPhini Likadirekhtha: I-Management Accounting
zu.summary: Isikhundla sePhini Likadirekhtha e-Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services e-Centurion, okubandakanya ukuphatha i-Management Accounting Sub-directorate ngesibopho sabathengi, sokuqapha ukuchithwa kwemali nokubika kwemali.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izifiso kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), iziqu ze-Bachelor's degree (NQF 7) ku-Financial Management / Accounting / Cost and Management Accounting / Commerce / Financial Accounting / Public Finance noma isifanekisimabhalo esihlobene semali esivunyelwe yi-SAQA. Kumele babe nokuhlangenwe nakho okungu-5 iminyaka kumasimu we-Management Accounting, Financial Accounting noma Financial Management. Kumele babe nokuhlangenwe nakho okungaphezulu konyaka o-3 bukhoma ezingeni lomphathi ongumncedi noma ezingeni eliphezulu lokubusa. Kumele kube nokuhlangenwe nakho ekuphathweni kwenqubo yabathengi. Kumele kube nokuhlangenwe nakho ekuhloleni nokubika ngemali echithiwe. Kumele kube nokuhlangenwe nakho ekuqapheleni imali yenhlangano kahulumeni nasekuhleleni imali. Ikhono namakhono: ukulawula imali, ukuhlela okubalulekile, ukulawula abathengi, ukuhlola imali, ukubika, ukulawula izinhlelo, ukubusa nokuphatha abantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuxoxa, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukulawula izinguquko, amakhono okuhlatshulwa, ukulawula abahlanganyeli, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nenhlanhla yokusebenza ngabanye nangaphakathi kwenhlangano.
zu.duties: Umuntu okhethwe uzoba nobume bokuphatha i-Management Accounting Sub-directorate nezeze imali emabhange ngokuhlanganisa nokuphatha abathengi, ukuhlela, ukuqapha imali echithiwe, ukulawula imali ephumayo, ukubika kwemali, ukulungisa abathengi abasha, izinqubo zokushintsha imali nokuhlola imali ukuze kusize i-JICS. Kumele ahlanganyele ekubhukweni kwabathengi abayisikhathi eside, akhombise izincomo ze-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework nezilinganiso ezilungisiwe; ahlole imali echithwa nezinkinga zabathengi; alungise izibalo zomholo wezinyanga futhi abike ngemva kwesikhathi esithile; aqaphe ukuthi imali iyadinga futhi yasho ukwenza okuthile; axele abaphathi bahlele ukuthi basebenzise imali kanjani nokulungisa izinto; aphathe ukushintsha, ukuhambahamba nokushintsha imali; wokuhlinzeka ngesevisi yemabhange ngokulungisa izibalo zabathengi abasemandulo nabasenhlanganweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana ne-PFMA, izimiso ze-Treasury, i-Modified Cash Standards (MCS) nezimiso zocwaningo zezezimali lapha kulesi sikhungo; ukubamba iqhaza kocwaningo lwangaphakathi nangaphandle, ukwazisa abacwaningi ngokudingeka kwabo, ukusekela ukusetshenziswa kwezinsodo zocwaningo, nokugcina imibhalo yemali nemibhalo engcwele yokuxhasa ukuze kwenziwe ocwaningweni nasekuqinisekiseni ukuthi kuhamba ngaphansi kwemithetho. Kumele aphathe abasebenzi, aqaphe ukuthi basebenza kahle futhi aqinisekise ukuthi kugcinwa imibhalo eminingi yocwaningo nemininingwane yemali yokwenza izinqumo nokubika.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: EzabaloBhatalo zoLawulo
xh.summary: Indima yesekela mongameli kwiJudicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services eCenturion, elawula iNqalaba yeNqanaba elingezantsi yeBaloLimali zoLawulo eneemfuno zobugcisa bezimali, okuqwalaselwa kokuchithwa kwemali nokuxela ngezimali.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe neGrade 12 (Senior Certificate), izidanga zeBachelor (NQF 7) kwiFinancial Management / Accounting / Cost and Management Accounting / Commerce / Financial Accounting / Public Finance okanye isidanga esilinganayo sezimali esamkelwe yiSAQA. Kufuneka kube khona ubugcisa obungaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 kwindawo yeManagement Accounting, Financial Accounting okanye Financial Management. Ubugcisa obungaphantsi kweminyaka emi-3 kwinqanaba laseka mongameli okanye esilinganayo kunqanaba lokuqondisa/elingangeniyo. Ubugcisa bolawula iinkqubo zobugcisa bezimali. Ubugcisa bokuhlalutya nokuxela ngokuchithwa kwemali. Ubugcisa kwibalobhaloabezimali bolawulo lwentlu kunezicwangciso ezimalini. Amakhono namandla: ulawulo lwemali, uqwalaselo olusisigqibo, ulawulo lobugcisa bezimali, uhlalutyo lwezimali, ukubhala iingxelo, ulawulo lweenkqubo, amandla okuhola nokulawula abantu, ukuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono edidia, okucinga ngokutahlula, ulawulo lootshintsho, amakhono okubonisa, ulawulo lwabo babanikiweyo, ulwazi lokusebenza ngemekileyo nako kukwazi ukusebenza bodwa nakwilqela.
xh.duties: Umphathi ophumeleleyo uya kuba nenxaxheba ekulawuleni iNqanaba elingezantsi leBaloLimali zoLawulo kanjalo noku nikezela ngenkxaso ebalulekileyo yolawulo lwemali ngokwenzululwazi nokulawula kobugcisa bezimali, okuqwalaselwa, okuqwalaselwa kokuchithwa kwemali, ulawulo lwemali egqitha lilixa, ukuxela ngezimali, okulungelelisanisa kobugcisa bezimali, iinkqubo zokudlulisa imali nohlalutyo lwezimali enxaxhebeni yeJICS. Ulungelelisanise inkqubo yebhajeti yonyaka, iingeniselo zeMedium-Term Expenditure Framework nezilinganiso ezilungisiweyo; hlalutya iintshukumo zokuchithwa kwemali ngecindezelwa zobugcisa bezimali; lukhokele iingxelo zemali ezinyanga nezinyanga ezithathu; qwalasela iimfuno zemali egqitha lilixa nokuqinisekiswa; yala abaphathi benkqubo ngokusetyenziswa kobugcisa bezimali ngezinyathelo zokulungisa; lawula ukudluliswa kwemali, ukujikelwa kwayo nokushifwa kwemali; Ukunikezela iinkonzo zebalobhalobezimali ngokulungiselelwa iingxelo eziseluxeshana nezonyaka zeziimali. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iPFMA, iTreasury Regulations, iModified Cash Standards (MCS) nezibhalo ezibalulekileyo ezimali zesebe; Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuqwalaselwa ezingaphakathi nangaphandle, nikezela ulwazi olufunwa ngabo bagqithisa iinkqubo zokuqwalaselwa, xhasa ukusebenzisa iingcebiso zabo bagqithisa iinkqubo zokuqwalaselwa, zigcine iirekhodi ezaneleyo zezimali namaxwebhu axhasayo ngenjongo zokuqwalaselwa nokuthobela. Qondisa abasebenzi, lawula ukusebenza kwabo ukuze kuqiniseke iirekhodi ezicoyitwayo, iifayile zokuqwalaselwa nolwazi olumayela nezimali zondliwe ngenjongo yokwenza izigqibo nokuxela.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Information and Communication
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package that needs to be structured)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Information and Communication at the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion, managing ICT environment, policies, infrastructure and cybersecurity at salary level 11.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), National Diploma / Bachelor’s degree (NQF 6) in Information Technology / Computer Science / Information Systems / Informatics / Information Management/ICT Management / Software Development / Network Engineering or an equivalent ICT-related qualification recognised by SAQA. Certifications in ITIL and/or COBIT will serve as an advantage. 3 to 5 years' experience in an ICT environment. At least 3 years' experience at Assistant Director level or equivalent supervisory / junior management level. Experience managing ICT projects, supervising ICT personnel, managing ICT service providers and contracts, and administering ICT infrastructure and information systems. Experience in Public Service ICT environment, SITA-related processes, PUBLIC cybersecurity management, Microsoft 365 administration, ICT governance and compliance, and digital transformation initiatives will be advantageous. Skills and competencies: contract management, leadership and people management, negotiation skills, policy interpretation, report writing, communication skills, project management, analytical thinking, problem solving, stakeholder management, presentation skills, computer literacy and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and State Information Technology Agency (SITA) Act.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and maintaining the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) environment of JICS through the implementation of ICT policies, systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity controls, user support services and digital solutions in support of the organisational mandate. Manage ICT governance, operational planning, ICT risk and compliance reporting; oversee network, server, end-user and Microsoft 365 administration; coordinate ICT procurement, asset management, service provider performance and contract management; manage user support and helpdesk services; implement cybersecurity awareness, backup, business continuity and access-control measures; coordinate ICT projects and digital transformation initiatives; ensure compliance with SITA processes, government ICT prescripts and information security requirements; supervise ICT staff, monitor performance and compile management reports for decision-making.
jobs.enquiries: Mr E L Brewis Tel No: (012) 321 0303
jobs.applications: Applications to be submitted through following link: https://forms.gle/podhaCCHTvtXwMRZ9 or hand delivered to Block C3, Eco Origins Office Park, Witch-hazel Street, Centurion, 0046. FOR ATTENTION : Human Resources
jobs.notes: All attachments for online application must include an application form Z83 and CV only, in PDF and as one (1) document or attachment and saved with surname and initials. JPEG (picture/snapshot) applications will not be accepted. Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each post(s) advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial and sign the Z83 form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. All applications must reach the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services (JICS) on/or before the closing date and time. JICS cannot be held responsible for server delays. Applications submitted in any other way other than the published link or hand delivery will be treated as invalid. All fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83, it is acceptable for applicants to indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached”. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re- appointment under Part “F” must be answered and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form is required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following the communication from Human Resources and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Non- RSA Citizens / Permanent Resident Permit holders in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants      who     do     not    comply       with    the    abovementioned instructions/requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate’s suitability based on the posts’ technical and generic requirements. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used for the sole purpose of this application and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. Due to the large number of responses anticipated, correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. The JICS reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s). The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. The appointment will be made according to the Public Service Act of 1994. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. af.title: Onderdirekteur: Inligting en Kommunikasie
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir Inligting en Kommunikasie by die Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion, wat die ICT-omgewing, beleide, infrastruktuur en kuberveiligheid bestuur op salarisvlak 11.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Nasionale Diploma / Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 6) in Inligtingstegnologie / Rekenaarwetenskap / Inligtingstelsels / Informatika / Inligtingsbestuur / ICT-bestuur / Sagtewareontwikkeling / Netwerkingenieurwese of 'n gelykwaardige ICT-verwante kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken is, hê. Sertifikate in ITIL en/of COBIT sal 'n voordeel wees. 3 tot 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n ICT-omgewing. Ten minste 3 jaar se ervaring op Assistentdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardige toesighoudende / juniorbestuurvlak. Ervaring in die bestuur van ICT-projekte, toesig oor ICT-personeel, bestuur van ICT-diensverskaffers en kontrakte, en die administrasie van ICT-infrastruktuur en inligtingstelsels. Ervaring in 'n Openbare Diens ICT-omgewing, SITA-verwante prosesse, OPENBARE kuberveiligheidsbestuur, Microsoft 365-administrasie, ICT-bestuur en nakoming, en digitale transformasie-aktiwiteite sal voordelig wees. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: kontrakbestuur, leierskap en personeelbestuur, onderhandelingsvaardighede, beleidsinterpretasie, verslagskrywing, kommunikasievaardighede, projekbestuur, analitiese denke, probleemoplossing, belanghebbende bestuur, voorleggingsvaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en State Information Technology Agency (SITA) Act.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur en instandhouding van die Inligting- en Kommunikasietegnologie (ICT)-omgewing van JICS deur die implementering van ICT-beleide, stelsels, infrastruktuur, kuberveiligheidskontroles, gebruikersteundienste en digitale oplossings ter ondersteuning van die organisatoriese mandaat. Bestuur ICT-bestuur, operasionele beplanning, ICT-risiko en nakomingsverslagdoening; hou toesig oor netwerk-, bediener-, eindgebruiker- en Microsoft 365-administrasie; koördineer ICT-aankope, batebestuur, diensverskafferprestasie en kontrakbestuur; bestuur gebruikersteun en helpdiensdienste; implementeer kuberveiligheidsbewustheid, rugsteun, besigheidskontinuïteit en toegangsbeheermaatreëls; koördineer ICT-projekte en digitale transformasie-aktiwiteite; verseker nakoming van SITA-prosesse, regerings-ICT-voorskrifte en inligtingsveiligheidsvereistes; hou toesig oor ICT-personeel, monitor prestasie en stel bestuursverslae op vir besluitneming.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokubamba Isebe: Ulwazi Nokuxhumana
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokubamba isebense kuLwazi Nokuxhumana e-Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services e-Centurion, silawula imvela ye-ICT, izinqubomgomo, insimbi kanye ne-cybersecurity ohlangothini lweholo izinga 11.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nesilabhulethi ye-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), i-National Diploma / I-digri ye-Bachelor's (NQF 6) kwi-Information Technology / Computer Science / Information Systems / Informatics / Information Management/ICT Management / Software Development / Network Engineering noma isitifikedi esilinganayo se-ICT esivunywe i-SAQA. Izitifikedi kwi-ITIL kanye/noma i-COBIT zizoba yinzuzo. Uhambo lweminyaka eyi-3 kuye kwengu-5 lwisebenzo emvela ye-ICT. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 yohambo olusezingeni lika-Assistant Director noma ezingeni elilinganayo lokubhekisisa / lokuphatha abasebansi abancane. Uhambo lokuphatha amaphrojekthi we-ICT, ukubhekisisa izisebenzi ze-ICT, ukuphatha abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ze-ICT kanye namakontrathi, kanye nokulawula insimbi ye-ICT kanye namasistimu wokwaziswa. Uhambo emveleni ye-ICT yesevisi kahulumeni, inqubo ehlobene ne-SITA, ukuphathwa kwe-cybersecurity kahulumeni, ukulawulwa kwe-Microsoft 365, ukulawula nokuhambisana nemithetho ye-ICT, kanye nokuqhuba izinhloso zokuguqula ngezomba kuzoba yinzuzo. Amakhono kanye nokusebenza kahle: ukuphatha amakontrathi, ukuba ngumholi kanye nokuphatha abantu, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukuhumusha izinqubomgomo, ukubhala imibiko, amakhono okuxhumana, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha abahlanganyele, amakhonookusethula, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kanye nenkesi yokusebenza eyedwa kanye nalapho kuyingxenye yeqembu. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye nomthetho we-State Information Technology Agency (SITA) Act.
zu.duties: Umuntu ozoqoba uzobhekene nokulawula kanye nogcina imvela ye-Information and Communication Technology (ICT) ye-JICS ngokuphatha izinqubomgomo ze-ICT, amasistimu, insimbi, izilawuli ze-cybersecurity, izinsizakalo zokwesekaya abasebenzisi kanye nezixazululo ezingamakhompuyutha ukuze kusekelwe iNqubomgomo Yesikhungo. Ukulawula ukubuswa kwe-ICT, ukuhlelwa kwezimisebenzi, amaphuzu wobungozi be-ICT kanye nemibiko yokuhambisana nemithetho; ukubheka inethiwekhi, isiphakeli, abasebenzisi kanye nokuqondisa i-Microsoft 365; ukubambisana ekuthengweni kwe-ICT, ukuphatha izimpahla, ukusebenza kahle kwabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo kanye nokuphatha amakontrathi; ukulawula ukwesekwa kwabasebenzisi kanye nezinsizakalo ze-helpdesk; ukuphatha ukuqaphelwa kwe-cybersecurity, ukugcina ulwazi, ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi kanye nensinga zokulawula ukufinyelela; ukubambisana namaphrojekthi we-ICT kanye nokuqhuba izinhloso zokuguqula ngezomba; ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nolanqubo ze-SITA, imiyalo kahulumeni ye-ICT kanye nezidingo zokuvikeleza ulwazi; ukubhekisisa izisebenzi ze-ICT, ukulandela ukusebenza kahle kanye nokubhala imibiko yokuphatha ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ulwazi nokuNxibelela
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli woLwazi nokuNxibelela kwiSikolo Sokuqwalasela iNkantolo ekuQwalaselweni kwiZiko loLungiso lweMisebenzi eCenturion, elaluhlola imeko ye-ICT, iinkqubo, iziseko zeNkcubeko nokuQinisekisa ukhuseleko kwinethwekhi kwinqanaba lemvuzo 11.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafaki-zicelo babe ne-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), i-National Diploma / Bachelor's degree (NQF 6) kwi-Information Technology / Computer Science / Information Systems / Informatics / Information Management/ICT Management / Software Development / Network Engineering okanye esilingana nayo nge-ICT ekuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Iifomazo ze-ITIL kwaye/noma i-COBIT ziya kuba ngumsa. Ukulinganiselwa kokuhamba kwexesha okuqinisekisiweyo kwi-ICT isigaba 3 ukuya kwi-5 yeminyaka. Inqanaba elingaphantsi kwesikhathi esingalinganiseliyo sokuba ngumqeqeshi kwiNqanaba leSikhulu seSigqiba ukuya kwinqanaba elingalinganiseliyo lokuqeqesha / lolawulo lwabancinane. Uluhlu lwe-ICT projects, ulawulo lwabantu abasebenzela i-ICT, ukulawula abahanjiswa be-ICT nemiqathango, nokuqwalasela iziseko zeNkcubeko i-ICT nendlela yokulawula iinkqubo. Uluhlu kwiPhatho yoLuntu inqanaba le-ICT, iinkqubo ezidibanisa kwi-SITA, ukulawula ukhuseleko kwinethwekhi PUBLIC, ukulawulwa kwe-Microsoft 365, ulawulo nokuhambelana namagunya e-ICT, nokuQwalasela iNqanaba le-ICT le-ICT kwi-SITA.
xh.duties: Umzekeli ophumeleleyo uya kuba noxanduva lokulawula nokuqinisekisa iziseko ze-ICT (Information and Communication Technology) zeJICS ngokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ze-ICT, iziseko, ulawulo lwenkqubo, ukhuseleko kwinethwekhi, iinkonzo ezinceda abasebenzisi nezisombululo ezingenisa ulwazi ngenqanaba eliphakamileyo kwakhona ekuzuziseni iNqanaba leNkonzo yeShishini. Ulawulo lwe-ICT, ulungelelwaniso lweenkonzo ezenziwayo, uNikelo nokuQinisekisa ingozi ekuQwalaselweni kwesimo sesi-ICT; ukulawula inethwekhi, abasebenzisi kumaserver, nokuLawulwa kwe-Microsoft 365; ulungelelwaniso lokuThengwa kwe-ICT, ulawulo lweempahla, nokuLawulwa kwenkonzo yabasebenzisi basekhaya nokuQwalasela imiqathango yeenkonzo; ulawulo lokuncedisa abasebenzisi nokuQwalasela iinkonzo zokusombulula iingxaki ze-ICT; ukusetyenziswa kokuQwalasela ukhuseleko kwinethwekhi, ukhuseleko iBackup, uQhagamshelwano lweMisebenzi ka-365, ulawulo lokungena ekusebenziseni iinkqubo; ulungelelwaniso lweenkqubo ze-ICT noQeqesho lwe-ICT Project Management noQeqesho lwe-ICT Transformation Digital.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Supply Chain Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package that needs to be structured)
jobs.summary: Manage and coordinate the Supply Chain Management function at the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion, covering demand, acquisition, contract, logistics, asset and disposal management.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), Bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) or Advanced Diploma (NQF 7) in Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Procurement Management / Public Administration / Public Management / Financial Management / Commerce / Business Management / Purchasing Management or an equivalent qualification recognised by SAQA. Skills and competencies: supply chain management, procurement planning, contract management, financial management, leadership and people management, negotiation skills, policy interpretation, report writing, communication skills, project management, analytical thinking, problem solving, stakeholder management, presentation skills, computer literacy and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Supervise staff, manage performance and coordinate audit responses and implementation of audit recommendations.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Bestuur en koördineer die Voorsieningskettingbestuursfunksie by die Regsinspekteur vir Korrektiewe Dienste in Centurion, wat vraag-, verkrygings-, kontrak-, logistieke-, bate- en afvoerbestuur dek.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), 'n Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) of 'n Gevorderde Diploma (NQF 7) in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Logistieke Bestuur / Inkoopsbestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur / Finansiële Bestuur / Handel / Besigheidsbestuur / Aankoopbestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie erken deur SAQA beskik. Openbare-sektor VKB-kwalifikasies en LOGIS-sertifisering sal 'n voordeel wees. Minimum 5 jaar se ervaring in Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Minimum 3 jaar se ervaring op Assistentdirekteurvlak of gelykwaardige toesigvlak. Ervaring in openbare-sektor inkoopsprosesse, bestuur van tenders en kwotasies, kontrakbestuur, batebestuur en VKB-bestuurs- en nakomingsake. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: voorsieningskettingbestuur, inkopiesbeplanning, kontrakbestuur, finansiële bestuur, leierskap en mensebestuur, onderhandelingsvaardighede, beleidsinterpretasie, verslaggewing, kommunikasievaardighede, projekbestuur, analitiese denke, probleemoplossing, belanghebbende bestuur, aanbiedingsvaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur en koördinering van die Voorsieningskettingbestuur (VKB) funksie van JICS deur die voorsiening van vraagbestuur, verkrygingsbestuur, kontrakbestuur, logistieke bestuur, batebestuur, afvoerbestuur en VKB-nakomingsdienste in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte. Bestuur inkopiesbeplanning en tenderadministrasie, kwotasies, aankopeorders en verskaffersprestasie; hou toesig oor kontrakadministrasie, bateverifikasie, voorraadbeheer, afvoerprosesse en logistieke dienste; verseker akkurate VKB-rekords, registers en verslagdoening; monitor nakoming van die PFMA, Tesourie Regulasies, Voorkeurinkoop voorskrifte en interne delegasies; identifiseer VKB-risiko's en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls; verskaf advies aan eindgebruikers en bestuur oor VKB-prosesse; Neem deel aan interne en eksterne ouditprosesse, verskaf inligting wat deur ouditeurs benodig word, ondersteun die implementering van ouditaanbevelings en handhaaf voldoende finansiële rekords en ondersteunende dokumentasie vir oudit- en PUBLIEKE nakomingsdoeleindes. Hou toesig oor personeel, bestuur prestasie en koördineer ouditresponse en die implementering van ouditaanbevelings.

zu.title: ONgqonqoshi Abakhethiwe: Supply Chain Management
zu.summary: Phatha uze uhlanganise umsebenzi we-Supply Chain Management esikhungweni iJudicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services eCenturion, okubandakanya ukulawula izidingo, ukuthenga, izinkontileka, izimpahla, ukuhambisa nokuphathwa kokulahlwa kwezinto.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi samabanga aphezulu (Senior Certificate), iziqu ze-Bachelor's degree (NQF 7) noma i-Advanced Diploma (NQF 7) kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Procurement Management / Public Administration / Public Management / Financial Management / Commerce / Business Management / Purchasing Management noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezamukelwa i-SAQA. Iziqu ze-Public Sector SCM kanye nesitifiketi se-LOGIS kuzozuza umuntu. Ubude obungu-5 eminyakeni wokutholele isipiliyoni kwi-Supply Chain Management. Ubude obungu-3 eminyakeni wesipiliyoni ezingeni lika-Assistant Director noma ezingeni elinganayo lokuhlola. Isipiliyoni kumaprosesi okuthenga kwentela yomphakathi, ukuphathwa kwamabhido namakholishi, ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka, ukuphathwa kwezimpahla kanye nemithetho yokubusa neyokuhambisana ye-SCM. Amakhono nolwazi: ukuphathwa kwenqwaba yezinto ezidayiswa, ukuhlelwa kokuthenga, ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuba ngumholi nokuphatha abantu, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukuhumusha izinqubomgomo, ukubhala imibiko, amakhono okuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha abahlanganyeli, amakhono okuyethula, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nendlela yokusebenza yedwa nangaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Omphumelelio uzobe nesibopho sokuphatha nokuhlanganisa umsebenzi we-Supply Chain Management (SCM) we-JICS ngokunikeza izinsiza zokulawula izidingo, ukulawula ukutholwa kwezinto, ukulawula izinkontileka, ukulawula izimpahla, ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla, ukulawula ukulahlwa kwezinto kanye nemithelela yokuhambisana ne-SCM ngokuvumelana nomthetho nezimiso ezisebenzayo. Phatha ukuhlelwa kokuthenga kanye nokuphathwa kwabathunywa bemibhido, amakholishi, ama-oda okuthenga kanye nokusebenza kwabathuningi; qapha ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka, ukuqinisekiswa kwezimpahla, ukulawulwa kwentengo, inqubo yokulahlwa kwezinto nezinsiza ezihambisana nezimpahla; qinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi we-SCM, amarejista nokubika akuqondile; qapha ukuhambisana ne-PFMA, Izimiso ze-Treasury, izimiso ze-Preferential Procurement kanye nezabelo zangaphakathi; tshwaya imingcele yezingozi ye-SCM uze usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa; nikeza izeluleko kubasebenzisi baphelayo nabanini izikhundla mayelana namaprosesi we-SCM; Ngenxa kumaprosesi okuhlola angaphakathi nangaphandle, nikeza ulwazi oludingwa bahloli, sekela ukuqashwa kwezincomo zokuhlola uze ugcine amarekhodu ezimali afanele namadokhumenti asekelayo ngenhloso yokuhlolwa nokuhambisana nomphakathi. Qapha abasebenzi, phatha ukusebenza uze uhlole izimpendulo zokuhlola nokusetshenziswa kwezinto eziyunconyiwe ekuhloleni.

xh.title: Isekela uMlawuli: ukuLawula uHambelo lweZixhobo
xh.summary: Ukulawula nokulungelelanisa umsebenzi wokuLawula uHambelo lweZixhobo kwiJudicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services eCenturion, kuquka ukulawula izidingo, ukufunyanwa kwezixhobo, iinkontrakti, amalogistiks, impahla nokulawula ukulahlwa kwezinto.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe neGrade 12 (Senior Certificate), izidanga zeBachelor (NQF 7) okanye iAdvanced Diploma (NQF 7) kwakuLawula uHambelo lweZixhobo / ukuLawula amaLogistiki / ukuLawula ukuThengiselana / ukuLawula uRholumente kaWonke-wonke / ukuLawula uPhando kaWonke-wonke / ukuLawula iMali / uTshisho / ukuLawula uShishino / ukuLawula ukuThenga okanye isidanga esilinganayo esamkelwa yiSAQA. Izidanga zeSCM zekaRholumente kaWonke-wonke nokugunyaziswa kweLOGIS kuza kubakho nzuzo. Amava angaphaya kweminyaka eyi-5 ekuLawulweni kweHambelo lweZixhobo. Amava angaphaya kweminyaka eyi-3 kwinqanaba lomsistente weDirector okanye elinganayo lokulawula. Amava kwiinkqubo zokuthenga korhulumente wonke-wonke, ukulawula izicelo zemibuthano namagama agenwe imali, ukulawula iinkontrakti, ukulawula impahla, nemithelela yokulawula iSCM nemigiqatho yokuthobela imigaqo. Amakhono nokuzelelwa: ukuLawula uHambelo lweZixhobo, uqeqesho lokuthenga, ukulawula iinkontrakti, ukuLawula iMali, ukulawula abantu nokuqhuba, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukucazulula iingcaphepho-migaqo, ukubhala iingxelo, amakhono ekuqhathanisa konke nokunxibelelana, ukulawula amaphrojekthi, ukucinga ngokuhlalutya, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukulawula abahl继而-partner-management ukunxibelelana nabo, amakhono okubonisa, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, nendlela yokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nangaphakathi kweqela.
xh.duties: Owomelelayo oqeqeshiweyo uza kuba nexabiso lokulawula nokulungelelanisa umsebenzi wokuLawula uHambelo lweZixhobo (SCM) kwiJICS ngokubonelela ngeenkonzo zokulawula izidingo, ukulawula ukufunyanwa kwezixhobo, ukulawula iinkontrakti, ukulawula amalogistiks, ukulawulaimpahla, ukulawula ukulahlwa kwezinto, nokuthobela imigaqo yeSCM ngokwemigaqo-nkqubo nemiqathango esebenzayo. Ukulawula uqeqesho lokuthenga nokulawula izicelo zemibuthano, iivoti, iiodolo zokuthenga nokusebenza kabanini kwabathengisi; ukuyalela ukulawulwa kweenkontrakti, ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla, ukulawula izinto ezikhoyo, iinkqubo zokulahlwa izinto, iinkonzo zamalogistiks; ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuko ukugcinwa okuchanekileyo kweerekhodi zeSCM, iirejista nokubika; ukugqiba ukuthobela imigaqo yePFMA, IMigaqo yeTreasury, imiqathango yePreferential Procurement nokuqhuba okungaphakathi; ukuqaphela iingozi zeSCM nokuseka iindlela zokulungisa; ukunika inkxaso kubasebenzisi nabolawulo ngemigaqo yeSCM; Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuhlola ezingaphakathi nangaphandle, ukubonelela nolwazi olufunwa ngabahloli, ukuxhasa ukusebenzisa iingcebiso zabahloli, kugcinwe iirekhodi zemali ezaneleyo namaxwebhu axhasayo ngenjongo yokuhlolwa nokuthobela imigaqo kaRHULUMENTE. Ukulawula abasebenzi, ukulawula ukusebenza nokulungelelanisa iimpendulo zokuhlolwa nokusebenzisa iingcebiso zabahloli.

af.title: Streeksbestuurder: Kwa-zulu Natal Bestuursstreek
af.summary: Streeksbestuurder gesoek om toesig oor korrektiewe diens-inspeksies, ondersoeke en ICCC-prestasiebestuur in KwaZulu-Natal te hou, met 'n graad en vyf jaar se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat) en 'n baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) in Kriminologie/Penologie/Openbare Administrasie/Openbare Bestuur/Korrektiewe Bestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie erken deur SAQA hê. Minimum 5 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in korrektiewe dienste, strafregpleging, toesig, inspeksies, ondersoeke, nakomingsmonitering of verwante omgewing. Minimum 3 jaar se ervaring op Assistente-direkteur-vlak of gelykwaardige toesighoudende/bestuursvlak. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Okuncane eminyakeni eyi-5 yohlelo oluhambisana nakho kokulungisa izingcosana, ezobulungiswa bobugebengu,okuqapha, okuhlolwayo, eziphenywayo, ukubhekisisa ukuthobela umthetho noma endaweni ehlobene nalokhu. Okuncane eminyakeni eyi-3 yohlelo ezingeni le-Assistant Director noma ezingeni elilinganayo lokubusa/lolawulo. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethi yenzeke. Ohlelo lokuphatha abantu, ukuhlanganisa izinkambu zokusebenza, ukukhiqiza izimbiko zolawulo kanye nokuxhumana nabahlanganyeli ezingeni lolawulo. Okunconyiwe kakhulu ohlelo ezinkonzweni zokulungisa izingcosana, ekuqapheni amalungelo abantu, okuhlolwayo nakokuphenywayo, ekuqapheni izikhalazo nasekuqapheni ukuthobela umthetho. Amakhono namandla: ikhono lesuqumo, ukuba ngumholi nokuphatha abantu, ukuphatha izinhlela namaphrojekthi, ukuphatha imali, ukuphatha inguquko, ukuphatha abahlanganyeli, ukubhala izimbiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphenya nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, amakhono okuxhumana, ukuhumusha izinqubomgomo, lolawulo lwesikhashana somphakathi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nenhlonipho yokusebenza yodwa nangaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhloboze izinhlelo zokuhlola izifundo ezidingekayo, ukuphenya, izikhalazo nokubika okuyimpoqo ezingeni lendawo. Phatha futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwezivakashi ezizimele zezikhungo zokulungisa izingcosana (ICCVs) kanye namakomidi ezivakashi endaweni. Hlanganisa ukuba khona kwabahlanganyeli futhi umele i-JICS kumaphilamu nezakhiwo zendawo. Qapha ukuthobela umthetho we-Department of Correctional Services Act, izinqubomgomo ze-JICS kanye nezakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisana nalawo. Phatha ukuphatha izinyathelo zokulungisa eziphuma ezivakashweni, eziphenyweni, ezikhalazweni nasenkondweni yokubika okuyimpoqo. Phatha izinsiza zabantu, zezimali, ezempahla kanye nezolawuzo zendawo. Hlela futhi uhambise izimbiko zokusebenza, zokuqapha nolawulo zendawo. Nikela ngesekelo eliyisuqumo nezokusebenza ku-Director: Regional Coordination and Oversight.

xh.title: Umphathi weNgingqi: Kwa-zulu Natal Management Region
xh.summary: Kufunwa abe nguMphathi weNgingqi ukuba alawule ukuhlolwa kolunyundo lwamasebe eziko ezenzululwazi, uphando nolawulo lwenkonzo ye-ICCC KwaZulu-Natal, edityaniswa nedegree nobugcisa beminyaka emihlanu.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesitshixo seGrade 12 (Senior Certificate), ibachelor's degree (NQF 7) kwiCriminology/Penology/Public Administration/Public Management/Corrections Management okanye isidanga esilinganayo esamkelwe yiSAQA. Kuya kubakho mzuzu othanda: Postgraduate qualification kwiPublic Management, Corrections, Criminology okanye Governance, Management Development Programme. Ubomi bokugqitha eminyaka emi-5 obugqithiselwe kumava kwiziko ezenzululwazi, urhulumente wezono, ulawulo, ukuhlolwa, uphando, ulawulo lwentobozelo okanye indawo enjengaleyo. Ubomi bokugqitha eminyaka emi-3 kumanqanaba kaAssistant Director okanye esilingana namanqanaba okulawula okanye okulawula abantu. Ilayisensi yokushukuma engatshoyo. Amava okulawula abantu, ulungelelwaniso lweenkonzo, ukwenza iinkcukacha zobugcisa bokulawula nokuqhubana nabathathi-nxaxheba kumanqanaba okulawula. Amava amakhulu anamkelo eziko ezenzululwazi, ukulawula kwamalungelo abantu, ukuhlolwa nophando, ulawulo lwezikhulumi kunye nolawulo lwentobozelo. Amakhono namandla: ikhono lokulawula iindaba, ukulawula abantu nokuqonda, ulawulo lweenkqubo nophando, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo lwenziwa yinto, ulawulo labathathi-nxaxheba, ukubhala iinkcukacha, ukusombulula iingxaki, uphando namakhono okuhlola, ukwenza izigqibo, amakhono okuthetha, ukutolika iinkqubo, urhulumente woluntu, ukusebenzela ikhompyutha n9 nokwazi ukusebenza lodwa nokuba yingxenye yeqela.
xh.duties: Lawula ulungelelwaniso lweenkonzo zengingqi zokuhola, ukuhlola, uphando, iingxakaminingi nokubika ngokumisela iinkqubo. Lawula ulawulo lwenkonzo yabaVisitors abazimeleyo baseziko (ICCVs) kunye namakhomiti abaVisitors kwengingqi. Lungiselelana nabathathi-nxaxheba umanyano olungeniyo zize ngokomthetho namakhomiti wezinto ezithile kwengingqi. Qaphela intobozelo ngomthetho weziko ezilawulayo iCorrectional Services Act, iinkqubo zeJICS nolawulo ngokomthetho oluthile. Lawula ukusebenza kolungiselelo olusuka ekuhlolweni, uphandweni, iingxakaminingi n9 ezinkqubo zokubika ezimiselweyo. Lawula amachwe, amawotyi, izinto ezahlukeneyo nezolawulo zengingqi. Hlaziya kwaye ungenise iinkcukacha zengingqi ngokwemigaqo, ukulawula nokuqonda iinkcukacha. Nikeza inkxaso ye strategic kunye neenkonzo ezilawulayo kuDirector: Regional Coordination and Oversight.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resources: Skills Development
jobs.summary: Oversee skills development and training at the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion, requiring a relevant diploma and three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), National Diploma in Human Resource Management/ Human Resource Development/ Training and Development or equivalent qualification at NQF Level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in Skills Development and Training coordination, of which one (01) year should be at a supervisory level. A valid driver’s license, Skills Development Facilitator certificate and Train the Trainer certificate will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Good interpretation and knowledge of the National Skills Development Strategy, Public Finance Management Act, Skills Development PUBLIC Act, Skills Development Levy Act, Public Service Regulations, compulsory training programmes in the Public Service, PERSAL system, planning, coordination, organising, analytical and people management skills, sound verbal and written communication skills, presentation skills, high sense of responsibility and accountability, interpersonal skills, time management, attention to detail, experience in managing long-term training programmes, experience in developing and submitting Workplace Skills Plans and SETA reports, project management skills, computer literacy in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, ability to work under pressure and independently and as part of a team.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronne: Vaardigheidsontwikkeling
af.summary: Ounsien vaardigheidsontwikkeling en opleiding by die Regtelike Inspektoraat vir Korrektiewe Dienste in Centurion, wat 'n tersaaklike diploma en drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/ Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling/ Opleiding en Ontwikkeling of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF Vlak 6 met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Vaardigheidsontwikkeling en Opleidingskoördinasie, waarvan een (01) jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie, Sertifikaat as Vaardigheidsontwikkelingsfasilitateur en Train the Trainer-sertifikaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Goeie interpretasie en kennis van die Nasionale Vaardigheidsontwikkelingsstrategie, Public Finance Management Act, Skills Development PUBLIC Act, Skills Development Levy Act, Openbare Diensregulasies, verpligte opleidingsprogramme in die Openbare Diens, PERSAL-stelsel, beplanning, koördinasie, organisering, analitiese en mensebestuursvaardighede, goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, hoë sin van verantwoordelikheid en aanspreeklikheid, interpersoonlike vaardighede, tydbestuur, aandag aan detail, ervaring in die bestuur van langtermyn opleidingsprogramme, ervaring in die opstel en indien van Workplace Skills Plans en SETA-verslae, projekbestuursvaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid in Microsoft Word, Excel en PowerPoint, vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Implementeer die Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsstrategieë, voer vaardigheidsoudit en opleidingsbehoeftontleding uit, ontwikkel Workplace Skills Plan (WSP) en Annual Training Report (ATR), neem deel aan vaardigheidsontwikkelingsbeplanning en identifiseer kritiese en skaars vaardighede binne die departement, verskaf insette tot die Departementele Menslike Hulpbronplan en ander vaardigheidsontwikkelingsplan-inisiatiewe, implementeer Menslike Hulpbronbestuursprojekte, koördinasie en fasilitering van Oriëntasie en Induksie-programme, bevorder Loopbaanontwikkeling en Talentbestuur. Belanghebbende-skakeling en Koördinasie, koördineer en verskaf sekretariaat en tegniese advies aan die Vaardigheidsontwikkelingskomitee (SDC), bestuur Vaardigheidsontwikkelingsnakoming, voer voor- en na-opleidingsevaluerings uit en meet opleidingseffektiwiteit en impak, koördineer Leer en Ontwikkelingsprogramme insluitend fasilitering en implementering van verpligte opleiding, beurse, internskappe, leerderskappe en leierskapsontwikkelingsprogramme, bestuur die opleidingsrekords, stel bestuursverslae op en verseker opleiding en bemagtiging van ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Onakekela Isikhundla: Human Resources: Skills Development
zu.summary: Qapha ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono nokuqeqeshwa e-Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services e-Centurion, okudinga idiploma edingekayo neminyaka emithathu yesipiliyoni.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe ne-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), i-National Diploma kwi-Human Resource Management/ Human Resource Development/ Training and Development noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 ezinemikomelo engu-360 njengoba kuvunyelwe yi-SAQA. Isikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) sokuba ngumuntu oqeqeshiwe ekwelweni nokulungiswa kokuqeqeshwa kwamakhono okuhlukene, okuyilapho unyaka oyedwa (01) kufanele ube ngqondongqondo. Ithikithe lesiqu sokushayela, isitifiketi se-Skills Development Facilitator nesitifiketi se-Train the Trainer kuzodingeka njengentengo ekwengeziwe. Ulwazi nezikhomba: Ukuhuoza okuhle nolwazi nge-National Skills Development Strategy, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Skills Development PUBLIC Act, i-Skills Development Levy Act, izincwajomthetho ze-Public Service, amaphrogremu wokuqeqeshwa ayingqayizivele koMnyango wezeNhlalo yoluntu, uhlelo lwe-PERSAL, ukucubungula, ukuhlanganisa, ukubumba izinhloso, ulwazi olunzulu nokuqonda kanye namakhono okuphatha abantu, amakhono okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala, amakhono okubonisa, iswele esikhulu somdlandla kanye nobudlelwano nokuzibophezela, amakhono okuxhumana nalowo nalowo, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukuqaphela okunzulu, isipiliyoni ekuphatheni amaphrogremu wokuqeqeshwa isikhathi eside, isipiliyoni ekuthuthukiseni nokuthumela i-Workplace Skills Plans kanye nemibiko ye-SETA, amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ku-Microsoft Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint, ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezi nokuzimela nokuba yingxenye yeqembu.
zu.duties: Phetha izindlela zokuqeqesha nokuqashwa kwabantu, yenza ukuhlola amakhono nokuhlaziya izidingo zokuqeqeshwa, khuthula i-Workplace Skills Plan (WSP) kanye ne-Annual Training Report (ATR), yiba ngxenye ekwelweni izindlela zokuqeqesha amakhono futhi uchithe amakhono abalulekile naba ithafa kumnyango, nikeza izimpumelo ku-Departmental Human Resource Plan kwezinye izinhloso zohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, phetha amaphrojekthi e-Human Resource Management, lungisisa futhi uhole amaphrogremu e-Orientation and Induction, khuthaza i-Career Development ne-Talent Management. Ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli kanye nokuhlanganisa, lungisa futhi unikeze inkonzo yobhalisi kanye nenkulumo-mcolo yobuchwepheshe ku-Skills Development Committee (SDC), phatha ukuhambisana kokuqeqeshwa kwamakhono, yenza ukuhlola ngaphambi nangemva kokuqeqeshwa futhi ulinganise ukusebenza komphumela wokuqeqeshwa, lungisa amaphrogremu e-Learning and Development kuhlanganise nohlelo nokuphethwa kokuqeqeshwa okuyimfuneko, izibhasidi, izintsha, izifundo zomsebenzi, namaphrogremu okuthuthukiswa kobuholo, phatha irekhodi lokuqeqeshwa, hlanganisa imibiko yokubusa futhi uqinisekise ukuqeqeshwa nokuqashwa kwabaphansi kwakho.

xh.title: Umqondisi oNcedisayo: iziseko zoluntu: uPhuhliso lwamakhono
xh.summary: Qondisa uphuhliso lwamakhono nokuqeqeshwa kwiJudicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services eCenturion, kufuneka idiploma efanelekileyo neminyaka emithathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe neGrade 12 (Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo), iNational Diploma ezoLawula iziseko zoluntu/ ekuPhuhliseni iziseko zoluntu/ ukuQeqeshwa nokuPhuhlisa okanye isifanekiso esingalingeneyo kwinqanaba leNQF Level 6 elinamava angama-360 njengoko kugunyaziswe yiSAQA. Amava amabalwa kathathu (3) eminyaka ekulungiseni uPhuhliso lwamakhono nokuQeqeshwa, apho unyaka omnye (01) kufuneka abe kwinqanaba lokuqondisa. Ilayisenisi evunyiweyo yokushayela, isatifikethi soQeqeshi boPhuhliso lwamakhono nesisatifikethi soQeqeshi abaQeqeshi kuya kubakho nzuzo engeziweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda okulungileyo nolwazi ngeSicwangciso seLizwe soPhuhliso lwamakhono, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, uMthetho kaMan wePhatlalatho woPhuhliso lwamakhono, uMthetho woRhwebo lwoPhuhliso lwamakhono, iMigaqo yeNkonzo kaRhulumente, iinkqubo zokuqeqeshwa eziyimfuno kuNkonzo kaRhulumente, inkqubo yePERSAL, ucwangciso, ulungiselelo, ukuhlela, amakhono okuhlola nokulawula abantu, amakhono abalulekileyo okunxibelelwana ngemilomo nangokubhalwa, amakhono okubonisa, isipiliwo esiphezulu sokuxabisa nokuziphendulela, amakhono okunxibelelana nabantu, ulawulo lwexesha, ingqalelo kwiinkcukacha, amava ekulawulen iinkqubo zokuqeqeshwa zexesha elide, amave ekwenzeni nokungenisa iiNkqubo zamakhono aseKwindla naye iingxelo zeSETA, amakhono okulawula amaphrojekthi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwiMicrosoft Word, Excel nePowerPoint, ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nodwa nangaphakathi kweqela.
xh.duties: Phumeza iindlela zokuPhuhlisa iziseko zoluntu, yenza uvavanyo lwamakhono nokuqonda iimfuno zolwazi, phuhlisa iNkqubo yamakhono eKwindla (WSP) nesiXego sokuQeqeswa sonyaka (ATR), thambe ekwenzeni iplani yophuhliso lwamakhono uze uchaze amakhono abalulekileyo angatholakaliyo ngaphakathi kwesebe, nikeze izigqibo kwiNkqubo yeziseko zoluntu yesebe nakwezinye iindlela zophuhliso lwamakhono, phumeza amaphrojekthi ezoLawula iziseko zoluntu, lungiselela ukuqalisa kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zoQeqesho nokuQaliswa kwindima. Thintele abanini nzala uze ulawule, lungiselela unikeze isigqibo ngamacebo obuchwepheshe kuBhungana loPhuhliso lwamakhono (SDC), lawula ukuhambelana kolwazi oluchaziweyo malunga noPhuhliso lwamakhono, yenza ukuvavanyo phambi nangemva kokuqeqeshwa uze ulinganise ukusebenza nokubakho impembelelo yokuqeqeshwa, lungiselela iinkqubo zokuFunda nokuQeqeshwa kuquka ukuqeqeshwa nokuphumeza uqeqesho oluyimfuno, izibursi, iintornship, iilearnership, nolunye uqeqesho oluphuhlisa abaphathi, lawula iirekhodi zokuqeqeshwa, hlela iingxelo zolawulo uze uqinisekise ukuqeqeshwa nokuqalisa kwabangaphansi kwakho.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Risiko- en Integriteitsbestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Risiko- en Integriteitsbestuur by die Regsinspekteur vir Korrektiewe Dienste in Centurion, wat 'n bachelorsgraad en drie jaar se risikobestuurervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Bachelorsgraad / Gevorderde Diploma (NQF 7) in Risikobestuur/Interne Oudit / Rekeningkunde of 'n equivalente verwante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, beskik. 'n Nagraadse diploma in risikobestuur en/of nakoming sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Minimum van 3 jaar relevante ervaring binne 'n risikobestuur- of verwante omgewing. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik), analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede, aandag aan detail, kliëntediensgerigtheid, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, eerlikheid en integriteit, verslagskryfvaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Implementeer die risikobestuuraamwerk, besigheidskontinuïteit en nakomingsbestuur wat die ontwikkeling en implementering van die risikobestuurplan, 'n risikobestuurfilosofie en -kultuur in die organisasie deur bewustmaking en kapasiteitsbou insluit, die handhawing van belanghebbende- en kliëntverhoudings, deurlopende monitering en vaslegging van data en die instandhouding van databasisse oor risikobestuurinligting. Outeur en onderneem studies en analise om risiko's te identifiseer ten einde die interne en eksterne organisasiekonteks te vestig. Fasiliteer en adviseer oor die risikobestuurasessingsproses soos identifikasie, analise, evaluering, die opstel van risikoprofiel en verslae. Monitor en hersien die vordering van aktiwiteite om risiko's aan te spreek en hersien risiko-reaksie-aktiwiteite. Verseker 'n effektiewe risiko- en integriteitsbestuursdiens. Koördineer en implementeer Etiese Bestuursstrategie, Beleide en Programme in JICS insluitend maar nie beperk tot nie; finansiële openbaarmaking, ander vergoede werk, ens. Kommunikeer met belanghebbendes, kliënte, bestuur en kollegas: Skriftelik, mondelings en formele aanbiedings/werkswinkels / bewustmakingssessies. Berei kwartaallikse risikobestuurverslae voor en bied dit aan die Oudit- en Risikokomitee voor.

zu.title: Umsekabhalwe: Ezingothingo & Ekuqinisweni Kokulawula
zu.summary: Umsekabhalwe: Ezingothingo Nokuphathwa Kokuqinisekisa e-Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services e-Centurion, ofuna idigri yebachelors namava eminyaka emithathu ekuqinisweni kokulawula.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nesikhedule 12 (Senior Certificate), idigri yebachelors / Advanced Diploma (NQF 7) ku-Risk Management/Internal Audit / Accounting noma isitifikati esihlobene esilinganayo njengokuqashelwe yi-SAQA. I-Postgraduate diploma ekuqinisweni kokulawula nokuhlanganiselwa kuzobe yinselelelo engeziwe. Ubuncwane beminyaka engu-3 yamava ahambisana nokusingatha kokuqinisekisa noma indawo ehlobene. Amakhono namandla: amakhono okuxhumana (akubukhuluma nakubhalwe), amakhono okuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuqaphela imininingwane, ukuzinza enkonzweni yabathengi, amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela, ukuqopha nokuzethemba, amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuwukwazi ukusebenza wedwa futhi njengengxenye yeqembu.
zu.duties: Ukuqalisa isakhiwo sokuphathwa kokuqinisekisa, ukuqhubeka komabhizinisi nokuphathwa kokuhlanganiselwa okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuqaliswa kohlelo lokuphathwa kokuqinisekisa, inqubo namasiko okuphathwa kokuqinisekisa emphakathini ngokuqondiswa nokwakhiwa kwamandla, ukugcina ubuhlobo nabanikazi bamaphrojekthi nabathengi, ukuqaphela ngokuqhubekayo nokugcina ukwaziswa nokuqinisekisa imininingwane ekuqinisweni kokulawula. Ukuqapha futhi ukwenza izifundo nokuhlaziya ukuze kubonakale izingozi ukuze kusekelwe isimo sangaphakathi nangaphandle sempahla. Ukwenza lula futhi umekele inqubo yokuhlola ukuqinisekiswa ngokuphathwa kwengozi njengokuhlonza, ukuhlaziya, ukuhlola, ukubhalwa kwemibhalo yamaphrofayili kanye nemibiko. Ukuqapha futhi ukuhlola inqubo yezindleko ukuze kubhekisiswe izinkinga futhi kuhlolwe ngokuphinda imisebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona insiza yokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezengozi. Ukwenza ngokuhlanganiswa nokuletha endaweni I-Ethics Management Strategy, Policies and Programmes e-JICS ehlanganisa kodwa ingaqediswa; izimali ezibonisiwe, eminye imisebenzi eznzuzo, njll. Ukuxhumana nabanikazi bamaphrojekthi, abathengi, abaphathi kanye nabahlanganye: okubhaliwe, okukhulunywa futhi okwethulwa okuhleliwe / amawokishophu / izikhathi zokuqondiswa. Ukulungisa imibiko yokuqinisekisa kwakunyaka ezinqameli futhi uyethule ku-Audit and Risk Committee.

xh.title: Umcebisi woMlawuli: UkuLawulwa koMngcipheko & ukuLawulwa koQiniseko
xh.summary: Umcebisi woMlawuli: UkuLawulwa koMngcipheko nokuQinisekisa kwiJarahamathikhal Inspektorethi yabaKhuseli abaLungileyo eCenturion, efunisa idigri yebachelor neminyaka emithathu yamava okulawula umngcipheko.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 (Senior Certificate), idigri yebachelor / iDiploma ePhakamileyo (NQF 7) kokuLawulwa koMngcipheko/ ukuKhangela ngaphakathi / ukuBala inani okanye isifanekisobuchule esinxulumeneyo njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Ipostgraduate diploma ekulawulweni komngcipheko nakho/nokuthobela iya kuba luncedo elongeziweyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-3 yamava ahambelanayo kwimeko yokulawula umngcipheko okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Amakhono namakhono: amakhono okunxibelelwana (olomlomo nelobhalo), amakhono okuhlola kunye nokusombulula iingxaki, ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha, ukujolise ekwenzeni abathengi, amakhono oceuclayishuni nokuhlela, inyaniso noqiniseko, amakhono okubhala iingxelo, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye nokuba nakho ukusebenza eyedwa nangaphakathi kwqembu.
xh.duties: Zisebenzisa isakhelo sokulawula umngcipheko, ukuqhubeka koshishino kunye nokulawula ukuthobela oko kuquka ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa icebo lokulawula umngcipheko, inqubo namasiko okulawula umngcipheko kwishishino ngokwazisa nokwakha amandla, ukugcina ubudlelwane nabanomdla nakabathengi, ukulandelela ngokung прекyn nokubamba i-data noku ulondoloza i-database kolwazi lokulawula umngcipheko. Lawula kwaye uzenze izifundo kunye nokuqondisa ukuze uchaze umngcipheko ukuze umiswe imo yangaphakathi nangaphandle yeshishino. Yenza umceli mncede kwaye uze nengcebiso kwinqubo yokulinganisa ukulawula umngcipheko efana nokuchaza, ukuhlola, ukulinganisela, ukuqamba iiprofayili zomngcipheko neengxelo. Landelela kwaye uqwalasele inkqubela yemisebenzi yokubhekana nomngcipheko kwaye ulungise ngokutsha imisebenzi yokuphendula kumngcipheko. Qinisekisa inkonzo ephumeleyo yokulawula umngcipheko noqiniseko. Lungisa kwaye zisebenzise isiCwangciso soLawulo loBuzo, iNqgamlezo nameNkqubo kwiJICS kuquka kodwa angadingeli; iinkcukacha zezezimali, omnye umsebenzi ohlawulwayo, njl. Thetha nabanomdla, abathengi, abalawuli nabahlobo: Ebiwriteri, eRomlomo noku kwangasemva/iingcinga zokuvakalaya / iinkqubo zokuqonda. Lungiisa iingxelo zethreyimesta zokulawula umngcipheko kwaye ziboniswe kwiKomiti yeKhangelo noMngcipheko.

jobs.title: Webmaster
jobs.summary: Manage and maintain the JICS website and digital platforms, including content publishing, UX enhancement, analytics reporting and compliance with government communication standards.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), National Diploma (NQF 6) or Bachelor’s Degree (NQF 7) in any of the following: Information Technology, Information Systems, Web Development, Multimedia Design, Digital Communications, Computer Science, Graphic Design, Journalism, Communication Science, Digital Media or an equivalent qualification recognised by SAQA. Added advantage: training or certification in HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Content Management Systems (CMS), WordPress, SharePoint, Adobe Creative Suite, Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Google Analytics or User Experience (UX). Minimum 3 to 5 years' experience in website administration and content management, managing organisational websites, publishing content on Content Management Systems, producing web performance reports and analytics and coordinating digital communication initiatives. Added advantage experience in government websites, public sector communications, SharePoint administration, social media management, basic web development, graphic design and multimedia editing, accessibility compliance and digital records management. Skills and competencies: website administration, content editing, web publishing, graphic design, analytical thinking, report writing, communication skills, proofreading and editing, photography and multimedia skills, problem solving, planning and organising, attention to detail, stakeholder liaison, computer literacy and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Manage, maintain and continuously improve the JICS website and digital platforms through website administration, content publishing, user experience enhancement, analytics reporting, digital communications support and compliance with government communication and information management standards. Upload, edit and publish approved content; ensure information is current, accurate, accessible and aligned to organisational branding; monitor website functionality, links, accessibility and performance; compile analytics and usage reports; coordinate digital communication campaigns and web updates with internal stakeholders; support social media and multimedia content where required; maintain digital records and content libraries; assist with basic troubleshooting, CMS administration and user support; liaise with service providers and ICT officials on technical enhancements and ensure compliance with POPIA, records management requirements and applicable communication standards.

Failure to fully complete, initial and sign the Z83 form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. All applications must reach the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services (JICS) on/or before the closing date and time. JICS cannot be held responsible for server delays. Applications submitted in any other way other than the published link or hand delivery will be treated as invalid. All fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83, it is acceptable for applicants to indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached”. af.title: Webmeester
