af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) in enige van die volgende hê: Inligtingstegnologie, Inligtingstelsels, Webontwikkeling, Multimediavormgeving, Digitale Kommunikasie, Rekenaarwetenskap, Grafiese Vormgeving, Joernalistiek, Kommunikasiewetenskap, Digitale Media of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken word. Bykomende voordeel: opleiding of sertifisering in HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Content Management Systems (CMS), WordPress, SharePoint, Adobe Creative Suite, Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Google Analytics of User Experience (UX). Minimum 3 tot 5 jaar se ervaring in webwerfadministrasie en inhoudbestuur, die bestuur van organisatoriese webwerwe, die publisering van inhoud op Content Management Systems, die opstel van webprestasieverslae en ontleding en die koördinering van digitale kommunikasie-inisiatiewe. Bykomende voordeel: ervaring in regeringswebwerwe, openbare sektor kommunikasie, SharePoint-administrasie, sosiale mediabestuur, basiese webontwikkeling, grafiese vormgeving en multimediabewerking, toeganklikheidsnakoming en digitale rekordbestuur. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: webwerfadministrasie, inhoudredigering, webpublisering, grafiese vormgeving, analitiese denke, verslagskryf, kommunikasievaardighede, proeflees en redigering, fotografie en multimedievaardighede, probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering, aandag aan detail, belanghebbende skakeling, rekenaarvaardigheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur, onderhou en verbeter voortdurend die JICS-webwerf en digitale platforms deur webwerfadministrasie, inhoudpublisering, gebruikerservaringsverbetering, ontledingsverslagdoening, digitale kommunikasiesteun en nakoming van regeringskommunikasie- en inligtingsbestuurstandaarde. Laai goedgekeurde inhoud op, redigeer en publiseer dit; verseker dat inligting huidig, akkuraat, toeganklik en in ooreenstemming met organisatoriese handelsmerk is; monitor webwerffunksionaliteit, skakels, toeganklikheid en prestasie; stel ontledings en gebruiksverslae op; koördineer digitale kommunikasieveldtogte en webopdaterings met interne belanghebbendes; ondersteun sosiale media en multimedia-inhoud waar nodig; onderhou digitale rekords en inhoudbiblioteke; help met basiese probleemoplossing, CMS-administrasie en gebruikerondersteuning; skakel met diensverskaffers en ICT-amptenare oor tegniese verbeterings en verseker nakoming van POPIA, rekordbestuursvereistes en toepaslike kommunikasiestandaarde.

zu.title: Umnikazi wewebhusayithi
zu.summary: Phatha futhi igcine iwebhusayithi ye-JICS kanye namapulatifomu ezenzakalayo, okuhlanganisa ukushicilela okuqukethwe, ukuthuthukisa isipiliyoni somsebenzisi, ukubika ukwahlukanisa kolwazi kanye nokuhambisana nemigomo yokuxhumana kahulumeni.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumelwe babe nesiqephe se-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), i-National Diploma (NQF 6) noma i-Bachelor's Degree (NQF 7) nakweyiphi kulezi: Information Technology, Information Systems, Web Development, Multimedia Design, Digital Communications, Computer Science, Graphic Design, Journalism, Communication Science, Digital Media noma izifundo ezifanayo ezithathwa ngokusemthethweni yi-SAQA. Izuzu elingeziwe: ukuzifundisa noma ukugqashwa izitifiketi kwi-HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Content Management Systems (CMS), WordPress, SharePoint, Adobe Creative Suite, Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Google Analytics noma User Experience (UX). Uhlangothi osukwana kweminyaka eyi-3 kuya kweyi-5 wokuhlola amawebhusayithi nokuphatha okuqukethwe, ekuphatheni amawebhusayithi ezinhlangano, ekushicileleni okuqukethwe kwi-Content Management Systems, ekukhiqizeni imibiko yokusebenza kewebhusayithi nakuhlukaniswa kolwazi nasekuhlanganiseni imizamo yokuxhumana ezenzakalayo. Izuzu elingeziwe ukuhlola amawebhusayithi kahulumeni, ukuxhumana kwentanga yomphakathi, ukuphatha i-SharePoint, ukuphatha izinkundla zokuxhumana kwezenzakalayo, ukuthuthukiswa kwebhusayithi okuyisisekelo, ukwakha izithombe kanye nokuhlela izinto eziningi, ukuhambisana nokufinyeleleka okulawulwayo nokuphatha izinkomba ezenzakalayo. Amakhono kanye nobuchwepheshe: ukuphatha iwebhusayithi, ukuhlela okuqukethwe, ukushicilela kwiwebhusayithi, ukwakha izithombe, ukucabanga ngokuhlukanisa, ukubhala imibiko, amakhono okuxhumana, ukufunda ukuqinisekisa ukuhlela, ukuthwebula izithombe namakhono wezithombe eziningi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa, ukunakisisa imininingwane, ukuxhumana ngqo nabahlanganyeli, ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuqashwa kwesisindo nokusebenza njengeshoba sitimela nangaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Phatha, gcina futhi ngokuphephile ukuthuthukisa iwebhusayithi ye-JICS namapulatifomu ezenzakalayo ngokuphatha iwebhusayithi, ukushicilela okuqukethwe, ukuthuthukisa isipiliyono somsebenzisi, ukubika ukwahlukanisa kolwazi, ukusekela ukuxhumana okuzenzakalayo nokuhambisana nemigomo yokuxhumana kahulumeni nokuphatha ulwazi. Layisha, hlela bese ushicilela okuqukethwe okuvunyiwe; qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lumanje, luqinisekile, lufinyeleleka futhi luhambisana nesibonakaliso senhlangano; qapha ukusebenza kwewebhusayithi, izixhumanisi, ukufinyeleleka nokusebenza; qoqa imibiko yokuhlukanisa nokusetshenziswa; hlanganisa imikhankaso yokuxhumana ezenzakalayo nokuvuselelwa kwewebhusayithi nabahlanganyeli bangaphakathi; sekele izinkundla zokuxhumana kwezenzakalayo kanye nokuqukethwe okuningi lapho kudingeka khona; gcine izinkomba ezenzakalayo namalabhulali okuqukethwe; siza ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezisisisekelo, ekuphatheni i-CMS nasekusekeleni abasebenzisi; xhumana nabahlinzeki besinsiza nabasebenzi be-ICT ngokuthuthukiswa kwamathuluzi bese uqinisekisa ukuhambisana ne-POPIA, izidingo zokuphatha izinkomba nemigbo yokuxhumana esebenzayo.

xh.title: Umphathi wewebhusayithi
xh.summary: Phatha kwaye ugcine iwebhusayithi yeJICS nakwezinye iinkqubo ezingamanani, kuquka ukushicilela okuqulethiweyo, ukuphucula amava omsebenzisi, ukubika ngokuqhutywa kunye nokuhambelana namagqabantshintshi okuthunyelwa koluntu.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesiqinisekiso seGrade 12 (Senior Certificate), iNational Diploma (NQF 6) okanye iBachelor's Degree (NQF 7) nakweyiphi na kwezi landelayo: Information Technology, Information Systems, Web Development, Multimedia Design, Digital Communications, Computer Science, Graphic Design, Journalism, Communication Science, Digital Media okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivunyiwe nguSAQA. Iindlela ezongezwa kakhulu: uqeqesho okanye isatifikathi kwiHTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Content Management Systems (CMS), WordPress, SharePoint, Adobe Creative Suite, Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Google Analytics okanye User Experience (UX). Amava amabalengi afunekayo yi-3 ukuya kwi-5 yeminyaka kwintlawulo yewebhusayithi nolawulo lokuqulethiweyo, ekuphathweni kweewebhusayithi zenhlangano, ekushicilelweni kokuqulethiweyo kwiContent Management Systems, ekwenzeni iingxelo zokusebenza kwewebhu nokuhlelwa kolwazi nakwintshayelelo yokuqhutywa koluntu kumanani. Amava afakwa ngaphezulu: ekuphathweni kweewebhusayithi karhulumente, ekuqhutyweni koluntu kwicandelo likarhulumente, ekulawulweni kweSharePoint, ekulawulweni kweekhonkoro zomlibo, ekwakheni iwebhusayithi esisekelweni, ekwakhiweni kwezigramu nakulungelelwaniso lwezithathu-ngaphezulu, ekuhambelaneni nangonikezelo lokufikelela nakulawulweni kweefayile ezimanani. Amakhono namandla okuqonda: intlawulo yewebhusayithi, ulungelelwaniso lokuqulethiweyo, ukushicilela kwewebhu, ekwakhiweni kwezigramu, iingcinga ezingcali, ukubhaliweyo kweengxelo, amakhono okuqhutywa, ukuqinisekiswa nokulungiswa, ukuthatha izithombe namakhono e-multimedia, ukusombulula iingxaki, iplani nokuhlelwa, ukunakela iinkcukacha, unxibelelwano nabanomdla, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nendlela yokusebenza ngokuzimela nakwinqanaba lesithembu.
xh.duties: Phatha, gcina uphucula ngokuyaqhubeka iwebhusayithi yeJICS nemiqobo yamanani ngentlawulo yewebhusayithi, ukushicilela okuqulethiweyo, ukuphucula amava omsebenzisi, ukubika ngokuqhutywa, inkxaso yoluntu kumanani nokuhambelana namagqabantshintshi okuqhutywa koluntu nolawulo lolwazi karhulumente. Layisha, lungisa uphinde ushicilele okuqulethiweyo okuvunyiweyo; qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi luyaqhubeka, luchanekile, lufikeleleka luhambelana nemvelaphi yenhlangano; qhatha imisebenzi yewebhusayithi, amakhonkco, ukufikelela nokusebenza; qulunqa iingxelo zokuqhutywa nezokusetyenziswa; hlela iinkqubo zokuqhutywa kumanani nalungiselelo zewebhu kunye nabaphathi bangaphakathi; nika inkxaso kumxholo wemidiba yomlibo nakwazithathu-ngaphezulu apho kufuneka khona; gcina iirekhodi ezimanani nemitabo yokuqulethiweyo; nceda ekusombululeni iingxako ngokomthetho, intlawulo yeCMS nolwazi lomsebenzisi; chukumisana neemveliso ezinikayo iinkonzo namaphantse abasebenzi ngamasebe e-ICT ngokuphucula inkqubo yobuchwepheshe uze qinisekise ukwamkelwa kwe-POPIA, iimfuno zolawulo lwamarekhodi nendlela yokuqhutywa evunyiweyo.

jobs.reference_number: JI 43/2026 Office of the Chief Financial Officer
jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Management Accounting & BAS
jobs.summary: Senior state accountant responsible for management accounting, budget planning and BAS control at the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), National Diploma (NQF 6) or Bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) in Financial Management / Accounting / Cost and Management Accounting / Public Finance/Commerce / Financial Accounting or an equivalent qualification recognised by SAQA. BAS Controller Certification, PERSAL certification, advanced Excel training and public sector financial management courses will serve as an advantage. Minimum 3 to 5 years' experience in a management accounting, budgeting or financial management environment. Experience in public sector financial management, working with BAS, expenditure monitoring and reporting, compiling budget information and financial reports and performing BAS PUBLIC Controller functions. Skills and competencies: financial management, management accounting, BAS administration, budget monitoring, expenditure analysis, report writing, communication skills, planning and organising, analytical thinking, problem solving, attention to detail, computer literacy and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Provide management accounting services through the coordination and administration of budget planning, expenditure management, financial reporting and cash flow management processes. Assist with the preparation and consolidation of annual, Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) and adjusted budgets, monitor expenditure trends and budget utilisation, conduct variance analysis, and provide financial information and advice to management and programme managers. Support the implementation of budget reallocations, virements, rollovers and adjustment estimate processes and ensure compliance with relevant Treasury prescripts. Prepare and coordinate monthly, quarterly and annual management accounting reports, including In-Year Monitoring (IYM) reports, expenditure projections, cash flow forecasts and other financial management information required for decision- making and reporting purposes. Monitor cash flow performance, analyse financial and expenditure trends, and provide recommendations aimed at improving financial management and budget performance. Perform Basic Accounting System (BAS) Controller functions, including the administration of user profiles and access rights, maintenance of system controls, management of user accounts, performance of month-end and year-end processes, monitoring of system security and segregation of duties controls, and ensuring the integrity and reliability of information recorded on BAS. Provide user support and training, resolve system-related queries, maintain audit trails and supporting documentation, and liaise with National Treasury and other relevant support structures on BAS-related matters. Ensure compliance with the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and other applicable financial prescripts. Participate in internal and external audit processes, provide information required by auditors, support the implementation of audit recommendations and maintain adequate financial records and supporting documentation for audit and compliance purposes. Provide financial systems administration support through the maintenance and monitoring of financial systems, reconciliation of information between BAS and other financial systems, testing of system enhancements and implementation of improvements aimed at strengthening financial management, reporting and internal control processes.

af.title: Senior Staatsrekenmeester: Bestuursrekeningkunde & BAS
af.summary: Senior staatsrekenmeester verantwoordelik vir bestuursrekeningkunde, begrotingsbeplanning en BAS-beheer by die Regsinspekteur vir Korrektiewe Dienste in Centurion.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) in Finansiële Bestuur / Rekeningkunde / Koste- en Bestuursrekeningkunde / Openbare Finansies / Handel / Finansiële Rekeningkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie erken deur SAQA hê. BAS-beheerder-sertifisering, PERSAL-sertifisering, gevorderde Excel-opleiding en openbare-sektor finansiële bestuurskursusse sal 'n voordeel wees. Minimum 3 tot 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n bestuursrekeningkundige, begrotings- of finansiële bestuursomgewing. Ervaring in openbare-sektor finansiële bestuur, werk met BAS, bestedingsmonitering en verslagdoening, samestelling van begrotingsinligting en finansiële verslae en die uitvoer van BAS PUBLIC-beheerder-funksies. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: finansiële bestuur, bestuursrekeningkunde, BAS-administrasie, begrotingsmonitering, bestedingsanalise, verslagskrywing, kommunikasievaardighede, beplanning en organisering, analitiese denke, probleemoplossing, aandag aan detail, rekenaarvaardigheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf bestuursrekeningkundige dienste deur die koördinering en administrasie van begrotingsbeplanning, bestuursbesteding, finansiële verslagdoening en kontantvloei-bestuursprosesse. Help met die voorbereiding en konsolidasie van jaarlikse, Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) en aangepaste begrotings, monitor bestedingstendense en begrotingsbenutting, voer variansie-analise uit, en verskaf finansiële inligting en advies aan bestuur en programbestuurders. Ondersteun die implementering van begrotingsherbedelings, oorboekings, oorplegtings en hersieningsramings-prosesse en verseker nakoming van tersaaklike Tesourie-voorskryf. Berei voor en koördineer maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse bestuursrekeningkundige verslae, insluitend In-Year Monitoring (IYM) verslae, bestedingsprojeksies, kontantvloeivoorspellings en ander finansiële bestuursinligting wat vir besluitneming en verslagdoeningsdoeleindes benodig word. Monitor kontantvloeiprestasie, analiseer finansiële en bestedingstendense, en verskaf aanbevelings gemik op die verbetering van finansiële bestuur en begrotingsprestasie. Voer Basic Accounting System (BAS) beheerder-funksies uit, insluitend die administrasie van gebruikersprofiele en toegangsregte, onderhoud van stelselbeheer, bestuur van gebruikersrekeninge, uitvoering van maandeinde en jaareinde-prosesse, monitering van stelselsekuriteit en skeiding van pligte-beheer, en verseker die integriteit en betroubaarheid van inligting op BAS aangeteken. Verskaf gebruikersondersteuning en -opleiding, los stelselverwante navrae op, onderhou ouditspore en ondersteunende dokumentasie, en skakel met die Nasionale Tesourie en ander tersaaklike ondersteuningsstrukture oor BAS-verwante aangeleenthede. Verseker nakoming van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en ander toepaslike finansiële voorskryf. Neem deel aan interne en eksterne ouditprosesse, verskaf inligting deur ouditeure benodig, ondersteun die implementering van ouditaanbevelings en onderhou voldoende finansiële rekords en ondersteunende dokumentasie vir oudit- en nakomingsdoeleindes. Verskaf finansiële stelselsadministrasie-ondersteuning deur die onderhoud en monitering van finansiële stelsels, afstemming van inligting tussen BAS en ander finansiële stelsels, toetsing van stelselverbeterings en implementering van verbeterings gemik op die versterking van finansiële bestuurs-, verslagdoenings- en interne beheerprosesse.

zu.title: Omfundi Wezimali Wombuso Ophakemei: I-Accounting Yolawulo & i-BAS
zu.summary: Umfundi wezimali wombuso ophakemei onobhekene ne-accounting yolawulo, ukuhlela kabhalwe kwezimali nokulawula i-BAS eJudicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services e-Centurion.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kumele babe nesithifakamabhasobhudogo se-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), i-National Diploma (NQF 6) noma i-degree ye-Bachelor (NQF 7) kwaku-Financial Management / Accounting / Cost and Management Accounting / Public Finance/Commerce / Financial Accounting noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezivunywe yi-SAQA. Ukuqinisekiswa kwe-BAS Controller, ukuqinisekiswa kwe-PERSAL, uqeqesho olusezingeni eliphezulu lwe-Excel nezifundo zolawulo lwezimali komphakathi kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukuthwala isipiliyoni seminyaka engu-3 kuya ku-5 kwindawo ye-management accounting, ukubhalisa kabhalisa noma ukulawula izimali. Isipiliyoni kulawulo lwezimali komphakathi, ukusebenza ne-BAS, ukubuka ukusetshenziswa kwezimali nokubika, ukuqamba ulwazi mayelana nabhalwe kabhalisa kanye nezibiko zezimali kanye nokwenza imisebenzi ye-BAS PUBLIC Controller. Amakhono namandla: ukulawula izimali, i-management accounting, ukulawula i-BAS, ukubuka ibhajethi, ukuhlaziya ukusetshenziswa kwezimali, ukubhala izibiko, amakhono okuxhumana, ukuhlela nokuhlelela, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukunaka imininingwane, ukwazi ukusebenza ngemikhando kanye nokuba ukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nangaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Nikela ngamasevisi e-management accounting ngokubambisana nokulawula ukuhlela kabhalwe kwezimali, ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwezimali, ukubika ngezimali kanye namashejula okulawula ukuphela kwemali. Siza ekulungiseleleni nasekuhlanganiseni amabhajethi eminyaka yonke, i-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) kanye namabhajethi alungisiwe, bengibuka ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezimali kuphi kanjani nendlela abhajethi esetshenziswa ngayo, ukwenza ukuhlaziya kwezinto ezingafani, futhi unikeze ulwazi nengeluleko ngemali kubaphathi kubaphathi bamaphrogramu. Sekele ukuphathwa kabusha kwamabhajethi, ukudluliselwa kwamabhajethi, amashebho kanye namashejula okulungiselela kwayo uqinisekise ukuthi akulandelwa imithetho eqondile yeTreasury. Lungiselela futhi ubambisane nokubika okukhonjiswa njalo ngenyanga, kwenyanga neyomnyaka we-management accounting, okuhlanganisa izibiko ze-In-Year Monitoring (IYM), ukubikezela ukusetshenziswa kwezimali, ukubikezela ukuphela kwemali kanye nalunye ulwazi lolawulo lwezimali oludingekile ekwenzeni izinqumo nasekubiken. Buka ukusebenza kwe-cash flow, hlaziya ukuphela kwemali namashejula okusetshenziswa kwezimali, futhi unikeze izinketho ezihloselwe ukuthuthukisa ukulawula izimali nendlela abhajethi esebenza ngayo. Yenza imisebenzi ye-Basic Accounting System (BAS) Controller, okuhlanganisa ukulawula amaphrofayi womsebenzisi namalungelo okungena, ukugcina ukulawula kwesistimu, ukulawula ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi, ukwenza amashejula okuphela kwenyanga nenyanga, ukubuka ukuphepha kwesistimu nokuhlukaniswa kwemisebenzi, futhi uqinisekise ukuzinza nokuthembeka kolwazi olugcinwe kwi-BAS. Nikela ngokwesekela kubasebenzisi nokuqeqesha, xazulula izinkinga ezihlobene nesistimu, gcina ubufakhi bokuhlola namadokhumenti okusekela, futhi uxhumane ne-National Treasury kanye nezinye izakhiwo zokusekela mayelana nezindaba ze-BAS. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), imithetho yeTreasury kanye nezinye imithetho ezihlobene nezimali. Thatha inhlanganja kumashejula okuhlola angaphakathi nangaphandle, nikeza ulwazi oludingwa bahloli, sekele ukusetshenziswa kwezinketho zokuhlola futhi ugcine irekhodi nezinkomba ezanele zezimali namadokhumenti okusekela ngenhlosela yokuhlola nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho. Nikela ngesekelo lolawulo lwamahlelo wezimali ngokugcina futhi ubuke amahlelo wezimali, ukuqondanisa ulwazi phakathi kwe-BAS namanye amahlelo wezimali, ukuhlola ukuthuthuka kwesistimu nokuphatha ukuthuthukisa okuhloselwe ukuthuthukisa ukulawula izimali, ukubika kanye namashejula okulawula angaphakathi.

xh.title: Mlimi wesizwe ophakamileyo: Urhwebo lokulawula & i-BAS
xh.summary: Mlimi wesizwe ophakamileyo onoxanduva lokulawula urhwebo, ukuqamba icebiso nobugcinja be-BAS kwiNqanaba leSikhosi leKonjulwa eZolungileyo eCenturion.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesiPapashana samabanga a-12 (isiQinisekiso esiPhezulu), izidanga ezingangamazwe (NQF 6) okanye iBakhalori yedigri (NQF 7) kokuLawula kweMali / Urhwebo / iindleko kunye noLawulo lweRhwebo / iMali kaLuntu / uRhwebo / Urhwebo lweMali okanye isifo esilinganayo esivunywa yi-SAQA. Uqinisekiso lokuLawula i-BAS, uqinisekiso lwe-PERSAL, uqeqesho olutshintshekileyo lwe-Excel nokuqhuba iinkcukacha zemiyalezo yemali kommandla koluntu kuya kubakuncedi. Amava abangangeyure ezingama-3 ukuya kwezi-5 ekulawulweni kurhwebo, ekuqambeni icebiso okanye ekulawulweni kwemali. Amva ekulawulweni kwemali kommandla koluntu, ukusebenza nge-BAS, ukugcina iliso kwentlawulo nokubika, ukuqhkelela ulwazi malunga necebiso nokubika ngemali nokwenza imisebenzi yokulawula i-BAS PUBLIC. Amandla namakhono: ukulawula kwemali, urhwebo lokulawula, ukulawula kwe-BAS, ukugcina amava, ukwahlulela amawa, ukubhala iingxelo, amandla okunxibelelana, ukuyila nokuhlela, ukucinga ngokuhlola, ukusombulula iingxaki, kuqeqeshe kumacandelo namava, ukusebenza ngokuzimeleyo njengakwindidi yeqela.
xh.duties: Nikezela iinkonzo zorhwebo lokulawula ngokulungelelanisa nokuqhelanisa iinkqubo zokuqamba icebiso, ukulawula amawa, ukubika ngemali nokulawula kwakho. Linganisa ukulungelelanisa nokudityaniswa konyaka, esiNgangamva esiMaphakathi (MTEF) kwaye ulungelelanise iimali, ugcine amava amawa nokusetyenziswa kwembali, wenze isikhathyazana sokwahlula, unikeze ulwazi ngemali nezengomculo kum lawulo ngokusebenzisa amaNkqubo. Sicela uxhase ukusetenziswa kokuqamba kabusha kwembali, i-virements, ukulibuyisa emva kwe-estimate yokusuka kokulungelelanisa uqinisekise ukuzithobela iNqaku ezinzima zeTreasury. Lungelanisa nokulungelelanisa iingxelo zorhwebo lonyaka nenyanga nenyanga, kubandakanya iingxelo zoMzila kwiNyaka (IYM), ukulinganisa amawa, ukulinganisa imali kwabantu belali ngokuthileyo kwezezimali efuneka kwiNqanaba lokugqiba nokubika. Ukhangelwe isimo sokugcinwa kwemali, uhlolithwe imarike ngokomoya, ngokomkhosi wendalo wezezimali neemfuno ekunzwi nokunika izindululo ukuze kusonywe isimo sokukhula iNqanaba leNkokha elinzima kwamacebo, ukusetyenziswa kwamaxhosa, ubuncinane beNkqubo yeBAS (BAS) ekudityanisweni kolwimi, ukulawulwa kokunika amalungiselelo okuzuzwayo, ukulawulwa kwesimo sokulunga ngokuphumelelayo, ukwenza iinkqubo zokubetha iNyanga neNyaka, ukulawula ubuhlonzi bokungeniselela nokunqwenelela kwemigudu yolawulo, ukwenza isigqibo ngokubaluleka ngesingqisiso solwazi olugcinwe kwi-BAS. Thembisa inkxaso yomsebenzisi nokwazi ukuqeqesha ngokubanzi besikolo, uxazule iingxaki ezinxulumene nesixhobo, zigcine iziyalezo ezingasetyenziswa ukuqinisekisa iingcebiso ezahlukeneyo malunga neBAS zifunyanwe ngokutsho kwinani leTreasury. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela ngokomthetho woMthetho woLawulo woMali kaRhulumente (PFMA), iziNqamlezva ezigqibele kwaye nezigqibo ezahlukeneyo ezihlobene nezinye iNqakamiso ezifakiweyo. Thabatha inxaxheba kwiNqanaba lokuqeqeswa kolawulo lwangaphakathi nangaphandle, ngokunikela ngolwazi oludingwa yinani, uxhase ukusetyenziswa kweengcebiso zamazwi athunyelwe kulawulo kwaye ulungelelanise neeprotocol ezimbalwa ezakulungelelana okanye okungenasiphithiphathi.

Voer regs- en feitelike analise uit, stel korrespondensie, memorandum en voorleggings op, steun ondersoeke waar nodig en hou toesig oor administratiewe personeel binne die Klae-eenheid om kwaliteit, akkuraatheid en nakoming van JICS-prosedures te verseker.

zu.title: Induna Yamacala: Izikhalazo
zu.summary: Indima yenkokhelo yamakhadi ephakeme eNyuvesi yokuqaphela Izinsizakalo Zokuqaphisana nokuqinisekiswa kwezokulungisa eCape Town, inesibopho sokwamukela, ukuqaphela kanye nokuphatha izikhalazo zabagqogi.
zu.requirements: Izicelo azidibana nakho ukuba azinokwaziswa nokuqaphuliswa khona nokuqinisekiswa kwezinyanga ezintathu eziphakamisa ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo: ukuba naMadeshi Womqondo Wamakhadi Olu-1, Isikole Esiphakeme/Umgangatho 12, Iziqu ze-BProc/LLB noma Isidanga Sokumqondisa okuvunyiwe ku-NQF 7 njengoba kuvunyiwe yi-SAQA. 1-3 iminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza lapho kufanele linye kulawula abantu. Ukwaziswa okujulile kanye nokuqonda uMthethosisekelo, uMthetho Wezinkonzo Zokulungisa, i-PAJA, i-POPIA, uMthetho Wokulandela Izolo, umthetho wokufakwa kwamaphoyisa, ukuhlelakwa komthetho kwezinqumo kanye namanye amakhulu okumqondisa okubusa isikhala sezinsizakalo zokulungisa nenhlekelele yomphakathi. Ukusebenzisa kahle isiNgisi kanti futhi ululimi olunye oluvunyiwe. Ikakhulu ukusebenzisa okuhlala kwenzeka emthethweni ukulalelela, ukubhala nokuqamba, ukulungiselela imibiko, amasu okusebenza, ukuxhumana nabantu, ukulungiselela nokulungisa izinkinga, ukubuka ngokucophelela, amasu okuphatha kanye nakho ukusebenzela ngabanye kanye nokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu.
zu.duties: Umphumeleli ophumelelayo uzobe nesibopho sokwamukela,okuqaphela nokuphatha izikhalazo zabagqogi ukuze athwebule futhi alondoloze iziqoshwa ezifanele nenhloso yokuthola amaphethini, izinqubo ezisizinda kanye nezindaba ezidinga ukungenelela. Bhalisa futhi uhlolisise izikhalazo, qaphela ukumathuluzi okusekelwayo, cela ulwazi olwengeziwe lapho kudingeka futhi lungiselela izincomo zokuqashwa. PUBLIC Qaphela izikhathi ezimisiwe, qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemigqa emiyala yamacala ngendlela efanele futhi uhlanganise izibalo nemibiko yabaphathi uphekelele Umphathi: Ikheli Lezikhalazo. Xhumana noMnyango Wezinkonzo Zokulungisa, Namakomidi Abavakashi, Abavakashi Abazimele BeziNkambiso Zokulungisa kanye nabanye abahlonishana ukwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izikhalazo nokuphakamisa izindaba eziphuthumayo. Yenza isilinganiso sezomthetho kanye nezinto eziyiqiniso, hlela imikhumbulo, imibhalo kanye nokuwethulwa, useke iziphondo lapho kudingeka futhi ulawule abasebenzi bolulo ngaphakathi kweKeli Lezikhalazo ukuze uqinise isevela, ukuqinisekiswa nokuhambisana nokuqondiswa kwe-Consumer Protection Commission (JICS) izinqubo ze-JICS.

xh.title: Unjineli weMimandla yoGcino lwe-CDP: Ukujoliswa kubaphathi abangangenwa ngaphantsi
xh.summary: Inkxaso yengingangi: ukuba nolwazi ngaphezulu kwemisebenzi emitsha, nokusetyenziswa kolwazi olusemthethweni nakuloo maxesha angakazange abe namsebenzi wakhe. Ulungelelwano lwezinto ezahlukeneyo ezisezantsi ezisebenzayo kubakho ukuxhomeleka ekugcineni urhwebo kwinkqubo yokulungelelanisa iinkalo ezingasentla nakumaxesha amaninzi amakhulu. Iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokugcina izikweru, iziphenezo ezahlukeneyo kunye nemicimbi yemihla ngemihla, nokulinganisela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokubakho ngokusemthethweni ukuba singangenwa ngaphantsi.
xh.requirements: Izicelo ezininzi zisemthethweni kodwa sisuke sibambe iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuziphatha kwabasebenzi abaninzi abaziphilisayo ngokusemthethweni. Izinto ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza zifuna isiprothisthu nemicimbi ekhawulezayo njengengxaki yoxhalo lwemihla ngemihla. Kufuneka kubekho isiseko esomeleleyo ngaphezulu kwexesha elide lokuziphatha ekunikezelwa kona, ukugcina urhwebo nakwindalo esemthethweni yalawo maxesha, kwaye kulungelelaniswe iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqinisekisa urhwebo kwaye kubekho ukugcina ixesha elifutshane leminikelo eyahlukeneyo yonke.
xh.duties: Umphathi oyintloko kumabala eengozi: Iinkcukacha ezimalunga nesarhwebo lokuthengisa kunye nendlela yokulungelelanisa urhwebo.

jobs.title: Senior Case Officer: Mandatory Reporting
jobs.summary: Senior legal professional needed to monitor and report on mandatory inmate reports for the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), an LLB, BProc or recognised legal qualification at NQF Level 7 recognised by SAQA. 1 – 3 years relevant working experience of which one (1) year must be in a supervisory experience. In-depth knowledge and understanding of the Constitution, Correctional Services Act, PAJA, POPIA, Criminal Procedure Act, Law of Evidence, interpretation of Statute and other legal frameworks governing the correctional environment and public service. Proficiency in English and at least one other official language. Ability to write analytically. Valid driver’s licence is essential and willingness to travel. Skills and competencies: computer literacy, legal research and analysis, report writing, communication skills, stakeholder liaison, planning and organising, problem solving, attention to detail, supervisory skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible to Monitor, enquire and evaluate reports received on all inmates in terms of section 95D of the Correctional Services Act. Write reports and make recommendations on systemic problems and practices, ensuring a good administration of mandatory reports by DCS. Monitor timeframes, ensure proper case-file management and compile statistics and management reports for the Assistant Director: Mandatory Unit. Manage, coordinate and foster relationships with external stakeholders Conduct legal and factual analysis, draft correspondence, memoranda and submissions, support investigations where required and supervise administrative staff within the Mandatory Unit to ensure quality, accuracy and compliance with JICS procedures.

af.title: Senior Case Officer: Mandatory Reporting
af.summary: Senior regsprofessionele persoon benodig om verpligte gevangeneverslae vir die Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Cape Town te moniteer en daaroor te verslag.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van Graad 12 (Senior Certificate), 'n LLB, BProc of 'n erkende regskwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 wat deur SAQA erken word. 1 – 3 jaar se relevante werkervaring waarvan een (1) jaar toesigervaring moet wees. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die Grondwet, Correctional Services Act, PAJA, POPIA, Criminal Procedure Act, Law of Evidence, interpretasie van Statute en ander regsraamwerke wat die korrektiewe omgewing en openbare diens regeer. Vaardigheid in Engels en ten minste een ander amptelike taal. Vermoë om analities te skryf. Geldige bestuurslisensie is noodsaaklik en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: rekenaarvaardigheid, regsnavorsing en -analise, verslagskrywing, kommunikasievaardighede, belanghebbende-liaison, beplanning en organisering, probleemoplossing, aandag aan detail, toesigvaardighede en die vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die monitering, ondersoek en evaluering van verslae wat ontvang word oor alle gevangenes ingevolge artikel 95D van die Correctional Services Act. Verslae skryf en aanbevelings maak oor stelselmatige probleme en praktyke, en sodoende goeie administrasie van verpligte verslae deur DCS verseker. Tydperke moniteer, behoorlike saaklidossierbestuur verseker en statistieke en bestuursverslae opstel vir die Assistant Director: Mandatory Unit. Betrekingske met externe belanghebbendes bestuur, koördineer en bevorder. Regs- en feiteanalise doen, korrespondensie, memoranda en voorleggings opstel, ondersoeke ondersteun waar nodig en administratiewe personeel binne die Mandatory Unit toesien om kwaliteit, akkuraatheid en nakoming van JICS-prosedures te verseker.

zu.title: Umphathi Wosazi: Ukubikwa Okuphoqelekile
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu othembekile wezomthetho ukuba alalele futhi abike ngemibiko ephoqelelwe yabangamshini ye-Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services e-Cape Town.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), i-LLB, i-BProc noma isilinganiso somthetho esiqashelwa esiZingeni 7 le-NQF esiqashelwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka engu-1 – 3 yokusebenza okuhambisana nalesi lapho kuyiminyaka eyodwa (1) kufanele ibe ngokuhlolwa kokubusa. Ulwazi olujulile nokuzwa ngomthethosisekelo, umthetho Wezinsizakusebenza Zokulungisa, i-PAJA, i-POPIA, umthetho Wezinqubo Zezobu-Gebengu, umthetho Wobufakazi, incazelo yomthetho kanye namanye amashekethe womthetho aphatha indawo yokulungisa nesevisi yomphakathi. Ukukhombisa ukuchuma ngesiNgisi okungenani olunye ulimi olusemthethweni. Ikhono lokubhala ngokuqhathanisa. Ilayisensi yomshayeli evumelekile iyadingeka futhi ukuzithoba ukuhamba. Amakhono namandla: ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, ukuphenya nokuhlola umthetho, ukubhala imibiko, amandla okuxoxa, ukuxhumana nabalingane, ukuhlela nokuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukunakela imininingwane, amandla okubusa kanye nekhono lokusebenza eyedwa futhi njengengxenye yeqembu
zu.duties: Umvumelekile ophumelele uzobe negunya lokulalela, ukubuza imibuzo nokuhlola imibiko etholwe ngabangamshini bonke ngokusho kwesigaba 95D somthetho Wezinsizakusebenza Zokulungisa. Ukubhala imibiko nokwenza izincomo ngemiba nezinqubo ezisimilo, kuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwemibiko ephoqelelwe yi-DCS. Ukulalela izikhathi ezibekiwe, ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwamafayela ezicala futhi ukuqoqa izibalo nemibiko yolawulo eya kumdluli: Unit Ehlomula. Ukuphatha, ukuhlanganisa nokwakha izinhlangano nabalingane bangaphandle; Ukwenza ukuhlaziywa komthetho nangemininingwane, ukubhala ukuhlanganyelana, amamemorandamu nokulethwa, ukusekela iziphepho lapho kudingeka khona futhi ukuphatha abasebenzi abangomthetho ngaphakathi kwe-Unit Ehlomula ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga, ukunemba nokuhambisana nezinqubo ze-JICS.

xh.title: Isikhululi esiKhululeyo seGxelo: ukubika okuMnyanzelekayo
xh.summary: Kudingwa ngowelizwe olusemthethweni osokhulileyo ukuba ahlole axeke iingxelo ezibekwe kwindlela kubabotyiwe zeZiko leNgqwalasela yamalungiselelo amnyama e-Cape Town.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nomatshitshi we-Grade 12 (i-Certificate ePhezulu), i-LLB, i-BProc okanye isidanga esesigqiwini somthetho esivunywa yi-SAQA kwi-NQF Level 7. 1 – 3 yeminyaka yamava wokusebenza ahambelana nalo apho umnyaka omnye (1) kufuneka abe ngumva wolawulo. Ukuqonda ngokujulileyo nokuqonda uMgaqo-siseko, uMthetho weeNkonzo zokuLungisa, i-PAJA, i-POPIA, uMthetho weziNketho zoManyano, uMthetho weeNkumbulo zoBulungisa, inkcubeko yoMthetho nolunye ulwimi lomthetho olulawula imo yokulungisa iinkonzo zoluntu. Isakhono kwiNgesi kwaye uluselolunye ulwimi olusemthethweni. Ukuba nakho ukubala ngokohlalahlulisayo. i-Driver's licence evakalisiweyo yeyamva kwaye ufune ukuhamba. Isakhono izakhono: ukusebenzisa i-khompyutha, uphando nomhlalutyo womthetho, ukubala iingxelo, izakhono zoxhumo, uxhumaniso nabalingani, ukuhlela nokuhlela, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha, izakhono zolawulo nokuqonda ukusebenza yenza nokuba ngamalungu eqela.
xh.duties: Omqeqi ofelethiyo uza kubizwa kumalungiselelo okuQhwesela, okuPhando nokuhlola iingxelo ezifunyenwe kubo bonke ababotyiwe ngokwecandelo 95D loMthetho weeNkonzo zokuLungisa. Kubala iingxelo zenze izindululo kumngeni wokuqatela nokuziphatha ezixhwele kuqinisekisa ulawulo olululo lweengxelo ezinyanzelekayo ngu-DCS. Qhwesela iimajelo, qinisekisa ulawulo olululo lweefayile ezizeza zibandakanywe kumanani amakhulu iingxelo ezoLawulo eziya kumlawuli oNcedo: iCandelo eLinyazelekayo. Lawula, hlanganisa nikhusela iimbopheleleko nabalingani bangaphandle. Yenza ukwahlulahlula ngokomthetho nangokwenyaniso, cubungula iindaba, izikhokelo neziqulathi zombuzo, xhasa uphando apha kufuneka kwaye ulawule abasebenzi ngokwahlulo kwisikhokelo kwiCandelo eLinyazelekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhetho, ukunyaniseka nokuhambelana nemigaqo ye-JICS.

af.title: Streekinspekteur & Ondersoeke
af.summary: Streekinspekteur wat inspeksies en ondersoeke by korreksionele sentrums uitvoer, wat 'n tersiêre kwalifikasie in kriminele regspleging en een tot drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12/Seniorsertifikaat hê. 3-jarige relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie in Kriminele Regspleging of relevante veld op NQF 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 1-3 jaar relevante werkservaring (onderhoude, afname van verklarings en versameling van bewyse). Selfversekerd en in staat om sperdatums na te kom. Aandag aan besonderhede en uitstekende verslagskryfvaardighede. Vermoë om doeltreffend sonder toesig te werk, maar ook in 'n span. af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir inspeksies en ondersoeke by korreksionele sentrums in die streke. Stel verslae op van voltooide inspeksies en ondersoeke en verwys dit na die Bestuurder: Inspeksies/ondersoeke. Administratiewe take wat verband hou met inspeksies en ondersoeke in die streke. Profilering van korreksionele sentrums en deurgaan van verslae ontvang van Onafhanklike Korreksionele Sentrumbesoekers (ICCV's) in die streek. Skakel met DCS rakende bevindings en aanbevelings oor JICS-inspeksies en -ondersoeke.

zu.title: Isihloli Sesigodi & Izinsomibuzo
zu.summary: Isihloli saseningi esimisebenzi yaso yokuhlela izinsizo nokwenza izifo emayelwe nemigodi yezivumelwano, sifuna imfundo ephakeme eCriminal Justice namaphuzu amu-1 kuya kwa-3 okuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: Abafakisi kufanele ukuba besine-Sitifikethi seMikhakha ye-12/Sezisoni. 3-uleminyaka unemfundo ephakeme edaniswe kwezezimali eCriminal Justice noma nganoma yisiphi isigaba esikelayo esithathwa njengeseduzene ngesibalo seNQF 6 njengoba setshunywe yi-SAQA. 1-3 iminyaka yempilo yokusebenza edaniswe (ukuphisisa imibuzo, ukuthatha izinkulumo nokulondoloza iziqoshwa). Ukuba ngumuntu ohlakaniphile nokuthi akwazi ukugcina izigqibo. Inakale imininingwane ngakho-ke futhi unamakhono aphezulu okubhala imibiko. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngemfe kahle ngaphandle kokubonisana, kodwa futhi nakuqembu. Ilayisensi yokushayela engenazinkomba iyadingeka, kanye nesifiso sokuhamba kakhulu ngokwesikhashana PUBLIC (okuhlanganisaamasonto). Ukubakwazi kakuhle isiNgisi okungenani inelinye ilimi lezomphakathi esisemthethweni.
zu.duties: Umkhethwa ohlangothini lithole izikhundla ezinhle uzoba nobunyebe bokwenza okuhlola nokuphenya emagunyazweni eziyimigcibelo kumantwe. jobs.title: Senior Internal Auditor
jobs.summary: The Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services seeks a Senior Internal Auditor in Centurion to deliver risk-based audit assurance and evaluate governance processes.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), National Diploma (NQF 6) or Bachelor’s Degree (NQF 7) at 3rd year level in Internal Auditing / Auditing / Accounting / Financial Management / Commerce/Risk Management or an equivalent related qualification recognised by SAQA. Added advantage: IIA membership; and CIA, CISA, CRMA studies or certification, etc. Minimum of 3 years' experience in an Internal Audit, External Auditing, Risk Management or Compliance environment. Experience conducting audit assignments, preparing audit working papers and reports, performing risk and control assessments and developing audit findings and recommendations. Added advantage experience in public sector internal auditing, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), compliance audits, performance information audits, information technology audits, risk management, audit committee support or audits within oversight. Knowledge of the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act and Regulations, risk management frameworks, corporate governance principles, fraud risk management, internal control systems, audit methodologies, performance information frameworks and Internal Audit Charter requirements. Skills and competencies: audit planning, risk analysis, report writing, analytical thinking, communication skills, financial analysis, data analysis, interviewing skills, problem solving, attention to detail, stakeholder engagement, presentation skills, computer literacy and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing independent and objective assurance and consulting services through the execution of risk- based internal audit assignments, evaluation of governance processes, internal controls and risk management systems, and the provision of recommendations aimed at improving efficiency, effectiveness and compliance within JICS. Conduct risk-based internal audits in accordance with approved audit project plans; prepare preliminary surveys; process flows; risk assessments; audit programmes. Conduct fieldwork and testing procedures; gather and analyse audit evidence; compile audit working papers; evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of controls; assess compliance with legislation and policies; review financial and operational processes; identify control weaknesses and risks; draft audit findings and recommendations. Compile audit reports; communicate audit outcomes to management; conduct follow-up audits and monitor implementation of audit recommendations. Provide risk management support, conduct governance and compliance reviews, support investigations into irregularities where required, assist with internal audit planning, contribute to risk-based planning processes, provide input into audit universe reviews and assist with preparation of Audit Committee documentation and progress reports. Manage the human, logistical and resources allocated to this position on an ongoing basis in line with PUBLIC organisational prescripts. Promote teamwork and manage conflict effectively to ensure delivery of project objectives.

af.title: Senior Interne Ouditeerder
af.summary: Die Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services soek 'n Senior Interne Ouditeerder in Centurion om risiko-gebaseerde ouditversekering te verskaf en borgingsprosesse te evalueer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) op 3de jaarvlak in Interne Ouditing / Ouditing / Rekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Kommersiële Bestuur / Risikobestuur of 'n gelykwaardige verwante kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken word. Bykomende voordeel: IIA-lidmaatskap; en CIA, CISA, CRMA-studies of sertifisering, ens. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n Interne Oudit, Eksterne Ouditing, Risikobestuur of Nakomingsomgewing. Ervaring in die uitvoer van oudit-opdragte, die voorbereiding van oudit-werkdokumente en verslae, die uitvoer van risiko- en kontrole-assesserings en die ontwikkeling van oudit-bevindings en aanbevelings. Bykomende voordeel: ervaring in openbare sektor interne ouditing, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), nakomingsouditte, prestasie-inligting-ouditte, inligtingstegnologie-ouditte, risikobestuur, ouditkomitee-ondersteuning of ouditte binne toesig. Kennis van die PFMA, Tesourieregulasies, Public Service Act en Regulasies, risikobestuursraamwerke, korporatiewe borgingsbeginsels, bedrog-risikobestuur, interne kontrolestelsels, oudit-metodologieë, prestasie-inligtingsraamwerke en Interne Oudithandvereistes. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: oudit-beplanning, risiko-analise, verslagskrywing, analitiese denke, kommunikasievaardighede, finansiële analise, data-analise, onderhoudvaardighede, probleemoplossing, aandag aan besonderhede, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, aanbiedingsvaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van onafhanklike en objektiewe versekering en konsultasiedienste deur die uitvoering van risiko-gebaseerde interne oudit-opdragte, evaluering van borgingsprosesse, interne kontroles en risikobestuurstelsels, en die verskaffing van aanbevelings wat gemik is op die verbetering van doeltreffendheid, effektiwiteit en nakoming binne JICS. Voer risiko-gebaseerde interne ouditte uit in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde oudit-projekplanne; berei voorlopige opnames voor; prosesvloeie; risiko-assesserings; oudit-programme. Voer veldwerk en toetsprosedures uit; versamel en ontleed ouditbewyse; stel oudit-werkdokumente op; evalueer die toereikendheid en effektiwiteit van kontroles; assesseer nakoming van wetgewing en beleid; hersien finansiële en operasionele prosesse; identifiseer kontrole-swakpunte en risiko's; opsterf oudit-bevindings en aanbevelings. Stel oudit-verslae op; kommunikeer oudit-uitslae aan bestuur; voer opvolgouditte uit en monitor implementering van oudit-aanbevelings. Verskaf risikobestuursondersteuning, voer borgings- en nakomingshersienings uit, ondersteun ondersoeke na ongeregtighede waar vereis, help met interne oudit-beplanning, dra by tot risiko-gebaseerde beplanningsprosesse, verskaf insette tot oudit-universum-hersienings en help met die voorbereiding van Ouditkomitee-dokumentasie en vorderingsverslae. Bestuur die menslike, logistieke en hulpbronne wat aan hierdie posisie op 'n deurlopende basis toegewys is, in ooreenstemming met OPENBARE organisatoriese voorskripte. Bevordere spanwerk en bestuur konflik doeltreffend om levering van projekdoelwitte te verseker.

zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesiQinisekiso seQela le-12 (iQinisekiso eliPhezulu), iDiploma yeSizwe (NQF 6) kuLawulo lweMali, ukuBala, iMali yeRhulumente, uLawulo lweHhofisi neTheknoloji, uMsizi woLawulo, uLawulo loRhulumente okanye isimemo esinomgama esihlobene esamkelwa yi-SAQA; kufuneka babe nobomi obungazanga ngaphantsi kweminyaka engu-2 ukuya kwa-3 ngokubakho amava ngokuxhasa abaphathi, ulawulo lwehhofisi, inkxaso yobobhalane okanye indawo yolawulo lwezimali. jobs.title: Data Capturer: Complaints and Mandatory Reporting
jobs.summary: Capture and maintain complaint and incident data for the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and one to two years' data capturing experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 (Senior Certificate). A Certificate in Office Administration, Information Management, Public Administration, Records Management, Computer Studies or Data Management will be an added advantage. Minimum 1 to 2 years’ experience in data capturing, administration, records management or information management environment. Added advantage: experience in case management systems, complaints management systems, statistical reporting, database administration, public sector administration and legal, correctional services or oversight environments. Knowledge of records management principles, information management practices, data capturing procedures, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, electronic document management systems, Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) and Public Service administrative procedures. Skills and competencies: computer literacy, data capturing, accuracy, attention to detail, record keeping, report writing, communication skills, planning and organising, confidentiality, client orientation, problem solving, ability to work under pressure and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing data capturing and records management services to the Complaints and Mandatory Reporting Units by capturing, updating, verifying and maintaining complaint and incident information, generating statistical reports and ensuring the accuracy, integrity and availability of oversight information. Capture complaints and mandatory reporting information on approved databases and systems, update existing records, process data timeously and verify captured information against source documents. Identify incomplete information, detect and correct data errors, verify accuracy of captured records, monitor data quality standards and ensure consistency of information across systems. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of office management responsibilities, systems and procedures and knowledge of electronic information resources and online retrieval. Skilled in communication (verbal and written), ability to interpret the law, legal writing/drafting /legislative drafting, strong leadership, management capabilities, computer literacy (MS Office), report writing, presentation, problem solving, decision-making, interpersonal relations, organisational skills. Along with the following attributes: ability to multitask, ability to work long hours, under pressure and meticulousness.
jobs.duties: Manage the office of the Judge President, support the Judge President in communication with all stakeholders, management and supervision of Judges’ support staff and operations, oversee the administration within the Office of the Judge President and follow up on the Judge President’s instructions to ensure prompt execution by relevant operational units at the court, liaise with all stakeholders in the department, Heads of Court, Senior Managers, Judges, National office, Legal Professional bodies and other stakeholders with regard to matters emanating from the Office of the Judge President and channel communication to both internal and external stakeholders. Prepare presentations and briefing notes for the Judge President and disseminate complex information to all relevant stakeholders, compile, analyse and report progress on a monthly/quarterly basis. Compile all letters, reports, memoranda and presentations. Ensure tracking of timeframes to enable compliance with various deadlines, manage all the logistical arrangements for the Judge President’s meetings, coordinate the submission of meeting reports and circulate thereafter, provide secretariat support in meetings chaired by the Judge President, ensure the correct application of regulations, resolutions, policies or any other legal source and execute any duties assigned by the Judge President or a Judge designated by the Judge President.

A minimum of two (2) years’ relevant experience in a statistical environment. Experience in a court environment will be an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service and knowledge of relevant policies and strategies. Skilled in computer literacy (MS Office – especially Excel), communication (verbal and written), planning, organising, presentation/facilitation, problem solving, numerical, analytical, interpersonal skills, report writing, attention to detail and time management along with the following attributes: professionalism, strong PUBLIC work ethics, time management, ability to work under pressure, flexible, creative and innovative.

jobs.summary: Perform clerical and administrative duties including case number allocation and file management at the Mpumalanga High Court in Middelburg.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a grade 12 certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level four (4) as recognised by SAQA. No experience is required. A three (3) year’s National Diploma in Legal qualification or equivalent at NQF 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment, registry processes and practice, storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, knowledge and understanding of legislative frameworks governing the Public Service, filling system, Mail procedure manual, Promotion of access to information Act and National archives. Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in computer literacy (MS Office), communication, numeracy, interpersonal, problem solving and analysis, time management and administrative skills.
jobs.duties: Perform clerical and administrative work within the Court: Register/ allocate case numbers to all pleadings and court documents received, ensure that the files have been served on all parties concerned, draw up files for the litigants/Attorney, update the file of return service/s proof services and safe- keep and dispose of case records. Handle court’s request files: Retrieve the requested file and make the file available to the requester, attend to queries from parties and members of the public, record documents received, ensure systematic recording of court files and keep a record of requests received from litigants. Render case management duties: Attend to case management and set down notice, implement case management practices (placing request forms in the space of a file that has been requested, complete and file the movement sheet), render case management duties and monitor files and records as per the case Management. Provide support with administrative registrar: Submit leave forms to HR for compliance, maintain and keep all registers for filing and archiving, comply with the telephone prescripts and leave policies and prepare and sign performance agreement timeously.

jobs.title: Chief Construction Project Manager (GRADE A)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 108 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the OSD
jobs.summary: Lead construction project management at the Gqeberha regional office, overseeing project managers and large-scale capital projects.
jobs.requirements: A minimum Engineering Degree (Built Environment field) or Equivalent qualification, with a minimum of 6 years’ post qualification experience and registration with the relevant council (SACPCMP) as a Professional Construction Project Manager. Valid driver’s license. Knowledge of Programme and Project Management. Project design and analyse, legal and operational compliance as well as the creation of a high-performance culture. Communication skills, problem solving skills, decision making skills, and conflict management skills. Research and development. Strategic capability and leadership. Financial management and computer skills. Negotiation skills.
jobs.duties: Monitor the performance of project managers under his/her supervision. Mentor, develop and offer technical support to improve performance. Manage construction projects on his/her own, ranging from large scale capital projects to maintenance projects and service contracts. Ensure that the needs of the clients are well interpreted into manageable scopes of work. Procure the services of built environment professionals through stipulated supply chain management process. Coordinate the work of various professionals to ensure the required design and 14 documentation quality as well as delivery is in accordance with project execution plans. Coordinate all internal resources required to ensure the bidding process for appointment of contractors. Ensure that appointed consultants manage the quality of work within their professional scope and responsibility. Ensure that contractors timeously receive all relevant specifications and details to construct. Adjudicate all applications of variation orders and extensions of time and make recommendations to the approving authority within the Department. Process all interim monthly payments as per the conditions of contract and in line with the Government’s commitment to pay invoices timeously. Prepare and submit project information to be filled to the Head of Directorate. Secure all required funding for the projects through internal set processes. Ensure that project information is filed appropriately for easy access during audit. Cultivate a culture for good working relationships with fellow colleagues within the Department.

jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 143 468 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the OSD
jobs.summary: Chief Quantity Surveyor needed at the Gqeberha Regional Office to provide in-house quantity surveying services, requiring a degree, SACQSP registration and six years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A Minimum Degree in Quantity Surveying or relevant qualifications with six (6) years post qualification quantity surveying experience required. A valid driver’s licence. Compulsory registration with SA Council for Quantity Surveyors (SACQSP) as a Professional Quantity Surveyor. Must be prepared to travel. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with professional requirements. Extensive knowledge of all quantity surveying aspects of the building and construction environment. Knowledge of contract and building law to the extent applied in the quantity surveying profession. Ability to work with consultants, project managers, work managers, professionals and staff at various levels. Financial administration, programme and project management skills. Computer literacy, budgeting, numeracy skills. The ability to apply professional knowledge and experience. Planning, organizing, problem solving and decision-making skills. Good interpersonal relationships, analytical thinking and conflict management skills. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Cost Management skills. Must be highly motivated and able to work under stressful situations. Must be hardworking and solution orientated ability to design ideas without direction.
jobs.duties: Provide standard in-house quantity surveying service in the regional service. To liaise and co-operate with the Directorate: Quantity surveying services in the professional services component in head Office. The standardization of quantity surveying matters. The provision of quantity surveying –related support and advice to project managers and work managers in the regional office and professional bodies. The auditing and verification of norms, variation orders as well as fee and final accounts on all projects executed by the region. The development and maintenance of the building cost database. The provision of budgetary and administrative support to the component. To visit building sites to review consultants’ cash-flow projections and to assist and monitor progress on documented projects and services. The effective management of subordinates.

jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R914 517 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the OSD
jobs.summary: Construction Project Manager needed at the Gqeberha Regional Office to oversee full project management functions including cost, quality and time control for built environment projects.
jobs.requirements: A minimum National higher diploma (Built Environment field) with a minimum of 4 years and six months certified experience. B-Tech (Built Environment field) with a minimum of 4 years certified managerial experience. Honours degree in any Built Environment field with a minimum of 3 years’ experience. Valid driver’s license. Compulsory registration with the SACPCMP as a Professional Construction Project Manager on appointment. Computer literacy, Knowledge and understanding of the following Acts: Public Finance Management Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act as well as Building Regulations and Environmental Conservation Act, Knowledge and understanding of the Government Procurement System, Good planning, financial and budget skills, Sound analytical and good written and verbal communication skills; Knowledge and understanding of the JBCC and GCC form of contract.
jobs.duties: Contribute to project initiation, scope definition and scope change control for envisaged projects. Full project management function, cost, quality and time control. Manage project cost estimates and control changes in line with allocated budgets. Plan and attend project meetings during the project phases. Assist with the compilation of projects documentation to support project processes. Implement project administration processes according to Government requirements. Ensure implementation of procurement activities and adherence thereof to Government policies. Provide assistance in implementing and assuring that project execution is in accordance with the approved project norms and time schedules. Support the project environment and activities to ensure that project objectives are delivered timeously. Relevant years of experience in training and development practices. A Valid Driver’s License. Knowledge of standards, practices, processes and procedures related to HR development; structure and functioning of the Department; Employment Equity Plan of the Department; regulatory framework related to HR development, including the Skills Development Act; Constitution of the RSA, Public Service Act and Regulations, Collective Agreements, Codes of Remuneration and the Public Finance Management Act; Basic numeracy; interpersonal and diplomacy skills; general administration and organizational skills; interpretation of policies; ability to undertake basic research/gather information; computer utilization; financial administration; change/diversity management; analytical thinking; problem solving skills; motivational skills; influencing skills; presentation skills; advanced negotiation skills; conflict management; communication and report writing abilities. Prepare minutes of meetings held with internal and external stakeholders. Prepare NYS documentation and liaise with stakeholders to ensure learner stipends are paid. Monitor the communication and administer the flow of information and documents in the office. Maintain the filing system and records keeping for projects documents and the unit where required. Maintain a leave register for the component. Provide financial administration support services. Capture and update component expenditure. Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component. Manage and coordinate travel arrangements.

jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1-3 sought at Botshabelo District Hospital to manage medical conditions, supervise junior staff, and perform compulsory commuted overtime.
jobs.requirements: Matric. Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Current annual registration with HPCSA for (2026/2027) Grade 1: None after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 1 year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised PUBLIC foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 6 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience after registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner in respect of South African qualified employees. 11 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of Foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Knowledge And Skill: Extensive knowledge on Public Service legislation, policies and procedures. Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, report writing, medico-legal reports). Good interpersonal skills as well as display of honesty, integrity and excellent work ethics. Knowledge in Childcare, Maternity, Surgical and Peadiatrics will be added as an advantage.
jobs.duties: Management of all medical conditions to ensure that a competent service is provided to all patients. Candidates will have to perform commuted overtime duties (compulsory & non-negotiable). Supervise junior staff in order to provide adequate medical care and to train them to be able to do key medical interventions. Consult patients on an outpatient basis to have optimal chronic disease management and good long term follow up. Briefing, informing and counselling patients and where appropriate relatives regarding prevention, treatment operative, complications and rehabilitation. Endeavour to become skilled in resuscitative measures and intensive care treatment to assure survival of critically ill-patients.

Valid Driver's license. Computer literacy Knowledge and Skills: PFMA / Treasury. Regulations / Practice Notes / Instructions / Circulars. Provincial / Departmental Supply Chain Management Policies. National Building Standards Act of 1977 and Regulations. Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. Health Act and Regulations. Engineering Professional Act 2000. Preference Procurement Act of 2000 and Regulations. Broad Based Black Empowerment Act of 2003. Expanded Public Works Programme. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Project Construction Management Professions Act of 2000. National Environmental Management Act of 1998. Promotion of Administrative Information Act of 2000. ISO standards Relevant Provincial Land. Administration Legislation. All different types and forms of construction contracts. jobs.duties: Infrastructure Programme and Project Planning in line with IDMS Prepare the Procurement Strategy, Infrastructure Programme Management Plan (IPMP) and updating of the plan. Prepare the infrastructure budget and Final Project List. Prepare the Packages/Individual Project Briefs; presenting these to the Implementing Agent (IA)- referred to as Project Execution Plan v1 with all the inputs obtained from the Directorate Infrastructure Planning. Manage preparation of Packages/Individual Project Briefs for projects that are not allocated to an Implementing Agent (IA). Participate in the procurement of Professional Service Providers and Contractors, including the preparation and approval of Bid Specifications and evaluations of tenders as member of the Supply Chain Management Committees in Public Services and/or relevant SCM Committees of Alternative IA and Provincial Department of Health. Manage adherence to Occupational Health and Safety and Quality Assurance standards. Infrastructure Programme and Project Implementation and Monitoring. Monitor the implementation of Programmes and Projects by the Implementing Agent (IA) and the adherence to the Service Delivery Agreement. Manage project implementation of projects that are not allocated to an Implementing Agent (IA). Review and sign-off on the Infrastructure Programme Implementation Plan (IPIP) as prepared by the Implementing Agent (AI). Review and sign-off on the Project Execution Plans Versions 2-7 prepared by the Implementing Agent (IA) with inputs received from the Directorate Infrastructure Planning. Review and recommend Variation Orders in terms of contract management practice and financial procedures, software applications and tools. Research/literature studies to keep up with new technologies, viability and feasibility of the geographical information management options for the Department including interaction with relevant professional development boards/councils. Study professional journals and publications to stay abreast of new developments. Monitor and study the Health sector, legal frameworks, standards changes and policy frameworks. Engage in relevant continuous professional development activities (tools and techniques) as prescribed and/or required. Update the Infrastructure policies of the Department in terms of research findings, new technology and changes in the institutional environment. Interact with relevant Professional Bodies/Councils.

jobs.salary_text: R785 568 per annum, plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional, Employee must meet the prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager position in critical care nursing at Boitumelo Regional Hospital in Kroonstad, overseeing the HAST programme and requiring SANC registration as a Professional Nurse.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Good communication skills and intersectoral collaborations. Strong management and leadership skills. Ability to analyse data and quality assessment. Appropriate financial management.

Implementation of the strategies aimed at behavioural change reducing new infections and retention of patients to care. Implement HAST programme according to the strategic plans. Provide programme technical and clinical support to the health care facilities and stakeholders. Implementation of all HAST programmes in the district and monitor thereof. Management of HAST multidisciplinary team and stakeholder coordination. Analyse and manage HIV/AIDS and TB data to strengthen programme implementation. Undertake clinic, hospital support visits and audits to ensure programme compliance. Lad health and wellness events that seek to influence behavioural change.

jobs.salary_text: R720 819 – R821 454 per annum, plus 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance, Medical Aid (Optional), Employee must meet the prescribed requirements
jobs.summary: Manage specialised nursing care and resource supervision at Katleho District Hospital in the Free State, requiring SANC registration as a Professional Nurse.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate, Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR - A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR - A 3-year Diploma in General Nursing (R171) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with SANC in Intensive Nursing Science. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse (2026/2027). A minimum of 9 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to the above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in Intensive Nursing Science after obtaining 1-year post-basic qualification in the Intensive Nursing Science specialty. Knowledge And Skills: Ability to provide holistic care. Computer literacy. Knowledge of Public Service Legislation, policies and procedures. Thorough knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele principles, etc. Knowledge of HR policies such as: Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure.
jobs.duties: Coordination of optimal, holistic specialised nursing care provided within set standards and a professional/legal framework. Manage effectively the utilization and supervision of resources. Coordination of the provision of effective training and research. Provision of Effective Support to Nursing Services. Effective utilization of resources (Human and Material) participation with training and research. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development. Demonstrate an in depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices and how to impact on service delivery. Ensure clinical nursing practices by the nursing team (unit) in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determine by the relevant health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Demonstrate and basic understanding HR and financial policies and practices. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisor, other health professionals and junior colleagues, including more complex report writing when required. Work as part of multi-disciplinary team at unit level to ensure good nursing care by the nursing team. Work effectively and amicable, at supervisory level, with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, PUBLIC racial or religious differences. Able to manage own work, time and that of junior colleagues to ensure proper nursing services in the unit. Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensuring that the unit adheres to the principle of Batho Pele. Able to develop contact, build and maintain a network of professional relations in order to enhance service delivery. Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery.

A minimum of 04 years of appropriate /recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Knowledge And Skills: Computer literacy. Knowledge of Public Service Legislation, policies and procedures. Thorough knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele principles, etc. Knowledge of HR policies such as: Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure.

Promotion of MBFHI (Mother Baby Friendly Hospital Initiative). Ensure compliance with infection control principles and waste management guidelines. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to lead in a shift and shift worker. Flexibility towards departmental needs. Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary team. Managing administration functions. Ability to utilize resources effectively, staff development and PMDS. Ensure compliance to Ideal Hospital Realization Framework guideline, policies, regulations, protocols, guidelines and SOP. Communication and Problem-solving skills and accurate data collection. To assist in planning/organizing and monitoring of the objectives of the specialized unit (Maternity unit) in consultation with subordinates. To provide a therapeutic environment for staff, patients and the public.
